reviews.title: A Great Visit
reviews.text: Tuscany is a welcoming fun place to visit.  The games are fun and accommodations are roomy and clean. The beds were comfortable and appreciated having a coffee maker in the room.

reviews.title: The Best Gamble to take while in Vegas Baby!
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino is a wonderful place to come for your Vegas getaway. It's a close and easy walk to the strip or a short uber/taxi drive and close enough to Harry Reid international without the noise of the airplanes.  Sometimes "you get what you pay for" can come into play, but I was VERY pleasantly surprised that this wonderfully affordable hotel was beautifully manicured, had large spacious and clean rooms, and a great variety of restaurants, bars, and cafes!  Not to mention, if I didn't want to go to the strip to gamble, the casino on site had so much to offer.  I already told my husband that we're coming back and staying here because next time I also want to enjoy the beautiful pool and spa area they offer. You will not be disappointed. Save the $ for shows, shopping, and more and stay at the Tuscany Suites & Casino. It's the best gamble you'll make while in Vegas!

reviews.title: Nice stay off the Strip
reviews.text: Nice room: large, clean, with fridge, great bed, and quiet. No microwave in room but could have requested one. Didn’t use the pools but they looked inviting and well kept. Distance from Strip was OK if you are willing to do the walk (about 15+ minutes).

reviews.title: Awesome Stay!
reviews.text: In town for a concert we selected this hotel as it was off the strip and less costly. We were a family of four adults and the room was impressive as it was quite spacious. The room consisted of two full-size beds, a living room with a nice sized couch, armchair, office chair/desk and a dining table, TV. There was a kitchenette with fridge and coffee maker (Keurig) and wet bar but no microwave (but we did see severalmicrowaves locked up in the maids’ closet at end of hall). The bathroom consisted of a square-shaped size shower (single person size), a toilet, bathtub and vanity. The room was carpeted (as opposed to a wooden or linoleum floor). They had a nice pool, bar and breakfast restaurant on site, too. The main pool had loud punk music being piped in but the nearby lap pool did not. They had poolside drink service, too. We all loved the small scale of the resort (three stories) and the ability to park close to your room. One evening we walked to the Hotel Cosmopolitan (30 minutes) passing Paris-Las Vegas, Planet Hollywood and Bellagio along the strip. The hotel staff was very accommodating, especially Shaun, the manager at check out. We would definitely come back here again.

reviews.title: Vegas hidden gem
reviews.text: Great valueVery clean 10 mins Walk to strip Very nice restaurants with GREAT prices Vegas hidden gem for sure The grounds landscaping is beautiful The pool and hottub are heated and open all year round

reviews.title: Best place to stay
reviews.text: There always clean and very affordable. The staff are very friendly and willing to help. If you plan on staying in Vegas I'd recommend staying here.

reviews.title: not a better place to stay.
reviews.text: for me...it truly is the best place to stay. location is killer. the rooms are huge. live music 7 nights a week. (no cover) name 1 hotel that provides a coffee maker (with coffee pods) a refrigerator, and a microwave.(ask for one, upon arrival) I can tell you ...none! the grounds are immaculate. the pools stay open til 10pm. the buildings are only 3 stories high mand with the rooms being so big, you have only 10 rooms per floor. the eats, are very good. and Cafe Bottega has thee ..best coffee! truly, you cannot go wrong choosing this establishment. it truly is a throwback to the way, Vegas used to be. treated like royalty....but without the ransom!

reviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTED
reviews.text: We arrived tired in the evening after a long day of travel.Check in was perfect and Noah was friendly and helpfulThe room assigned was removed from the parking areas so relatively quietWe retired early due to the travel and time difference w/o checking out the roomWe awoke to find that our coffee maker was broken, we next noticed the dead bolt doesn't work on our door, we also found out the vault was already locked and un-usable.We called for service before leaving the htel to report these things to front desk.She stated they would send someone out to fix these things while we were out exploring.  While speaking with the operator I asked where the complimentary water bottle was. She stated only (casino) VIPs were given complimentary water bottles. RME gasp.9 hours later after returning to the room we found NOTHING had been touched.It was dinner time and our show was to follow - on the way to the dnner we again reported these issues to the front desk . . . instead of making an effort to fix right away the assistance mgr on duty tried to accuse use of not reporting these things in a timely manner.  We were comped a 3rd of the over priced dinner in the hotel's restaurant which wasn't worth the 3rd let alone the full price.Overall, I'd recommend buyer beware at this hotel - not terrible but certainly DOES NOT meet expectations or norms for service and accomodation.

reviews.title: Unhappy this Vacation at the Tuscany
reviews.text: My husband and I have been staying at the Tuscany for more than 15 years. This was the first time we were disappointed in our stay. The rooms are always nicely furnished and clean. The pool is great and a good way to relax in the sun. We have been to the strip but rather enjoy just being at the Tuscany, The restaurants are good except the prices are rather high. I felt the air conditioning in the casino was way too high because I was freezing most of the time. I had a bad experience in the casino where someone stole my ticket from the machine for $88.17. I was treated like a criminal when I first had staff come to the slot machine when I said my ticket was gone. Eventually they checked cameras and found some woman cashed it out then walked out of the casino. I felt that they could have helped more or compensated me for my loss. I do have to say they were helpful when we checked in because I have cancer and they did give me a room one the first floor of the building we always stay in. I'm disappointed with our vacation at the Tuscany this year because I may not be able to make another year because of my health.

reviews.title: Great location and value, perfect for business travel
reviews.text: Great option within walking distance of the Venetian, Paris, Caesar's, the Sphere, BattleBots Arena, and the Atomic Museum. Room was large with a living area. Grounds and room clean. I stayed for a conference, so value, comfort, and quiet were my primary concerns. The rooms are in a completely separate building from the bar and casino, so sleep was good. Marilyn's Cafe also provided a solid diner breakfast.

reviews.title: Fun times.
reviews.text: Need those Tuscany coupons back. Need the pens back. Rooms look great. Property is always great. I will see ya'll again in the near future.

reviews.title: Nice hotel with competitive price
reviews.text: It is a very nice hotel overall and I would choose to stay again, but we were assigned to a far corner, which was a bit inconvenient, plus the room AC was noisy the first night, the vents were not working inside the bathroom/toilet room, and the broken picture frame was not cleaned up after room service.The temporary road construction made the stay a little bit challenging also when going to the strip or riding buses

reviews.title: Affordable Full Las Vegas Experience
reviews.text: Nice to be slightly off the busy strip but still very close at the same time. Very close to the Sphere and easy to navigate to and from

reviews.title: Relaxing, enjoyable and hope to return soon.
reviews.text: There is not much I can say when the service is excellent from walking in the door to leaving after the visit. Front desk went very well. The suite was perfect, clean and spacious. The Bodega smoothies were addictive and tasty. The staff at Marylands were very pleasant,  efficient and the food was tasty and a good value.

reviews.title: Overall wonderful place to stay. Made us feel welcomed and appreciated.
reviews.text: Such a wonderful property, exceptionally friendly staff, beautiful accommodations, Well priced dining options, located within long walking distance from many places, but with a rental car it was perfect.

reviews.title: For the cost  very clean and comfortable.
reviews.text: Reserved two days.Casino does not pay and I gambled more than I should have. Hotel and restaurants where outstanding very nice hospitality ended up staying four days and gambled elsewhere.

reviews.title: Better than expected. Loved my stay would stay again!
reviews.text: I would stay again. I loved the room (executive suite in building H by main pool and close to gym, lobby) and the resort. Beautiful trees, pools, setting. Off the beaten path. Easy walk to the Sphere.  Construction on strip a real pain - I avoided as much as possible. Plan time to enjoy the resort itself if you would like to just relax. I did & am so glad I did vs stress of navigating the strip! I enjoyed choose salad at Pub 365, panini at I think Bogetta? And the entertainment in the lounge bar area was really good! Clean, good service. They do need more bellman though to manage all the activity.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Fantastic gem just steps off the hussle & bussle of the strip. Large resort complex with many buildings.  Every room is huge and all furnishings are in Fantastic condition. Bars & restaurants have very affordable happy hour deals. Casino has low minimums.  All staff is very nice. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: SPHERE and RAIDERS Weekend Fun in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Tuscany is the perfect hotel and awesome location for ez walk to THE SPHERE and other casinos and a short Uber ride to RAIDERS game!! It is also perfect for a one and done casino hotel restaurant entertainment pool experience if you don’t want to leave the property.

reviews.title: Fabulous accommodations.
reviews.text: Best place in Vegas to stay. The grounds are beautiful and all of the employees are very helpful and kind.  We will stay at Tuscany Suites on every trip we take.

reviews.title: Exceptional staff. Lovely, clean hotel. Great location.
reviews.text: Beautiful grounds, perfect location, just far away enough to walk to the strip. Peaceful and relaxing. Exceptional staff. Room was very big and really clean. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Terrible experience, never again!!
reviews.text: Terrible experience.!! There for a softball tournament. Returned to hotel after playing all day and couldn't get into the room. Walked all the way down to front desk and learned water issue, had to move us to another building. went up to room to wait for somebody to let us in to retrieve our belongings and no one showed up for over a half hour sitting in hallway. Had to call again and finally again after 15 minutes a security guard showed up! Ask to use a cart for suitcases and refused, thus taking 2 trips to move to another building. Finally in new room and noticed window was not in its track with air running full bore, had to replace ourselves. Not way wanted to spend evening after playing ball all day !! The next day returned from playing ball all day and the TV was not working and was that way all evening!! Terrible experience and will never stay there again even though there every year !!

reviews.title: Overrated Value/40 minute Check-In/Long walk to room, no luggage rack
reviews.text: More than 40 minute wait to check in even with echeck.  $42 additional Resort Fee Hotels.com didn't mention.  No Microwaves, small lumpy Beds, carpet was wet.  Tuscany restaurants were to expensive and crowded.It was far from where we frequent in Silverado Ranch/Henderson+Downtown.No premium channels

reviews.title: Always a GREAT VALUE at the Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: I've stayed at the Tuscany Suites numerous occasions over the past several years.  Although they charge the "BS Las Vegas" resort fee, as does all of the other major Vegas hotels, I opine there is still tremendous value when staying at the Tuscany.  Parking is included in the resort fee unlike the Caesars and MGM properties (which have gotten just ridiculously out of control with their room rates and fees).   The Tuscany rooms are extremely spacious and reasonably well kept (could use a "refresh" in the future, but I can see that leading to increased room rates).   I also like being able to park right outside the building where my room is and also being able to go to my room without having navigate through a crowded casino.    Staff members are always friendly and helpful.  The casino floor is not large, but my wife enjoys the variety of slot machines they have (wish she could win rather than lose though...).  I've only eaten at PUB 365 and I find their food, drink selection, service and value are great.

reviews.title: Beautiful Property, Great Value, Just Short of Perfect
reviews.text: My son and I came from Colorado for the Raiders Monday Night Football game and stayed at the Tuscany on September 14 and 15. I will just say it up front: the Tuscany has ruined me for future hotel stays. From now on, I will probably judge every hotel by this one, whether it be cleanliness, décor, maintenance, the meticulous care of the grounds, or especially the value.The property exceeded my expectations. It is a beautiful and meticulously maintained place. Every morning I saw crews cleaning leaves, picking up debris, and keeping the grounds spotless. Inside was no different. No matter where you walked, someone was wiping windows, polishing door handles, or vacuuming. Considering the number of people passing through daily, it is pretty remarkable. I live a few minutes from the Broadmoor Hotel in Colorado Springs, and honestly, their standards do not seem as high as the Tuscany’s.Our two-double room was huge and absolutely spotless. I always test for dust on furniture, and there was not any. One half of my one-star deduction was the lack of a microwave in the room. This seems to be a trend, perhaps to encourage guests toward on-site dining, but it is very convenient to have the option to reheat leftovers, even from the hotel’s own restaurants. Microwave aside, I had zero complaints. The room was clean, spacious, and comfortable, and the shower had excellent water pressure. All in all, it was simply great.The restaurant food and value, especially compared to what you would pay just a couple of blocks down on the Strip, was excellent. We ate at Pub 365 twice and Marilyn’s Café once. Pub 365 had great food, and the late-night special was impressive for the price. Marilyn’s served me one of the better chicken fried steak meals I can recall, hearty, flavorful, and cooked just right.The only area where my experience did not quite match the high standard of the property was the service, which is the second half of my one-star deduction. At both Pub 365 and Marilyn’s, the three servers we had seemed a little stretched once food was delivered, even though the restaurants were not particularly busy. At Marilyn’s, our waitress was away for nearly 30 minutes, likely on break, and no one else stepped in to check on tables during that time. Service was never unkind, just not as attentive as I would have hoped. On the positive side, one woman at Marilyn’s, who I believe may have been a manager, was very friendly when we arrived and seemed to notice we had been waiting. When our waitress returned, she appeared to gently encourage her to stop by our table, which I really appreciated.Another moment that stood out was when I paid at Marilyn’s. I handed the woman at the register my ticket and a $50 bill, explained the leftover was for the tip, and that was the entire exchange. It was not rude, but there was no thank you or acknowledgment, and it felt a little impersonal.A similar theme came up at the front desk. When we arrived early, the man explained our room would not be ready for about five hours. That was perfectly fine since we were early, but there was no “Welcome to the Tuscany,” no small talk, and no offer to explain where we could leave our bags. Later in the day the staff member who checked us in was pleasant, but again there was no “Thank you,” “Enjoy your stay,” or “Please let us know if you need anything.”I do want to highlight the bell staff. The man who took our bags when we arrived was especially kind, warm, and friendly. Later in the day, when we picked them up, a different bellman helped us and he was also very kind and helpful. These two stood out as excellent examples, and it would be great if their personalities and warmth were reflected throughout more of the staff.That said, the property itself was outstanding. It is rare that a place truly meets my expectations for value, cleanliness, and attention to detail, but the Tuscany did both inside and out. Even the pool area was one of the best maintained I have ever seen. The pool was a perfect temperature, and the hot tub was actually hot, which in my experience is rare.Overall, the Tuscany delivers one of the best values I have ever experienced in a hotel. Clean, spacious, beautiful, and affordable. If every staff member showed a little more enthusiasm and they added microwaves to the rooms, this would easily be a five-star review.

reviews.title: Ambiance and the workers and security guards are always pleasant and caring. Everyone makes you feel you belong.
reviews.text: Ambiance and the workers and security guards are always pleasant and caring. Everyone makes you feel you belong.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our 4-night stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino. Our room was large and comfortable. The grounds of the hotel were well-maintained and the pool and hot tub were great. We enjoyed the Bodega for breakfasts and lunch and loved Bistecca for dinner (I'll write a separate review for that). The casino was bright and friendly and we LOVED the 5-dollar blackjack table (Shawn was our favorite dealer). The hotel is about a half mile from the Strip, but that's what makes it affordable. Great value! If we return to Vegas, we'll be sure to stay here again.

reviews.title: Top location
reviews.text: Perfect location for a visit to Las Vegas. Close to the strip, easy to reach.The hotel ells is a quiet hotel since thencasino and te rooms are not in the same building, Also nice swimmingpool and fitness center

reviews.title: Clean well maintained all over the Property.
reviews.text: Suites Rooms are very clean very. Employees are friendly. Property is maintain inside and out. If you book Tuscany website is higher rates. And if you order to go. Is a ridiculous 1$ per order. Overall I had lots of fun I would recommend Casino, Restaurants and suites rooms.

reviews.title: 1000/ 100 experience
reviews.text: 1000/10 experience .. excelent location and service ..  Ill definitely consider to stay there on my future vegas trips.

reviews.title: Our Vegas favorite
reviews.text: We stayed for the weekend. The room was remodeled with a new bed, new couches and are so roomy. Our favorite place to stay in Vegas. The employees are friendly from the players club to the gift shop to the resteraunts. Marilyns breakfast is so good. Bring you appetite as the portions are very big.

reviews.title: Expect to pay More for HOLD and Resort Fee
reviews.text: It's a pretty place. I was charged a resort fee when I arrived, and they put a $150.00 hold on your credit card. YOU have to use a major credit card and NOT a debit card!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: great hotel, perfect location just off the strip (15-20 min walk to Bellagio/Caesars). Good size rooms. Good bars etc. nice pool area . just really good value

reviews.title: Peaceful, elegant hotel with all the amenities you need, central location.
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, a place to retreat when you need a break from the Vegas scene. Quiet well-maintained grounds, lovely pools, friendly staff, good food, spacious well-appointed rooms. I'd recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Very good experience
reviews.text: The hotel is pretty nice, is clean, has a good coffee shop, mini market shop and restaurants, and its near the Strip, I recommend it.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites & Casino my go to place in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites & Casino is the perfect spot when visiting Las Vegas.  It is close enough to all the key spots yet far enough away to insure a quiet time when there for business or pleasure. Reasonably priced clean and spacious suites and excellent dining options.  Great pool area and the workout facility is top notch.  My go to place from now on in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites and Casino provide a comfortable stay full of amenities
reviews.text: My husband and I booked a short stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino. We chose the hotel based on excellent reviews and the proximity to the Sphere and "The Strip". The Tuscany is within walking distance for us to The Horseshoe (old Bally), the monorail and The Sphere; approximately 1 mile.We ate at two of the restaurants and the food was very good with a friendly wait staff.  The Casino has gaming tables, a Parlay desk and a good selection of slot machines. I would suggest the Casino increase the air filtration system because at times the cigarette smoke smell was heavy.The rest of the property and the rooms did not smell like smoke.Our room had a coffee maker and a mini fridge and sink. There were no dishes or utensils provided.We enjoyed our two night stay and would book here again.

reviews.title: Another great stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino
reviews.text: Tuscany is a great property and staff. Only place we stay since we found Tuscany. Great restaurants and great vibe in casino. Wife and I absolutely enjoy Tuscany.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: We stayed at Tuscany for one full week- from the end of August thru first week of September and had a great stay. The rooms were very clean, great size, and well appointed. We spent parts of 2 days by the pool and had great service both days. The casino had all of the games we look for and the walk to the strip was very manageable. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: The best family friendly option in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We spent an excellent week there, very good place in Las Vegas to go with the family, varied food and entertainment options, is about 20 minutes walking to the strip, very close to the dial, allowing you to have a proper rest and at the same time be close to everything, very good pool to spend the summer heat in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Relaxing and Comfortable!
reviews.text: Went to conference at Tuscany Suites, was so relaxing and comfortable,  We ended up staying an extra five days. Staff was helpful, rooms were clean, quiet, and roomy. Food and Bars, had great food, service and entertainment. Will stay at Tuscany Suites again, due to location, value, service and entertainment. Making for a wonderful trip!!

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: The suites advertise kitchen as usable but they refuse to provide ANY utensils, bowls, etc. Nothing. Walls are so thin you can hear people in rooms on all sides and even when the TV volumes are regulated you can hear the TV blaring all night long. The pool and hot tub and fitness center were nice.

reviews.title: The good and the bad.
reviews.text: The rooms and location is really great! Check in was slow and late. We couldn't get a room until close to 5 pm. Even with a reservation. The part I hated the most was the casino. It was really smokey, so if you have to do anything in the main building, dinning, conference, etc just know their ventilation is NOT good at all. It just smelled like the entire building was a big astray.

reviews.title: A great play to stay
reviews.text: Everything went well. Everything was clean inside and out. All Staff were helpful and Friendly. The Security employees were on point inside and out.

reviews.title: Good value in general
reviews.text: Nice enough!Nice pool area. Big rooms with kitchen,  however no utilities and no microwave,  which didn't make the kitchen very usefulVery loud AC in the room that disrupted my sleep. Maybe that's normal. I'm not used to having loud ACs from Europe. Got a turkey burger instead of a veggie one in the restaurant- the waiter told me he was 100% sure it was veggie but still double checked after I had eaten from it and turned out it was turkey. He didn't even apologize but told me- veggie and turkey look the same.

reviews.title: Beautiful Tuscany
reviews.text: Beautiful room. Very well maintained and comfortable. The check-in was a little long because there was a lot of people checking in for the conference.

reviews.title: Great value! All in one location
reviews.text: Great value for the money. I would stay here again! Everything is in this one location- good food and drinks, a little coffee bottega with great pastries and matcha/ coffee lattes at a decent price. Was surprised at the prices for the value I got for staying here.

reviews.title: This is the place to stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: This is a great place - BIG rooms and reasonable prices.  Good service.  Love this place and will definitely come back! We ate at Marilyn's twice, for breakfast and lunch, and the food was very good both times.  I like the fact that the rooms are so big and spacious.  They provided 2 complimentary bottles of water every day.  We had a great time!

reviews.title: All the Stars for Tuscany Suites and Casino!
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino is an excellent hotel in Las Vegas at an incredible price. It’s located just a few steps from the Strip, which allows you to enjoy the area while still having a peaceful place to rest. The rooms are very spacious, comfortable, and offer everything you need for a pleasant stay.What I value the most is their customer service, which is truly outstanding. During my stay, I was expecting a package that, due to shipping delays, didn’t arrive on time. The hotel staff took care of helping me and arranged for the package to be returned, a detail that very few hotels would handle, and it shows their real commitment to guests.Between the comfort of the rooms and the quality of the service, I have no doubt in giving them the highest rating. Definitely a hotel I will return to and one I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great staff and room
reviews.text: The housekeeping and front desk staff were superb, helpful, friendly.  The accommodation was very nice and clean with lots of space.

reviews.title: Tuscany is like being at home.
reviews.text: Tuscany is like going home to your family. Everyone is pleasant, helpful, and they make you feel like family.  It's a small but fun casino.  The rooms are everything and I've stayed on the strip at big hotels, but Tuscany rooms are everything.

reviews.title: Near; but adjacent to the circus....
reviews.text: Is the calm before the storm! Great rooms. Hyper clean. Safe. Beautiful grounds. Marilyns is fantastic...if you love to eat moms food!!!! OK, just about!!!Rat Pack is alive.  Pool fantastic. Ambiance. Tuscan, of course. We've been 10-year loyalists wanting to avoid the strip rip-off,  yes but  be close to the fountains!!!

reviews.title: Staying at Tuscany
reviews.text: The AC made a chirping sound throughout the night, and when I reported the issue to the front desk, the staff were rude and no action was taken during our stay.

reviews.title: Just like osmanthus wine.
reviews.text: This was my second time staying at Tuscany suites.  Just as pleasant as I last remembered.  Had such wonderful experiences both times that I will always book with Tuscany when I go to Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: We went to Vegas to go to the BSB concert at the Sphere.  The location is perfect.  We were able to walk home instead of getting an Uber which would have taken forever.  Our room was really nice.  It was very large, clean, didn't feel outdated at all.The people at the front desk were wonderful.  We got an early flight into Vegas and were able to checkin early which was great since we got a nap in before going to the concert.We had lunch before we checked in at Marilyn's Cafe.  The food was good and reasonable and really quick.I definitely plan to stay again when we come to Vegas.  And you should too, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.title: Aggressively Harassed by Security Returning to My Room – Profiling, Humiliation, and Management Retaliation
reviews.text: Aggressively Harassed by Security Returning to My Room – Profiling, Humiliation, and Management Retaliation

reviews.title: Great Value Stay Near the Strip
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by this hotel, it was more than I expected for the price we paid. The property was very clean, and the staff was attentive throughout our stay. Our room was spacious, with two full beds, a separate living area, and even a small kitchenette with a sink and mini fridge, which was a nice bonus.While the room could use some updates for a more modern look, it was comfortable and well-kept. If you’re someone who prioritizes comfort and value over luxury, this place is a great choice.The location is about a 10-minute walk from the Strip, which can feel a bit longer in the Vegas heat, but there are bus stops nearby and Uber rides to the Strip averaged around $8, making it very convenient.Overall, I’m very satisfied with my stay and would definitely consider staying here again.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful time at Tuscany Suites. It is very close to the Strip but without the commotion of the Strip, and it is a really good place to rest after a hard day.

reviews.title: Happiness at TUSCANY
reviews.text: I finally realized  ''accessable'  is the way to go for this old lady at 88.  Did I ever enjoy it   c203   and   later   D104  I think.  we came twice with family and also enjoy breakfast at the MARILYN cafe with an incredible waitress.  Missed her name unfortunately.    I have been at TUSCANY at least 6 or 8 times through the years and you just keep getting better.  We also ate at the PUB and enjoyed that twice.

reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: Always enjoy my stay at the Tuscany. Location is perfect, rates are always reasonable, cleanliness on point, very quite, overall very pleasant.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: It was a good experience. The hotel is nice, the only thing the ac in my room was noisy, but it was too hot in LV so i did not mind at all.... this is a great hotel. The room was super clean, everyone from the staff is nice.

reviews.title: Really really great.
reviews.text: Had a Really great time.  Only ptoblem (:  is that I don't want anyone else to find about this Jewel.   Only kidding.  This the best place I have ever stayed in Las Vegas and I have been coming to LV for over 40 years.

reviews.title: Oasis in Vegas.
reviews.text: What a great spot, its like an oasis in the middle of Vegas. Loved the staff the restaurants and the entertainment. Poolside is fantastic.

reviews.title: Local Gem
reviews.text: Local Gem conveniently located close to the Strip.  As a solo traveler, I felt safe. The pub & restaurants were very good!!

reviews.title: hotels in the centre
reviews.text: The hotel is just a few minutes walk from the main street of Las Vegas, convenient.Very spacious rooms. Inside the hotel there are several bars and restaurants. Recommended

reviews.title: Great little casino/hotel
reviews.text: Nice little self-contained casino with excellent pub for beer snobs like me.  Pool is pretty nice too, and not jammed like a strip hotel.  Rooms are clean and huge.  Ellis Island is right around the corner for more gambling and dining options, though that walk is pretty sketchy.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: The beds were extremely comfortable and the room was very clean and spacious. The shower head wasn't working well, it could be swapped out or have the limescale buildup removed. Besides that, the location was perfect. It is walking distance to the strip, and there was no loud guest keeping us awake. I loved the easiness of parking.

reviews.title: speed up check-in
reviews.text: I liked the hotel and the service, but when it came to checking in, it took many hours longer than they had said and we wanted to go out and explore, so we wasted time on that.

reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.text: My family has been to Tuscany Suites before to eat at Marilyn's. So it was a great surprise to us that that rest of the property upheld the high standards of Marilyn's. The rooms were spacious and well maintained. The staff was friendly and accommodating. The facilities were very nice and up to date. We availed ourselves of the valet and bell services. We were not disappointed. They both were spectacular. The only gripes we had is the WiFi is pretty non-existent on the property. Oh it is there, it just doesn't work well if at all.  Fortunately we had good phone reception there. The other thing is the valet was almost non-existent after 10pm although the hours stated it was available until midnight. Overall we will be back.

reviews.title: Happy Solo Traveler
reviews.text: 1st time at this location. I felt like I was at a resort in Florida with a casino. After a 10 min walk, you're on the Strip. Plenty of food options, very affordable. The room was excellent and spotless.  Pool and fitness center were perfect.  Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay!
reviews.text: Such an amazing place to stay! Rooms are amazingly maintained, and huge for the prices. Never a complaint from either me or my wife. This is always our go-to place to stay. The beds are super comfortable, and I love they have Keurig for the coffee, as I'm obsessed with coffee and need plenty of it throughout the day. The casino isn't super huge, but always has a wide variety of games to play, nonetheless. I also like that it's off-strip, but not too far off that you have to travel to get to the Strip. So location is perfect.

reviews.title: Good solution out of the chaos of the Strip
reviews.text: We chose this property to stay off the chaotic Strip, but at the same time reachable with a 15-minute walk.The hotel has a large car park from which you can directly access the various buildings, reception staff available.The room despite being a classic type was very spacious (even the bathroom), clean and equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay, fantastic beds and good soundproofing with the adjacent rooms.In the structure of course there is a Casino, bars, pizzerias and restaurants of all kinds and some shops.Recommended if you do not want to stay in the midst of confusion.

reviews.title: Low Accessibility Score, In Disrepair
reviews.text: The Tuscany is a hotel in disrepair. I went to an event that was hosted at the hotel and was highly disappointed with the quality of the suites themselves but also the “villa” buildings. My friend’s sink in her room’s kitchen area simply fell apart while being used— the faucet randomly just fell off, spraying water everywhere. Multiple people in our group had the AC in their rooms stop working. The elevator in our villa stopped working and there is no way to walk from one floor to another without exiting and re-entering the building. The hotel also has far too few accessible rooms and parking places available, and is laid out in a way that requires a lot of outdoor walking to get anywhere. This is a big problem in the full heat of Las Vegas in the summer, and I don’t recommend this hotel for anyone with a disability of heat sensitivity because of it. My heart rate would spike going from my room to the casino building where the restaurants and ballrooms are.Those services are also only okay. They certainly are nowhere near the quality of other similarly priced places to stay in the area.The Tuscany also advertises being near to The Sphere but it’s almost impossible to get there on foot. It’s “in a good location” but you can’t actually access almost anything from there without getting a car.The pool was the nicest feature of the hotel, but it had far too few chairs for the amount of people using it.

reviews.title: Great value stop
reviews.text: We stopped here for 1 night on the way back from the Grand Canyon. Huge room , coffee machine , fridge etc . The pool area was pleasant , comfy sun loungers . We stayed on the strip for 2 night at New York New York and this was a much better experience .

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites is Superb!
reviews.text: Great place if you like peace and quiet in the midst of the hustle and bustle of Vegas. It is close to everything while remaining cozy and peaceful. I do not like to stay in the major Vegas hotels because I feel claustrophobic (they are so big you can never find your way out), so Tuscany feels perfect for me and the quality of the rooms and services are outstanding.

reviews.title: Comfortable stay
reviews.text: Very good experience in the stay But many problems with the charges charged to the credit card until 20 days after you left the hotel did not make the correct charge

reviews.title: Quiet, family friendly, and cute.
reviews.text: Family friendly hotel, but pool is small and not heated. It's twenty minutes from the strip. The hotel is separated from the casino, which is great because you're away from the noise. The rooms are spacious, with a couch and small kitchen (doesn't include silverware or dinnerware).

reviews.title: Loved the Tuscany and will definitely be back
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Tuscany. The rooms were large and clean, it was more affordable and quiet than staying on the strip yet conveniently located. The pool, fitness center and spa were all great and we really enjoyed our massage with Norma. We had other family and friends staying on the property and it was easy to coordinate and find each other in the casino (not too big). The food options on site were great as well. We'll definitely be back on our next Vegas adventure.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service. Unfriendly staff
reviews.text: Save yourself trouble and book somewhere else because this hotel would give your room to someone else with no heads up and leave you stranded in the middle of the night.My wife and I booked this hotel for 2 nights. We called 4 hours in advance before arrival, but upon arrival they told us our Deluxe king non-smoking room was no longer available and the only room left is a smoking room that was barely cleaned up before given to us. I let them know that my wife is pregnant, and I would not risk her and the baby's health staying in a room full of smoke when we've booked a non-smoking room. We went back and forth between the room and the front desk to see if we can get any non-smoking room at 2 AM. Not only were the  staff unapologetic, their manager was extremely rude and told us that's how hotels work, and they would overbook and give the room to whoever show up first. They were also unwilling to find another hotels that they may do business or are simply friendly with to help their guest for their mistake. Again, if you are there for any event or concert, save yourself the headache and don't risk scrambling to find a place to sleep in the middle of the night because they do not care about their guests but only their money

reviews.title: My go-to in Vegas.
reviews.text: Very clean. Staff is wonderful. Free parking and I don't have to walk a mile to get to my room. Try the coffee shop. Great value!

reviews.title: Best kept secret
reviews.text: Best hotel in Vegas!  Budget friendly, extremely clean and roomy. Wonderful staff, easy parking. Great food!  I just booked another stay.  Love this hotel.

reviews.title: Lovely Suite, Quiet, Good Sleep
reviews.text: From check-in to checkout, it was a positive experience. I asked for a quiet room and the clerk was very accommodating. We were given a quiet room and were impressed with the kitchenette area with dining table. We had a wall thermostat to regulate the A/C which was wonderful. Exceptional suite with nice decor, clean, upscale furniture & furnishings. The bathroom was beautifully decorated and luxurious. Water pressure was excellent. TV & wifi were great. The mattress and pillows were firm, and we had a good night’s sleep. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Nice experience.
reviews.text: My wife and I had a nice experience.  We arrived very late after a delayed flight and got checked in quickly.  Our TV was small for such a large room but it was remodeled nicely.  I would stay there again.

reviews.title: Relaxing for those who are working not on vacation. Recommend
reviews.text: Always a great place to stay and can recommend to our clients also. Clean and friendly staff. Relaxing and no hassle for those there on business.

reviews.title: Needs some work
reviews.text: My spouse and I came for my birthday. Karina Blanco, the assistant manager was pretty short with us at check in. She never said please or thank you to us and talked at us. The shower didn’t have shampoo or soap and it took them two days to figure out how to fill it and the air conditioner sounded like a diesel truck starting. The room was otherwise nice and so was the house keeping staff. Saving grace is the slots were pretty loose and it was fun to be able to keep playing.

reviews.title: There's no place like our home away from home!
reviews.text: This hotel and casino continue to exceed expectations.  After almost 30 years of coming here, she's becoming a home away from home.   We just love to come, play, dine and relax here.  If we do go out, everything is nearby.

reviews.title: Large, clean rooms - hotel has everything you may need
reviews.text: Wonderful place to stay. Rooms were huge and everywhere was so clean! We were about a 15 minute walk to both the Strip and the Sphere. It was nice to be away from the craziness of the Strip. It was about a $25 Uber trip to the Fremont Experience. The hotel has everything you may need - don’t even need to leave if you don’t want to. Food and drinks at restaurants were good but be sure to check your bill for a “service” charge - the already added gratuity. Casino was large enough.

reviews.title: Tuscany for the win
reviews.text: Officially our new Vegas home base. Staff, amenities, location, casino,,,tough to beat, the whole package is covered at the Tuscany.

reviews.title: Love the Tuscany
reviews.text: Great  place to stay and convenient.  I stay each time I am working in LV.  The pillows have improved but they still fill with air and are awkward

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel to stay at!!
reviews.text: The size of the rooms and having a living area and kitchen area is so nice.   The beds are very comfortable. The grounds are beautiful also!!

reviews.title: Great Girls Trip
reviews.text: The staff was so friendly everywhere we went on this property. Book one of the cabana packages, it was very reasonable priced and worth it to guarantee some pool chairs in the sun AND shade all day.

reviews.title: Great stay, everything I needed and very quiet and chill.
reviews.text: Loved the room, service, amenities, restaurants, casino service, massage at the spa, pool. I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Best bang for your buck. What normal Vegas vistors should be looking for.
reviews.text: Love staying here whenever I'm in Vegas. Rooms are huge, food and drinks are good quality and affordable, while it can be busy with guests around the property its very managed and everyone is respectable no loud groups or children unattended running at your feet. Location is still close to everything. You could walk (Vegas blocks are enormous) Lyft and Uber can get you to your destination quickly and affordably.The pool is perfect and the staff is great.Beds and blackout curtains help you forget what time it is so you can just sleep in for as long as you would like.Again everything is affordable which is hard to find anywhere near the strip or Fremont. Definitely a place where you feel like you get some value for your dollar. Geared towards normal Vegas visitors that made Vegas what it was at it's peak. Casino is a decent size and you don't have to walk through it if you don't want to. Also they still have $5 dollar tables. Pub 365 has good food deals and 365 different beers so don't forget to check in and try a flight! Enjoy your time. I can't wait to be back.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Stay here always now. We had a timeshare just down the street and a half a block closer to the strip, but when we relinquished it, we began staying here. Only wish we had started sooner.

reviews.title: Favorite place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Nice quiet Property just far enough off the strip to avoid all the congestion, but close enough to walk to wherever you would like to go. Great pool area. I enjoy the Piazza lounge as well.

reviews.title: Appreciate the service your team always provides
reviews.text: Staff was great, we always love staying at your hotel.Needed a room last minute and you all made it easy for us to book and the stay was great.

reviews.title: good overall stay. i'd go back.
reviews.text: the rooms are very large which is great for a family of  to spread out. this made the stay worth it for us. the rooms could use a little freshening up. leaky shower covered up with a plastic bag, running toilet, that kind of thing. the hotel is a short uber to the strip but well worth it for the price.

reviews.title: No reason to stay anywhere else.
reviews.text: The Tuscany is our go to place to stay when visiting Las Vegas. This was our 3rd stay at the Tuscany in the last 18 months. We choose the Tuscany for many reasons. It’s clean throughout the resort. All the employees are friendly and helpful. The rooms are large and spacious. All the restaurants serve great food and drinks. The pool area is relaxing It’s a short walk to the strip. We’ve already booked for next February.

reviews.title: Overall it was nice.
reviews.text: Spent the night at the hotel.  The room was great, the pool was great, the casino is kind of small so I would of thought it would of paid better.

reviews.title: Tuscany where have you been all my life
reviews.text: The room was spacious, clean and very nice. The kitchenette was perfect. Just a great experience overall. The casino was not too big which made it feel intimate.

reviews.title: Great hotel.
reviews.text: Brilliant holiday atmosphere in spacious rooms and with friendly staff. The fitness studio offered many possibilities. It is very nice that the pool is directly adjacent.Overall it was a very pleasant stay.

reviews.title: If you smell perfume in your room, you got yourself visitor! 😁
reviews.text: This is the second time we visited the Tuscany. The room was very comfortable. Nicely decorated. We stayed in the H building that was right behind the pool area, but on the other side. Which I preferred because I didn’t have to hear all the music and people chatting down below. The layout of room was really nice compared to other places I’ve stayed at. It had this old classic Vegas feel to it. My only complaint was that the bathroom toilet fan was super loud.  I honestly don’t think it did much. Weirdest thing about this room was every time we walked through the door we smelled perfume. The smell was only on the inside side of the door. Not in the hallway. It smelled like old lady perfume. The smell would dissipate right after. It didn’t linger at all. It only appeared whenever we came back to the room. I read of  hotels that add a fragrance to their vent system, but there was no vent by the door and we didn’t have the room cleaned at all during our stay. When we checked out, I asked the front desk about fragrance in the ventilation system, she had no idea what I was talking about. I honestly think we were visited by a former visitor or occupant of the room. No weird paranormal activity. Just the smell of perfume. Would I stay here again? Absolutely!

reviews.title: Thought it was nice
reviews.text: Room was huge and clean with ample room to sit and stretch out. Bathroom was a decent size. AC worked nicely. Casino was a bit cozier which was nice, not too crazy with people. There were also a good amount of food options available. Service was friendly. Shampoo, conditioner, body soap and moisturizer smelled nice. Overall a good stay. I liked the cozier smaller Vegas resort feel.

reviews.title: Solid Value and Simple Comforts
reviews.text: Solid value, great location, and easy in-and-out for exploring the town. If you're into spirits, the lobby bar offers a remarkable variety--everything from cognacs to Amari--far more than you'd expect from your typical hotel bar. The rooms are huge and decently lit (except for the showers). Pro-tip: Ask housekeeping for a "flat pillow" unless you enjoy resting your head on an 8" cloud. (It's fluffy, but a bit too high for some). The Tuscany's four eateries offer a range of dining styles--diner, pub, cafe, and steakhouse. The patty melt at the diner ("Marilyn's") was one of best I've had--simple and perfect with freshly grilled onions and Swiss cheese.

reviews.title: Great staff made it all super easy and fun
reviews.text: Everything was terrific, but the warm welcome by every single person on staff who I encountered all week was unsurpassed by anywhere I have ever stayed! Awesome team - give them ALL a raise!Cheers, Michael Albuquerque NM USA

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem That Feels Like Home
reviews.text: As a former casino employee, I’ve seen the full spectrum of hospitality in Las Vegas, from flashy façades to lackluster follow-through. But Tuscany Suites genuinely surprised me. Tucked just steps off the Strip, it offers a level of care and charm you’d expect from a private resort, not a hotel in the heart of Vegas.I stayed during the BiggerVegas event, and my room was massive, clean, and comfortable, like a personal retreat after a day of poolside chats or late-night adventures. The space felt less like a hotel room and more like a peaceful suite I could actually live in for a while.What really set the tone, though, was the staff. Every person I encountered, from front desk to food service to housekeeping, was genuine, kind, and sincerely helpful. It's rare to see such consistent positive energy, and it made every interaction feel warm and personal. This is the kind of service culture that takes real leadership and team pride to build... and it shows.Now, let’s talk food:☕ Cafe Bottega became my go-to for a quick, delicious bite. Their coffee and sandwiches are better than most trendy cafés you’ll find in town.🍳 Marilyn’s Café delivered classic breakfast comfort with heart and generous portions.🥩 And Bistecca? Phenomenal. The atmosphere was intimate and inviting, and the meal, from appetizers to dessert, was unforgettable.The pool area was another standout: peaceful, uncrowded, and just what you need to decompress. It feels more spa-retreat than Strip chaos.If you're craving a real vacation vibe in Vegas, without sacrificing location, Tuscany Suites is a rare find. It’s the perfect blend of accessibility and serenity, with a staff that truly elevates your stay. I'll definitely be back, and if you're heading to Vegas for any event, this should be at the top of your list.

reviews.title: terrible reception service
reviews.text: The person who helped us at check-in was not interested in helping, despite asking us to accommodate us in a room near the pool due to a physical problem, it seems that he did not care and his response was to give us room M220, which made us walk excessively, he showed no empathy, the hotel is really very nice, I can't complain about anyone else, the cleaning people are always willing to help, but my entire experience was an excessive physical effort, thanks to the person who helped us when giving us the room, my overall rating would have been a 9, if they had accommodated us in a room closer to the lobby.

reviews.title: Disability issues are not being addressed at Tuscany Suites.  Shameful.  I won't be back.
reviews.text: Tuscany doesn't have any ADA-compliant rooms near the pool and main building.  I requested an accessible room when I booked the reservation several months prior.  I had to check out two days early due to an injury that wouldn't have happened if there were grab bars in the bathroom.

reviews.title: Highly recommend will be back
reviews.text: I had a pleasant stay at the Tuscany Hotel.The room was spotless and well-maintained, and the staff were friendly and always ready to help. The location is excellent just a short walk from the Vegas Strip. I also really enjoyed the pool, which was clean and relaxing.I highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back.

reviews.title: Business Meeting Stay
reviews.text: Overall, it was a good stay...business meeting This was my second stay, as i drove up i remembered staying there previously.

reviews.title: Top-notch hotel
reviews.text: Top of the top! Love it!Will come again 200%. The staff is very friendly and helpful, the room servese is great, the location-7min by foot from the Flamingo hotel.

reviews.title: We were made to feel we mattered.  Great staff.  Great food.  100% recommended.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Tuscany.  I found nothing to complain about.  The rooms and grounds were clean and meticulously maintained.  The staff was quick to engage if we looked uncertain about anything at all.  We were treated like we mattered.  Gotta love that.  And the restaurants are so good we often returned to the comfort of the hotel for meals.

reviews.title: Great Location, Competitive prices, Professional staff, Amazing rooms.
reviews.text: Very well located (15 minutes walk from the Las Vegas Strip), the Tuscany hotel offers fully equipped spacious suites in a beautiful environment with great pools and "go the extra mile" style staff services. On top of all this, the rates are more than competitive. My wife and myself come at that hotel since many years and have always been happy with everything it contains.

reviews.title: Great experience attending for a business conference
reviews.text: The rooms were HUGE! I was impressed that I saw a lot of security walking the venue (which helped me feel extra safe) and there were many service providers cleaning the lobby and common areas. It was spotless! Loved the pool, rooms, palm trees, everything.

reviews.title: Worst wifi and check-in process ANYWHERE
reviews.text: The rooms are huge suites and pretty nice and functional (though a little dated). HOWEVER, their wifi is basically unusable. So slow that we had to use the hotspot on our phones, and we ran out of high-speed hot spot data on our phone plans. That is unacceptable and for that alone we will never, ever stay at your hotel again, and if you need decent wifi, you’d be crazy to stay here.To boot, after waiting for over 1 hour in line to check in, they said their system was down and that I had to check in online. They said there was no other way to check in. They said they had emailed me the check-in link, but I didn’t receive the email. They tried sending it about 5 times over the next 30 minutes. At that point, I gave up and called Hotels.com to ask them to move us to another hotel, and Hotels.com called the Tuscany and after a long time they realized that their front desk people had a typo in the email address that I had just given them. It took me almost 2 hours to finally check in, which is unacceptable. Overall, a very disappointing stay.

reviews.title: Off strip value and less crowded
reviews.text: Great off strip option. Walkable to the strip and Linq promenade as well as the Sphere. There’s a 7 11 close by and a liquor store over the road.

reviews.title: Decent stay
reviews.text: Overall the suite worked well with the two rooms. The beds were comfy and the living area very nice. It was a noisy stay for us  with the upstairs families that were staying above us. Honestly, we will try a VRBO next time but did like the resort overall other than not getting a good nights sleep. The pool water is cold and the techno music was annoying but hey it was a hot week so we dealt with it. The layout of the resort is vey nice!

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointed.
reviews.text: •	Arrived June 20 around 3:30 p.m. – systems were down	•	Waited 2 hours, then told systems were still down	•	Offered a link to register manually, but had to do it myself to get room/key card	•	Mentioned I had a show that evening and needed time to prep	•	Sunday morning: security knocked, told to go to front desk and move due to building renovations (no prior notice)	•	No help offered with relocation – moved from Building J to Building H	•	Later that day, found carpet around AC unit completely soaked – wet my socks	•	Extremely disappointed – never stayed in a hotel with wet carpet like that	•	Front desk was unhelpful, rushed me, didn’t take concerns seriously	•	Still waiting for a call from the property manager

reviews.title: Accommodating for the most part
reviews.text: The facility is huge. Vegas is not anywhere I will ever go to again. Vulgar,stinky, nasty in every way ☹️. The Tuscany Sweets is a good place to stay but it would be a great place in any location other than Vegas

reviews.title: Not terrible but could use some love
reviews.text: Overall the hotel was fine. It seems to be on the older side and could use a refresh. The mattress and pillows were too hard, in my opinion. The location isn’t directly on the strip, but it is perfect if you’re going to The Sphere (which is why were there).

reviews.title: Great location but clearly needs to fix issues
reviews.text: We have grown to love the Tuscany for many years. But in the last 2 times we have stayed there are numerous issues that we feel are making us sway to try another place for our Vegas stay. The check in process is fairly easy, but we have been checked in by Sixto the last could times and its not a great experience. He's very rude, not friendly and has bad customer service. For sure doesn't make you feel like a valued customer or welcomed, which at check in is a bad way to start your stay.The grounds are always very well kept which we love. This time we experienced a bit of a hard time parking at they were doing maintenance on the whole parking lot which we weren't informed of at check in. Once the parking lot had opened up a few days later, while walking through it found numerous screws and nails which made it concerning to park/drive there. There are definitely things that need updating like pool towels and times around the pool, but for the most part its a very clean outdoor resort.They are trying to keep up the rooms the best they can but there are some things that need help as well. We always loved walking into the hallway and it smelling so clean, especially being in Vegas hotel then coming to this hotel to smell how clean it is was great. The last couple times though , that hasn't been the case. It has lost the clean smell which is upsetting. Our room this time was for sure "surfaced cleaned". There was noticeable trash, food and other stuff on the carpet. The curtain had a huge white smear of some sort that was disgusting. The fridge does not get cold at all. The items they leave for the coffee maker such as sugar, where already wet and stained ,clearly not replaced. The pillows are horrible, too fluffy where you cant even sleep with them. The bathroom was again surfaced cleaned which is gross and the most disgusting thing was the bathroom sink drain did not drain. You're brushing you teeth with a sink full of water and gunk and it takes a hour or so to drain. I had to do a full room cleaning for myself before we were able to unpack which sucks but it's a Vegas hotel and who knows what went on before us. So for some peace of mind I cleaned. Last time we stayed our door wouldn't latch at all so we had to wait 2 hours for maintenance to fix it.That's it in a nutshell. We again love the location and atmosphere that Tuscany has but we are going to try other places because there are quite a few issues and most of all we don't feel like valued/welcomed customers.

reviews.title: Found a gem in Tuscany Suites and Casino in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino was awesome!  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there.  Every staff member we encountered was friendly and accommodating.  They greet you as they walk by, even security.  The rooms are very large and spacious.  The food at the PUB 365 was excellent.  The only complaint I have are the pillows, they are not very soft.  The lay out was  also great, each building was like little villas.

reviews.title: Spacious Rooms
reviews.text: We did out annual tour of Vegas eateries and this hotel was the best place to stay at because of its spacious rooms. I highly recommend it!

reviews.title: Everything you want with none of the price gouging!
reviews.text: They have become our favorite place to stay! Done with the overpriced, mega resorts on the Strip that take all your energy just to get through the casino and up to your room. Rooms are clean and spacious and the staff is friendly. Located behind the Horseshoe Casino & Hotel it is a short 10 minute walk and you're at the center of the Strip, not to mention the pool is open from 7am-10pm! Beautiful, clean grounds and is now our go to spot!

reviews.title: Great all around stay and value!
reviews.text: Excellent all around. Would definitely go back!Nice rooms, great breakfast, friendly and helpful staff and casino crew!

reviews.title: Hidden fees
reviews.text: Hidden booking fees and hidden hotel resort fees. I was not told there would be additional booking fees on the Expedia website. The website said the fees you see are what you will pay but at the end of the booking when they charge your credit card you have to pay taxes and other fees. At the hotel is was never mentioned that an additional $47.62 in resort fees and resort taxes would be added to the cost of the room.

reviews.title: Great location in walking distance to strip
reviews.text: Great location and beds were comfortable. Room was fairly spacious too. Room service was excellent. Made sure we had clean towels and bedding everyday

reviews.title: Very happy to stay at the Tuscany had a pleasant stay
reviews.text: Repeat customers and planning on returning, the staff very attentive and responsive quality of the hotel is top notch offers good amenities to include 2  pools jacuzzi workout room and 3 different eateries

reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: Too many issues with room keys, AC noise,  Had change room, card keys not working properly. Shower not working unless hit the head hard. Just too many issues. Would not recommend.

reviews.title: Will come again!
reviews.text: Great hotel. Beds are fine!. Good Pool.  In walking distance of the strip. Nice staff. We stay for 4 nights. Will come again!

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: It was a good stay, we have been coming here for over 10 years. It feels safe and is in a convenient, quiet location off the strip.

reviews.title: Fun was had by all
reviews.text: I loved the location, within walking distance of everything! The rooms were clean, and spacious. Woo-hoo for the city that never sleeps.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: First time stay and was so pleasantly surprised at the quality and customer service. Very CLEAN... from the room to the restaurants to the lobby bathrooms. Stayed here for close proximity to the Sphere but would stay again when in town next time even if it wasn't for that. The room was so spacious, clean, one of the most comfortable hotel beds I've experienced, nice coffee in room. Good food options, really liked the café. I wasn't expecting much from this place, but was shocked in a good way of what a great place it was.

reviews.title: Recommended!
reviews.text: Very spacious room with fridge and coffee maker, good value for money. All the hotel staff very friendly. It is located within walking distance of the main boulevard. Free parking is available on site. The hotel has several bars and restaurants where you can eat or drink.

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel, clean,safe with a nice casino.
reviews.text: Other then the mix up with our room reservations we love this place and always stay here. We live 90 miles away near Laughlin NV with 8 casinos there but enjoy weekend get sways to Vegas. Rooms are always very clean and a nice size. A great value for the money. Parking is easy. We like the coffee shop with seating by the pool. You can find us there enjoying our morning coffee every morning we stay..

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Very comfortable and close to the strip. A little gem in Vegas. The rooms were big and comfortable, just missing a microwave. PUB365 had the best steak and eggs meal after 10pm. The pool was very nice and the grounds were kept clean.

reviews.title: It is imperative to pay attention to guest experience
reviews.text: LOVE HAVING COFFEE IN THE ROOM Room size is so welcoming It makes me feel like want to live there Room above us was extremely noisy at nite It was easy to regulate the temperature in the room I enjoy the makeup removers provided in the bathroom The lip for shower door was damaged on missing I nearly ripped my tgum nail backwards Then I tried using a washcloth the 2nd day Did not work I hurt my knuckle Altho reported no repair was made

reviews.title: Despite front office experience, one of the best vacations
reviews.text: During my recent stay, I had an uncomfortable experience at the front desk. When it was my turn to be helped, the clerk informed me that an "Anglo lady" would be assisted first, despite the fact that I had been waiting longer and it was clearly my turn. As a Native American guest, I felt dismissed and disrespected by this action. This interaction gave the impression of biased or discriminatory treatment, and it left me feeling unwelcome. I hope the hotel takes this feedback seriously and provides staff with training on cultural sensitivity and equitable service.

reviews.title: Terrible Experience – Poor Management and Misleading Booking Practices
reviews.text: Our recent stay at Tuscany Suites & Casino was deeply disappointing and frustrating. We were a group of nine, including senior citizens, and had specifically booked three non-smoking executive studio suites well in advance. Despite our confirmed reservations, we were told upon arrival that the hotel was overbooked for the weekend and the only rooms available were smoking rooms—completely unacceptable, especially with elderly travelers in our group.The problems began even earlier in the day when my cousin and her husband arrived before us. Though the booking was under my name, we added their names to the reservation in advance. Still, the hotel refused to accommodate them, leaving them stranded and without a room until we arrived late at night. Agoda, through whom we booked, tried to resolve the issue but ran into complications because the hotel somehow had our booking under Expedia instead. The lack of coordination and accountability between the property and these platforms was astounding.Communication at the property was virtually nonexistent—housekeeping and reception routinely ignored phone calls, forcing us to physically walk to the front desk for even basic requests like extra towels or toiletries. Despite booking rooms for three guests each, only one room had a proper sofa-cum-bed; the other two had standard sofas that were completely inadequate for sleeping.As compensation, we were offered a measly $20 per room to use at the property's restaurants—a single-use credit that did not come close to covering the inconvenience we faced. Frankly, a gesture like complimentary breakfast for the entire stay would have been far more appropriate and appreciated.While the reception staff were polite, it was clear they had no authority or resources to actually resolve any issues. I would like to recognize Jemini and Victoria for doing what they could, but even their efforts were hamstrung by poor management policies and systemic inefficiencies.This experience was a complete letdown from start to finish. We expected a relaxing and comfortable stay and instead got miscommunication, neglect, and poor service. I do not recommend Tuscany Suites & Casino, especially if you're traveling in a group or with family. There are far more reliable options in Las Vegas that actually honor bookings and value their guests.

reviews.title: Superior service and value within walking distance of the Strip!
reviews.text: Excellent value and service. Super clean and well stocked. Free parking and superb room service. It was nice and quiet and I liked that the secondary entrance was closed at night. Security presence was reassuring. Will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Returning guest. Relaxed, fun and great location
reviews.text: Large clean well appointed rooms, very comfortable bed and amenities. Love the location just off the strip but close enough ,it was no issue getting to attractions. Food and drink at the resort were convenient and fairly price. I always stay here.

reviews.title: One night on the road.
reviews.text: The rooms were spacious and clean. The two double beds were a bit smaller than we are used to, but we still slept great. Check-in was a breeze. Just don't take your luggage out of the car until you have your building letter and room number. There are many hotel-like buildings around the pool area, and it is easy to drive to a parking location close to the right building and room. Overall, we had a great stay.

reviews.title: Great place to stay when going to Sphere
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay at Tuscany Suites.  We attended Kenny Chesney at Sphere and it was a nice 18 minute walk which was much better than having to take a rideshare.  Casino was good and property was very nice.  Restaurants in the property were very good also.

reviews.title: Las Vegas May 2025
reviews.text: Been going to Las Vegas for 20 years and stayed at this hotel for 13 times. In the early days it was a little gem, however the last two trips we have gone in May and the hotel was turned over to the fans of the group called Dead and Company. If we had known about this we would have not booked in May. It's made our mind up that we will not be returning to this hotel in the future.

reviews.title: Nice suites but customer service needs improvement at front desk
reviews.text: This hotel is an off-strip hotel, about a 15 minute walk from it.It is an all suite hotel and the suites are pleasant, with a good sized and comfortable bed, reasonable size bathroom, a sitting area and very basic kitchenette (but that did not even provide any cutlery/crockery or proper drinking glasses. I'm not honestly sure what was the point of having it there as a result).I ate a few times in Marilyn's cafe and the food was good and plentiful , the menu varied and the staff helpful. There are three other eateries within the hotel all of which had good offerings. There is a nice pool with plenty of places to sit around it, and a good variety of live music on many eveningsThe main reason for my low review score is that most of the front desk staff were not at all friendly or particularly helpful on both occasions I stayed there.  On the second occasion, after I complained in the morning about my room being situated next to the water heater which rumbled incessantly all night meaning I did not get much sleep, the lady at the desk simply said I should have asked to change rooms.  Why would I want to change rooms in the middle of the night?  I did not know this was going to be a problem until the night.  In the morning I asked if they could offer any compensation, for example, a complimentary breakfast that morning, and, after consulting with her manager, this was refused.Very poor customer service in my view.

reviews.title: almost perfect
reviews.text: I found it a shame that in such a large room the beds were not wider (room with two double beds) .The hotel is very well located, a stone's throw from the strip, which is its advantage. It is also very clean and luxurious in my opinion.I would stay there again without any hesitation.

reviews.title: The Only Place Toi Stay When Dead and Company Play Sphere
reviews.text: Big room, nice free pool, and great experience overall. Really the only place to stay for the Dead and Company shows. Between the Shakedown, post and pre shows in Copa and Piazza, and the post show food options, I will be back when Dead and Company returns to the Sphere.

reviews.title: Everything was absolutely great !
reviews.text: The beds and pillows were all great, as was every other aspect of the Room. We enjoyed the Patio by the pool for relaxing and catching some sun. The firepit is a beautiful addition to the poolside. Everywhere we visited clean and neat. All personal were friendly and helpful. Already looking forward to our next trip to the Tuscany Suites Hotel and Casino.

reviews.title: Great location and amenities
reviews.text: Great location, amenities and staff. We stayed overnite for a show at The Sphere and the location was walkable to the venue, plus a plethora of restaurants in and around the area that you can walk to. Nice pool and grounds. The room was as big as advertised, bed super comfy and the place was spotless.

reviews.title: Chilled hotel!
reviews.text: It’s a great hotel with very easy access to your room from the car!Beds are super comfy and great to have a fridge to stock up on juices and fruit for the room!I would say I think the rooms could be decorated or painted just a little brighter as it can feel quite dark but overall the hotel is a little gem with good size rooms.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: My suite was clean and well stocked (towels, etc.)  I wanted a ground floor suite by the pool and I was told there were none available.  I booked my suite 2 and a half months before my stay, so I was suspicious when they told me the pool view ground floor wasn't available.  I've been staying there for over 10 years and all and all I love it!  I have recommended Tuscany Suites to over 30 people and after their stay, they thanked me and have gone back many times!  Scott Brown

reviews.title: A hotel that provides FREE parking AND smoking rooms...Yeaa!!
reviews.text: Liked the fact that parking is next to the building and is FREE, unlike other hotels that even charge guests for parking. Extremely happy that the Tuscany has smoking rooms available for smokers like myself.Nice clean, comfortable suite. Bed and pillows were just right for a good night's sleep.The only complaint I have is that the cocktail bar does not do a "Harvey Wallbanger" Apparently the bar does not stock one of the main ingredients - Galiano - and no one knows why.

reviews.title: Great Hotel!
reviews.text: Love everything about this hotel from cleanliness, service, and location.  Location is perfect, not quite in the middle of the strip chaos but close enough to the strip.  About 15 mins away from downtown. Only minor issue I had was trying to get the heater to go on.  AC/Heat unit could possibly be outdated...?  Other than that, everything is great! For sure, my place to stay!

reviews.title: Excellent service.  Not far off the strip.  In room coffee.
reviews.text: As an "older" adult, my friend and I found The Tuscany the perfect place to eat, drink, gamble, and sleep, away from the crowds on The Strip.  Their service in all departments is impeccable.  The rooms are spacious, and we LOVED having coffee in our room as opposed to standing in line somewhere on the strip for morning coffee.

reviews.title: A bad suite
reviews.text: We stayed in a suite and unfortunately had a terrible experience. The air conditioner leaked badly, soaking the carpet and leaving the entire room damp and musty. The smell was unbearable, especially with kids. Although a technician came to fix the issue, it was never properly resolved. To make matters worse, customer service was unhelpful and dismissive throughout our stay. This really ruined our trip, and we wouldn’t recommend staying here.

reviews.title: A home away from home
reviews.text: The Table games are too much money to stay and play and we love Roulette, so we have to go elsewhere.  The staff are helpful and the rooms are great for two or more and it feels like home away from home!  The grounds are kept clean and we always enjoy the nice clean pool/spa.

reviews.title: a hidden gem of a hotel.
reviews.text: well, I’m in two minds to write this.Let me explain,I’ve been coming to Las Vegas for over 20 years,I have written thousands of reviews truthfully reflecting hotels and restaurants.I’ve stayed in the best most expensive hotels and their best suites , so this leaves me with a dilemma , do I rate the Tuscany suites properly ? I’ve stayed before and rated it as good,well this time I have to be honest, and I hate to do this as I feel I am going to give away a Las Vegas secret.Anyway,I have to be honest,this is a hidden gem !, as I say I’ve been coming here for 20 odd  years,so this is how you should vacation.Hire a car,this hotel allows you to park…FREE!,Then, go to Walmart,this hotel gives you a full size fridge…FREE.It’s just off strip,but it’s a 10 min walk.The suites have been redecorated,the bathroom has been re tiled , it’s large clean and has an excellent power shower,a separate bath, a separate toilet.In room coffee machine,air conditioning is an older variant but it’s good,the rooms are very large,very clean and the beds are comfortable, it is raining here , my wife asked for an extra blanket, it arrived in minutes!.Now it also offers room service , it’s not 24 hours,but it’s a new experience in this hotel.I was so happy to be back playing blackjack with a human !,the last time I was here it was covid nonsense. The staff are really friendly,the upkeep on this property is seen everyday,painting and the maintenance staff are everywhere,it’s so clean !,the scent of flowers and the chirping birds takes you away from the strip,it’s so nice to see.The pool area has improved, new beds,but still very clean,with staff waiting on you,I am still here and indeed I have been so impressed I have extended my stay until Wednesday,I never do this, as it can get boring, but it’s priced very reasonably, the only downside I see is with me opening the Tuscany suites up to those who will see this review and I won’t get to keep this gem hidden any longer.I always tell the truth woth these reviews ,rarely do you get a bargain hotel with really good level amenities,the fact you can park,then just walk into your room from the street, without walking miles,then cutting through a casino,then waiting on a lift with others going up 40 floors will only mean something to seasoned vegas travellers,I cannot state enough how private these suites are!. I used to think that this hotel was second rate,I am so wrong,I genuinely can’t fault it, ty again for having the upgraded areas, and importantly, humans to play bj with !
