What a difference that makes.I will be using the m monroe cafe and the Bistecca restaurant, as I’ve heard very good things, I used the cafe before and the prices are very good, the Italian restaurant is more pricey ,but it’s very highly rated,so I look forward to forward to trying it out.I just wanted to write this review whilst still in the hotel, it’s that good! Congrats to the owners,this has become my favourite!

reviews.title: Noise is an issue, if that is a concern
reviews.text: Two major noise issues. Proximity to airport and noise from hall and above floors. Do not expect to get help with selecting a quieter room location in advance. It is pot luck on arrival only. Rooms are suites, but it is one large square room. You can see the door from the bed.

reviews.title: A great hotel, walking distance from the strip - Recommended
reviews.text: The hotel is a complex of buildings, like a village, featuring green lawn areas, a pool, and a large, fantastic fitness center. The room was nice, clean, and comfortable. It has a refrigerator, but no microwave oven. The bathroom features a bathtub, a separate shower, and a private restroom with its own door for added privacy. The bed was comfortable, and there was no issue with the room.The front desk staff was great. The location is next to the Tuscany casino, which you have to walk through to get to the restaurant, but it wasn't as smoky as I recalled from the past. The local restaurant was good (services, food, and prices)There's a local cafe and a gift shop with inflated prices, but they were all under one roof, which made staying easy.We walked to the strip, visited the other attractions on foot only, and worked in the room during business hours. The hotel provides a slow Wi-Fi connection, but we had our own equipment.One thing to remember: when you get the room, ensure it is not next to the elevator shaft. You will hear the elevator moving at all hours of the day. This was our room the first night. We requested to change rooms, and the request was fulfilled immediately without any issues.We were there from Monday to Friday, and there were not many people around or in the street. We were told the weekend is a zoo. will definitely revisit this hotel.

reviews.title: Nice room and place but bar should not have live bands playing loudly until past 3AM
reviews.text: The resort and casino should absolutely NOT allow bands to play in the bar near the check in area until 315AM in the morning. I was in building H by the pool and could clearly hear that music even with the doors and windows all closed. Other than that the rooms are nice and it is a good value.

reviews.title: Stay at Tuscany
reviews.text: Love Smoke Out great time . will be back next year and we always stay before we fly out .Bar service is great food service great 365 great onion rings. pillows in room were a little hard . please continue to host Smoke Out Tuscany does great job !!!1

reviews.title: My stay at the Tuscany.
reviews.text: Tuscany is a very nice place to stay. It's clean and well cared for.The room I had was excellent. Had a kitchenette with a fridge, coffee maker, table and chairs, a sofa and arm chair as well. A work desk if needed. It's a very lively place. My only issue was when I arrived my room wasn't quite ready. It was resolved promptly and was pleased with the results.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Great rooms and casino! Everything is super close and comfortable here. The food options are amazing. Also within walking distance of other local spots if you need other options. Honestly i don’t even touch the strip when i come here. Don’t need to

reviews.title: Best Stay Off the Strip
reviews.text: Best experience off the strip.   The location is really nice.  20 minute walk to the strip  or a $20 uber to Freemont Street (there were 7 of us).  The place is exceptionally clean.  The grounds were immaculate.  I can't give enough praise to the staff.  Not one bad encounter.  It has everything you need.

reviews.title: Total perfect with our budget
reviews.text: This hotel is brilliant for families with a car in the United States. Super lovely pool area where we ended up spending our vegas days. Family with 4 children had a great stay. Short for good food, easy parking. The rooms are huge and easily 6 people in 2 rooms. Definitely here I/we will stay the next time we get to Vegas. Thanks is just the word we said goodbye with.

reviews.title: Exceptional Service That Felt Like Home
reviews.text: I would like to highlight the excellent service we received from Andoni during our stay at the hotel. From the moment we arrived, he made us feel at home with his warm, kind, and professional attitude. He was always ready to assist with any questions or requests, making our experience even more enjoyable. His kindness and dedication truly made a difference in our stay. Without a doubt, his attention was one of the main reasons why our time at the hotel was so special. Thank you, Andoni, for making our visit an unforgettable experience!

reviews.title: Enjoy Tuscany.
reviews.text: Easy access and free parking. Recently I always staying Tuscany. Two nights or three nights reservation. Casino area is a small  but easy access any place. I love Marilyn Cafe and the coffee Bottega. Next time try bistecca restaurant.Very comfortable stay. I like.

reviews.title: Tuscany is the best!
reviews.text: Look no further. The Tuscany is the place to stay. This is my second stay at the Tuscany and I will be returning. I’ve recommended friends and family and have never had a complaint. The GM Grayson is the best. He was very accommodating and truly cared about making this trip memorable. Mission accomplished!! Well done to Grayson and the entire staff.

reviews.title: A Marvelous Experience
reviews.text: I had the best night's rest away from home!  Wonderful accommodations and location.  Well-groomed and kept property.  The ease of access to the gym and swimming pools and dining areas added to pleasantness of our experience.  We celebrated our 16th Anniversary and have wonderful memories as a result of the place and treatment received where we stayed.

reviews.title: Warm a comfortable feeling from check-in to check-out!
reviews.text: Most amazing relaxed feeling I’ve ever experienced in Vegas. Like a beautiful home away from home!  Really amazing the way the resort accommodated shakedown street and allowed this deep-rooted family a venue to reconnect with our tribe. We will never forget. Thank you!!

reviews.title: Great for Deadheads
reviews.text: Hotel went above and beyond to make all the Deadheads feel welcome and comfortable for the Dead & Company shows at the Sphere. Best place in Vegas to stay when seeing Dead & Company! Pool area is nice, bar is fun and the casino is fine if you want to do some gambling. A great time.

reviews.title: Nice stay downtown with parking
reviews.text: The hotel is a nice location near the strip but removed a few blocks which is nice and quiet with free parking. The rooms were very comfortable and large with a great shower. Check-in was a breeze too. My only challenge was an elevator that was slow/problematic.

reviews.title: avoid!!!
reviews.text: terrible, from smell to wet carpet, leaking faucets, broken toliet, keys not working....terrible. I would never stay here again. Called front desk to switch rooms, was first told no, but finally did switch, next room was no better. AVOID!

reviews.title: Great weekend at the Tuscany!
reviews.text: The Tuscany went all out to make our Sphere weekend of shows a true experience.  The room was spacious, clean and had everything we needed including a little refrigerator we could stock ourselves. We loved the music at Bistecca during brunch and the bands playing after our Sphere shows were great.

reviews.title: Another great stay
reviews.text: My second year of staying at the Tuscany for Dead & Co shows at the Sphere.   Management and staff are all very welcoming to the crowd and it certainly enhances the overall experience.   The rooms are spacious and very well maintained.  Cleanliness was above average.  And I really appreciate having a coffee maker and refrigerator.  The casino is small by strip standards but it serves the purpose well and the dealers and other staff are very laid back and friendly.  Drink service at the tables was excellent.Can't beat the location for a short walk to the Sphere.   I will certainly return again.

reviews.title: Great location and good price.
reviews.text: Hotel is clean and price is reasonable.  Rooms are very spacious with lounge sofa and desk.  Location is very near to the centre of the strip. There are good facilities as well.  However, double bed are rather small. So if you are larger in size, it would be a problem to share the bed.

reviews.title: Great Value!
reviews.text: Absolutely! Here’s the updated review with that detail included:⸻Review for Tuscany Suites & CasinoHad a great stay at Tuscany Suites! The hotel has a bit of a dated decor, but everything was very clean and well-maintained. The beds were on the smaller side, but still quite comfortable.The restaurants on-site were a pleasant surprise—delicious food at very reasonable prices. It’s also conveniently located just a short walk from the Strip, which made getting around easy without being in the middle of the chaos.The pool area was another plus—very clean, and we never had trouble finding available lounge chairs, which made relaxing super easy.We did have a minor issue with the toilet breaking, but maintenance came and fixed it right away—really responsive service.One of the highlights of our trip was catching The Rat Pack show in the Copa Room. The small, intimate theater made for a fantastic experience, and the show itself was incredible—definitely a must-see if you’re staying there.Overall, Tuscany Suites offers solid value, great food, a relaxing pool, and a few hidden gems that make it a strong choice for your Vegas stay.

reviews.title: It was a good time!
reviews.text: This hotel was decent overall. The room was clean and a reasonable size, though nothing exceptional. Staff were polite but could not help solving my reservation issue! The location was convenient, about 15 minutes from main attractions.

reviews.title: Staycation!!!
reviews.text: We loved our staycation. The comps are great!!  There is great music seven days a week in the lounge. If you get a chance have a jumbo martini while listening to the great music, they are wonderful! The suites are very roomy and the bed was comfortable. We will be back.

reviews.title: Resort fee
reviews.text: I can't understand that if I checked in at almost 1 AM they charged me the resort fee for the first night. I understand that I have to pay for the room but not for the resort fee. In other hotels they always waive this charge if we arrive after 12. I spoke to the front desk and they said they couldn't do anything about it.

reviews.title: Great hidden gem in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The property is within walking distance of the Las Vegas Strip. We utilized ride-sharing services on four occasions.  We found the on-site Marilyn's restaurant at the Tuscany Suites & Casino to offer convenient, high-quality meals at reasonable prices. We were unable to dine at Bistecca during our stay. Our guest room was spacious and well-maintained.  Customer Service staff was very friendly and helpful.  The Casino was clean and well-maintained.   We did not utilize the pool area due to the cool weather during our visit.

reviews.title: Avoid this hotel.
reviews.text: Terrible stay. 1.  Although booked months ago were stuck in a smoking room which reeked of nicotine   Told the fright staff to please move me into another room they said to come down the next day and it would happen. It did not happen.Absolutely revolting and disgusting 2. When you stay at this dive hole you must  prepay and it’s non refundable ( who does that in 2025) Advise to avoid this hotel if possible

reviews.title: Satisfied with our stay
reviews.text: The room is spacious and the front desk very helpful checking us in.  Location  is very convenient, next to a lot of shopping, dinning and entertainments.  Fully stocked amenities. We only stayed for 1 night and everything is awesome! Would stay again for the next trip.

reviews.title: Comfort and resort feel in a value property close to the strip.
reviews.text: I can't wait to stay here again. The staff were helpful and that helped me feel welcome. I appreciated the pool area so much in the evening. It was well taken care of and very comfortable. I liked the location because I was able to leave my car throughout my stay.  Food at the café was quick and delicious. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Go Elswhere
reviews.text: Don't stay here and think you'll get a room before 5pm. Check in starts at 3pm and can be up to 5pm. Wandered for hours starting at 11am, until my room was ready. Better places that are the same price. Go elsewhere for a better experience. Staff don't want to be bothered helping you either

reviews.title: Recommended but they need to make one of their buildings dog-friendly.
reviews.text: Excellent all around, even won some money in the casino.  Good room, decent price, good restaurants.  Set up like an apartment complex with multiple buildings… they should make one dog friendly, if they did that I would make this a destination stay with family, not just on my own for business as this stay was.

reviews.title: Hidden gem minutes away for the Vegas shrimp
reviews.text: You are not going to get more for your money anywhere else. The rooms are twice this size of anything on the strip,at a fraction of the cost. There are the food options in, and around the Tuscany. I also have a great spa on site, and a good workout in as well.

reviews.title: Overall good value for money for me.
reviews.text: Everything was fine and as expected with good value for money. My only issue was that there was noise from some of the appliances and also from the outside in the morning, probably the gardening team.The kitchen didnt have a microwave initially which is crucial for me because of medical reasons. I asked for one and got it very quickly but it was not in the best condition and a bit banged up and tilting forward. did the work.

reviews.title: Plan to book here again.
reviews.text: The casino is in a separate building so the air in the residences is fresh.  Its just 2 blocks East from the center of the Strip.  Property well monitored with actual security personal, not just cameras.  Marilyn's Cafe has to-go order desk so you can easily take the food to your room. One negative, no grab bars in the bathrooms to use.  Must be very careful.

reviews.title: Vegas Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Great hidden gem in Las Vegas. Perfect place to stay for Dead and Co at the sphere. Plenty of music, art, and fellowship if that is what you are looking for. Also, clean and quiet oasis in a large room with kitchenette. Quality food in the Pub and great little coffee shop with pastries and sandwiches.

reviews.title: Hidden gem off the strip
reviews.text: Wow…we were very pleased with our only one night stay. All of the staff were friendly and helpful. Will definitely stay here again. A hidden gem just 1000 feet from the strip. Bed was comfortable. Only complaint is that there was no utensils , plates of glassware provided with the kitchenette

reviews.title: Nice place, bad room service
reviews.text: It was extremely difficult to get room service on the phone, and once I finally did, the food was cold, served in cheap plastic clamshell containers with grooved bottoms, we had over-medium eggs, most of the yolk was spread across the bottom of the container, unretrievable due to the grooved bottom. There was not an option for real creamer, only the powdered crap. Also, the creamer offered was wrapped in packets with stuff we did not need, a huge waste, we only used the creamer and the rest went into the trash. I called to complain, could not get anyone on the phone so I left a message and my call was not returned. I was pretty upset by the lack of response.

reviews.title: Absolutely perfect place for Dead & Co shows at The Sphere
reviews.text: Spacious, clean room with excellent comfortable bedding.  Nice feature having the kitchenette, sofa, and desk.  Very large bathroom.  Pool and poolside bar with live music greatly enhanced our experience.  Excellent location for attending shows at The Sphere as it is only a 17 minute walk.

reviews.title: Good location, nice hotel for a few days in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: The rooms are very large, the bed was comfortable but I prefer a firmer mattress. The location is good (away from the noise on the strip) but within walking distance of the strip. There was a refrigerator but no microwave. Bathroom is large (separate shower and tub). Restaurants in the hotel are pretty good, less expensive than restaurants on the strip. I didn't use the pool but used the hot tub, which was nice after a long day of walking a lot.

reviews.title: Great Place To Stay!
reviews.text: Came to town for shows at the Sphere.  Cab ride was less than $10 Suites were much bigger than expected, Staff were eager to please and totally accommodating!  Coffee shop was open at 2am, Bistecha restaurant was amazing.  Great value for Las Vegas.  Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Such a nice place
reviews.text: Loved this hotel! Will be back in the future! It was like a little oasis that I didn't even know was there. I like the ground level rooms and the ease of getting where you want to go. I would highly recommend to anyone! Worth every penny to stay here.

reviews.title: Best value for your money in all of Vegas
reviews.text: The rooms are huge, the bed was super comfortable and the room was very clean.  I think this place is the best value for money in all of Vegas.   I will definetly be staying there again.  Its also a very quick walk to Sphere and the rest of the strip.  Best place to stay if you are going to see Dead and Company as Shakedown Street is there as well

reviews.title: Executive Suite
reviews.text: We were very impressed by the room at the Tuscany. It is off the strip and we were pleasantly surprised by how nice it was.  It was easy to check in and everyone we spoke to was very kind.  We also ate at Bistecca at the Shakedown brunch and the food was delicious, the service was great and the music was very nice. We really enjoyed our staycation!

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Vegas, especially if your going to the Sphere.
reviews.text: I've been back to the Tuscany 3 separate times and being a very picky clean-freak it's always went past my expectations. The front desk staff are always helpful, cheery and efficient. The rooms are spotless! I mean I'm never very comfortable away from home, but I sleep like a baby at the Tuscany. The rooms and bathrooms are just spotless. Room's are massive, beds are very comfortable, air conditioning, even in 120f are cool. WiFi is good. They don't charge you for putting your own things in the fridge like other tiny roomed places do in Vegas. Staff is as chill and nice as they can be. I would sit outside the  pool for hours just enjoying the people and area. Restaurants are good and well priced. I iwll be coming back in May, would never stay anywhere else.

reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Had the most amazing stay.  Hotel was fabulous and staff was kind and courteous. Rooms were A+ so clean huge and shower pressure was so strong.  Room service fast and tasty.  Even had gluten free bread options.  Can’t wait to stay again!  Room was amazingly priced.

reviews.title: Prefer Tuscany over Strip Hotels, better value overall! And quiet break from strip!
reviews.text: Stayed a few times, overall would stay again for the more calm pace than the strip (it's 2 blocks away from The Horseshoe and walking distance to the Sphere). It's older, but spacious room & bathroom with separate tub and shower. Kitchen area with mini fridge and K-cup style coffee machine with pods. Free parking. 2 pools, 2 hot tubs (main one and gym area one). 3 restaurant choices and 1 cafe/coffee shop Bottega, but we only ate at Marilyn's and Bottega (all day breakfast, large menu, better value portions and prices), and Bottega is coffee shop with paninis, salads, smoothies (can sit outside by pool here). Service at Marilyn's was either fantastic, or not. Many servers looked very unhappy and ignored us. Others were lovely. Bottega service was good, shout out to Michelle. The bathroom fan and A/C units are loud. Street noise in room was loud, but we asked for top floor with Sphere and Link view. Couldn't hear other rooms. Beds were firm, pillows were not the best but ok. Never used the casino. Cute gift shop. We enjoyed the smaller resort size here, lower price, and multiple buildings for rooms that were only 3 floors high so could take the stairs. Elevators were fine however. Will return considering the better value in Vegas!

reviews.title: Grateful Dead Fun!
reviews.text: I loved that he bars had incredible live bands Grateful Dead cover bands like Catfish John, all day & night & the Shakedown outside Parking lot with the bands &  Grateful Dead vendors was amazing too! That's what would make me return. Lots of cab service to the Sphere.

reviews.title: Above Average Stay!
reviews.text: Very good. Had some issues. Shower head and valve broke but were fixed in timely manner. We requested a microwave first day. We weren’t able to get till 3rd day. Staff for most part courteous and professional. Rooms are large, outside grounds very clean.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Would definitely stay here again. Off the strip but very close enough to walk to the strip. Beautiful grounds. Make sure your poolview though is not in front of the cabanas. They were amenable to crediting us for that since we paid extra for that and they didn't have another poolview room available. Three great restaurants on-site and nightly entertainment.

reviews.title: Would stay again and again
reviews.text: We have stayed here multiple times and it’s always great! Off the strip, clean, secure, and very convenient with free parking. The pools are well maintained, the coffee bar is convenient and well priced, and the happy hour martinis are awesome!

reviews.title: Great alternative to the big strip casinos
reviews.text: Excellent experience.  I will definitely stay here again.  Much better than the big strip casinos.  Wonderful service and very convenient.  The location is great close enough to the strip for easy access but just far enough away to avoid the crowds and congestion.

reviews.title: Extreme highs and lows with overall room and dining experiences.
reviews.text: First room we checked into wasn't ready... looked like cleaning crew left in the middle of cleaning (bed wasn't made, trash cans were out with no bags, toiletries hadn't been restocked). 2nd room we were moved to, the entire front of the AC unit had fallen off and was on the floor. We dined at Bistecca and the food was amazing but the service after we received our entrees was horrible and disrespectful so it ruined the dining experience.

reviews.title: Not good…
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for five days in March 2025. It's two blocks south of the strip, the hotel itself is very quiet, you can't hear any neighbors showering and there's no car traffic in block D where we stayed. What sucks, though, is that on the first day the fire alarm went off because workmen weren't doing something properly, so I had to get out of the shower and leave the building. On the second day, the water pump near the ice machine was so loud that we could only sleep with earplugs. Hearing protection is recommended anyway, the airport is close by and the planes fly late into the night. The cleanliness was very good, but the air conditioning is a disaster, very old and insanely loud. All in all, we would not stay here again.

reviews.title: Relaxing quick vacation looking for sun and hoping to avoid the drunk and young crowd
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere and clean pool without a throng of drunk 20 somethings you get on the strip. It is close, but just far enough away to avoid the crazy. I liked how you did not have to walk through a casino in your bathing suit to enjoy the pool. The size of the complex is much more enjoyable than the mega places on the strip. I'd like better room coffee- but coffee shop is open early and the price of a latte is the same as at home... as opposed to the big hotels on the strip where a Starbucks is in the teens.

reviews.title: Definitive Hotel for Dead Sphere shows..location great, festival atmosphere, positive vibes, big enough but not huge.
reviews.text: Definitive Hotel for Dead Sphere shows..location great, festival atmosphere, positive vibes, big enough but not huge.

reviews.title: Solo 4 day vacation
reviews.text: I love this hotel and stay there every time I go to Las Vegas. The rooms are suite size and clean. Marilyn’s restaurant has great affordable food. The drinks are good there too. Great service all the way through from the front desk to bar to restaurant

reviews.title: Many better places to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: We had a terrible time with the front desk at Tuscany. The clerks were rude and unhelpful. We requested to speak with the manager and was told no one was available. After numerous further requests a manager appeared wearing a mask. We told him our problem and his reply was completely muffled because of the mask he would not remove. Unbelievable. If you want to have a horrible Vegas vacation be sure to stay at Tuscany.

reviews.title: Elevator broken, old rooms, could LOUDLY hear every step taken in the room above us, bellman takes forever,
reviews.text: Elevator broken, old rooms, could LOUDLY hear every step taken in the room above us, bellman takes forever,

reviews.title: Beware! Lounge adds 22%to any purchase.
reviews.text: This is more informational , although it's probably an obvious thing to locals. I would like to bring awareness to the bar lounge in the lobby area. It's a great atmosphere but be aware that when ordering drinks they automatically add 22%!!!! to the total for gratuity.... In my case I didn't receive a receipt just told the total and with the crowd I just paid and tipped (I use cash) . On the second round I was told  total and paid again with cash tip and got a receipt. When I looked at the receipt later I noticed the disrespect and fleecing of the customer by the management policy. I am aware this policy is used in situations with large groups but didn't not know it was used when walking to the bar and getting three drinks.  Viva Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Hidden gem off strip
reviews.text: Hidden gem just a 15 minute walk to the strip. Location was fine and away from hustle bustle of Vegas. Sweet young lady works at check in. Restaurant (Steak/Italian) looked and smelled fabulous, wish I had one more night to test it. Heard great things about it. Hotel was clean and set up like a small campus, neatly landscaped. Room is spacious with table, desk and fridge. No frills but has exactly what is needed and clean. Walk between buildings was short and manicured greens are pretty. Coffee shop has large selection of drinks, snax and breakfast / lunch items.

reviews.title: Always beautiful!
reviews.text: We returned to this hotel after our first time in April 2017. Room H207, huge, spotless and with comfortable bed. Even the rest of the structure is kept in a manic way with maximum cleaning, paths with flowers everywhere, garden and pool really well cared for and clean. Friendly and helpful staff! All at a fair price, about $170 a night. Go there, although not located right on the Strip but about 500 meters.

reviews.title: One out of TEN REVIEW
reviews.text: Changed for the WORSE!  Fewer games that have no payoff. And the FOOD is not worth a review.    Have had good experiences for past 10-12 years but will not go back. No positive reason to return.  Room has been the same for past 10-12 years and  past three years the play and food has not been anything to talk positive about.  Marilyn’s is actually AWFUL!  So DISAPPOINTING.

reviews.title: Beware of cancelling
reviews.text: I have stayed here many times and always loved it. However had booked a upcoming trip here and person I am with didn’t think she could go.  Within minutes of cancelling I called and tried to reinstate, and they would not work with me.  I could rebook , but still will be charged for the cancelled room full price. I tried to reach out to a manager and was told to send email.  This was not even acknowledged one way or another.  Very poor customer service, as I was not lookin for a refund, just the room back.

reviews.title: Good for Tourists, Not Great for Meetings & Events
reviews.text: Property is beautiful, rooms are very large but unexceptional in terms of the decor and quality of the furnishings, and the location is outside the strip but only a mile away. Staff is very friendly and accommodating. However, if you're planning to host a meeting or event there, be prepared to have a frustrating experience in terms of responsiveness and accuracy of the information you receive.

reviews.title: Highly recommend. Great priceoff strip relaxed atmosphere. Lounge with nightly bands, restaurants, casino, 15 minute walk to Ven
reviews.text: Highly recommend. Great priceoff strip relaxed atmosphere. Lounge with nightly bands, restaurants, casino, 15 minute walk to Ven

reviews.title: Lovely Property/Great price
reviews.text: This is a lovely, well kept property at a great price. Within walking distance of the strip as well as other attractions, such as the Sphere. There are several restaurants on site with good food and some nice specials. The onsite casino is on the small side, but a nice, quiet reprieve from the bigger casinos on the strip.

reviews.title: Worth the stay for 4 nights!
reviews.text: Spacious, clean rooms with lots of space to spread out.10 minute walk to the strip, this really felt like an oasis just away from the mayhem and cattle herds .....Didn't have a chance to use the pool, but all other facilities were just a i had hoped for .....

reviews.title: do not check in to your room early
reviews.text: I drove to Vegas and arrived early, around 11:00 AM. Before heading to the hotel, I called the front desk at 10:30 AM to check if there were any available rooms for an early check-in. However, the woman on the phone refused to provide room availability and said I needed to speak to the front desk in person.When I arrived at the hotel, the front desk agent was able to expedite a room for me at 11:00 AM and mentioned it would be ready around 1:30 PM. In the meantime, I left the hotel and went to have lunch with my family.We returned around 1:30 PM, only to find out the room still wasn’t ready. The agent called housekeeping to rush the preparation for a second time. While waiting in the lobby for over an hour, I noticed other guests checking into their rooms.Around 2:30 PM, I spoke with the same front desk agent, who reminded me that the regular check-in time was 3:00 PM and promised to notify me once the room was ready. It wasn’t until 3:30 PM, after I approached the desk again, that I was informed the room was finally ready.I wish they had provided this information over the phone initially, so I wouldn’t have wasted the entire day waiting for my room.

reviews.title: Great first stay at Tuscany
reviews.text: The executive suite was so spacious, very clean and well maintained. I didn’t care much for the view of the room. AC was a little wonky sometimes but overall we were very comfortable with our stay. Coming back to a hotel like this was refreshing after the busy night life of the strip. The location itself was perfect for us as we were attending a concert at the Sphere. The sphere was about a 15-20min walk from the hotel. Walking to the strip was doable but Lyft/Uber was preferred because it was an easy pick-up/drop off process. I stayed on the strip before and getting a ride was chaotic. I will definitely recommend this place and would stay here again as the deal we got for a non-smoking room was great.

reviews.title: Comfy without the Hassle of Hotel Life!
reviews.text: Our family has stayed at Tuscany Suites for the last 15 years.  The suites are a great size.  The only drawback is the pool area; the pool is not big enough to accommodate patrons staying at the Hotel. Marilyn's Cafe has a great breakfast.  We'll be back in 2025!

reviews.title: Relax in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent resort, just a 10/15-minute walk from the Strip.Very peaceful and set in a relaxing environment, with truly spacious and well-maintained rooms.The resort is well-kept, and the staff is friendly and professional.Perfect for those looking for something quieter compared to the massive resorts on the Strip.I would gladly return!

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a hotel that’s near the strip, that treats their staff well,  and has everything you need in one place, You have it at the Tuscany. We have been staying there for 10 years and have never been disappointed. We love the lounge acts, The restaurants, and the slot machines, and especially the old school machines.

reviews.title: We love Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: We always enjoy staying there. It feels very civilized compared to the craziness of other hotels on the strip. The suites are very spacious and the employees always are friendly not trying to rush you. Check-in was a piece of cake. See you next time!

reviews.title: Tuscany is No Ka `Oi !
reviews.text: We love the intimate setting, from the arrangement of the rooms, to the casino and restaurants, and the lounge with live music. Parking is easy and available. We love Tuscany for over 10 years from the first time we discovered this jewel that is off the strip.

reviews.title: Vegas trip 2024
reviews.text: What a great find near the Las Vegas strip!  Quiet boutique-like hotel and we enjoyed our stay.  The food, the hotel room and amenities including the entertainment was very nice.  So many places also nearby the Tuscany too.  We will definitely come back when we visit Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Great off strip hotel.
reviews.text: Big room, well kept, and clean. Grounds are beautiful. Marylyn’s restaurant was very good and good value. 18 minute walk to Sphere. Only issue was we requested a microwave and after confirming they had one available and would bring it we never received it.

reviews.title: Why stay Anywhere Else.
reviews.text: This is our third consecutive year for staying at Tuscany.  Love  everything about it…location cleanliness spacious rooms very comfortable beds the fact there is a mini kitchen area with mini fridge however no microwave coffee in room good food coffee bar in resort. It has become our go to accommodation when in Vegas!

reviews.title: Grounds are the best.
reviews.text: The grounds are beautiful.   The mattresses are harder than a 2x2.  The pillows are flat and not comfortable.   Our bathroom light flickered, the shower dripped for hours after using.  The carpet is frayed.  The toilet ran.  There is a mini fridge, no microwave, limited tv channels.

reviews.title: No Pool View in Pool View Rooms
reviews.text: We were upgraded toa pool view room that hadno pool view. The cabanas around the pool obstruct the view. This was highly disappointing in addition to never receiveing the microwave we were promised. This was highly disappointing when they charged us for an upgrade.

reviews.title: Very Dissapointing Stay at the Tuscany
reviews.text: My room was broken into on my first day at the Tuscany. Multiple items were stolen, including cash. The issue was raised with the security desk, and I was assured that it would be reviewed within 48 hours. When I left the hotel 8 days later, they still had not addressed the theft, and instead gave me a new excuse and contact each time I checked in with the security team. Extremely disappointed with the lack of urgency or care on the part of the Tuscany team. If you stay here, do yourself a favor and leave your DO NOT DISTURB sign up at all times, use your safe, and do not leave anything valuable in your room.

reviews.title: Perfect Choice!!
reviews.text: Great place to stay off of the strip and yet easily walkable to the Sphere. Suites are large and spacious, plush and comfortable. Spotless! Nice furnishings, nice decor and good amenities. Reasonably priced! Pretty grounds with a gorgeous pool and patio.

reviews.title: Has gone down hill
reviews.text: We have stayed at this resort several times but this will likely be our last time. Service was not great, parking lot was over filled and we were not accommodated. We could not reach the front desk from our our. Our toilet was not working and our room was not ready upon check-in. It felt like we were in a motel-6 with Bellagio pricing. We were not pleased.

reviews.title: Spacious room but beware that bed sizes are King and Double
reviews.text: The rooms are spacious and wide so we did not feel cramped but could spread out. The beds are comfortable but we did not realize that the two beds in our room are only Doubles, not Queen size, so that was a bit uncomfortable. The bathroom looked very nice but the lighting wasn't very bright for putting on makeup. The separate shower enclosure had excellent shower pressure and wide range of temperature but the shower head was installed very high and its aim was not adjustable, so a shorter person like me was constantly being sprayed with water on the chest bouncing up onto my face with no where to move. It was nice to have a separate door for the toilet so someone else could use the sink.

reviews.title: Economical, Luxurious can get better
reviews.text: We landed up at Tuscany finding that Agoda giofed our booking and we do not have one. We could find an alternate room quickly and parked in in a large 700+ sft room.  Equipped with REfregerotor, Kithennete, Dining table and large bathrooms.  Its is Luxurious at a fraction price.It is walking distance from Bellagio and Horse shoe and the Sphere. 15 min on each sode so if you are ok to saunter a little just go for it.  They downside was that their ice machines were not working anywhere andf t get water to drink you need to go to the Restaurant as they found it difficult to fix water machines.  Sometimes hotels feel if you do not do something quaint, youa re not a hotel.  Hope they fix thisWe may have encountered bed bugs as i had a swollen skin above my temple in the morning. Despite may still peek in this place if I visit again.

reviews.title: Girls trip.
reviews.text: Conviently located near the airport. The only thing i would recommend is having shutte service since you are only several minutes away from the airport. I think shuttle service to and from wity a fee would be a nice added bonus for your guest.

reviews.title: Bed sheets were not very clean.
reviews.text: The location was perfect, close to the strip. I've stayed in this hotel a few times. This time I was not fully satisfied with the bed sheets. The first night there were pieces of short hair and the second night after getting back to the hotel and after the room was cleaned, the bed sheet had a dirt on it. Everything else was great otherwise.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: This is a hidden gem and I doubt we will stay on the Strip again. We went to the Venetian for dinner but the traffic problems caused by the forthcoming Grand Prix road closures and construction meant getting a taxi was a nightmare. We stayed local the next night and thoroughly enjoyed the music entertainment in the bar. This place is an oasis!

reviews.title: Never stay anywhere else.
reviews.text: Close enough to the strip if that's what you are after, but we rarely leave the Tuscany. There are enough activities and venues to satisfy most everyone. The lounges have great entertainment, Ashley Fuller is excellent.Even have free parking with close access to help out challenged walkers!

reviews.title: A nice hotel with a large room at a value price.
reviews.text: I chose Tuscany Suites because it was a much better price than the Venetian where I was attending a conference. I knew it would be a bit of a walk, and it took about 25-minutes between the hotels. (The walk was made a bit more inconvenient by the current detours due to the upcoming Formula 1 race.) Tuscany Suites is also close to a Starbucks and a few restaurants without having to go to the strip. The hotel registration staff was professional and efficient. The room was large, well-maintained, and clean. I was disappointed that the air conditioning unit was so loud and you can't have the fan on all the time (only when it's heating or cooling), so I was constantly turning the TV up and down as the AC cycled on and off. I could also hear the guest in the room above me walk around (when the AC was off), so the space between the floors is not adequately insulated for sound (either that, or the guy wheighed 350+ pounds). Other than those issues, I did not have any problems with my stay. I did not use the casino, so I have no feedback on that part of the property -- this review is only about the hotel.

reviews.title: enjoying my Vacation and Quality time with my wife...
reviews.text: This Place was Quiet and relaxing, and the area was secure and safe... the room was clean and comfort I really enjoyed with my wife, just at the end no microwave in the room but everything was fine, the repair of the parking lots everyone very organized the security, front desk and the house keeping with an excellent customer service.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Nice Hotel. Good food. Nice bar. Okay Casino.  Not to crowded in November. Fine rooms. Good food. Nice with all the green areas between the buildings. Walking distance to the strip and conference center. Only minus was that I could hear the floor from the upstairs neighbor.

reviews.title: Nice hotel for a reasonable price
reviews.text: The property was actually very nice!  Rooms were clean and large sized with room for our kids to hang. Restaurants were tasty, but no 24 hour dining or store option onsite. Casino still offered $5 minimum tables and friendly dealers at the tables.  Conveniently located close to the strip, without being in the middle of it. Rooms were spread out in 3 floor high buildings and grounds were well maintained.

reviews.title: Reasonable, comfortable and close to the Strip
reviews.text: We like to come to this off-strip resort for the quality of the rooms and the service, as well as the free parking, the value and the convenience to the strip. Rooms are comfortable, with small (not mini) refrigerator, beds are very comfortable, A/C is loud though. Housekeeping was good. The week of our stay there were a couple of days where they blocked off a part of the parking lot due to preparation for the Grand Prix race so we had to park rather far from our room. On previous stays we had no problems with parking close to our room. We like the dining options, and the gaming is relatively reasonable compared to the casinos on the strip.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: I’m a regular customer but most likely that will end now.  It’s convenient for walking to the Sphere and dinning at Lowry’s.  But,  the shower curtain fell down and cut my wife’s toe.  They put us back in building L, I asked for closer, there was none?  A rat ran across the pool area at night.  The bathroom fans are way too loud.  Lots of stomping in the room above us. Rates were the highest ever and the resort fee is a rip off.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem in Las Vegas – Tuscany Casino & Hotel
reviews.text: If you're looking for a Las Vegas getaway that offers a more intimate, relaxed vibe without sacrificing excitement or convenience, the Tuscany Casino & Hotel is the perfect choice. Nestled just off the beaten path on Flamingo Road, this delightful property combines old-world charm with modern comfort, making it one of the best-kept secrets in the city!The Hotel:From the moment I stepped into the lobby, I knew I had found something special. The hotel’s Mediterranean-inspired design, complete with beautiful arches, warm tile floors, and elegant furnishings, sets a peaceful tone. Check-in was smooth and the front desk staff was friendly and efficient, setting the tone for an easy, stress-free stay.The rooms are spacious, clean, and well-appointed. I stayed in a King Suite, which featured a comfortable bed, a cozy sitting area, and a well-stocked minibar. The bathroom was large and modern with all the amenities you'd expect, plus a great shower with plenty of water pressure. I especially appreciated the attention to detail – plush towels, quality toiletries, and a peaceful atmosphere that made unwinding after a busy day so much easier.

reviews.title: Best deal for those on a budget!
reviews.text: Best bang for your buck! Located not far from the strip (within walking distance, really) and quiet enough at night to get a good night's sleep. Beds and pillows left us feeling rested and the room was very spacious and clean. Loved that there was plenty to do without even leaving the property (coffee shops, restaurants, casinos, shops, etc.). My partner and I do not make a ton of money but coming here and staying here left our wallets feeling happy while not stressing about the cost! We would stay here again 100%.

reviews.title: This Place is Da Bomb!  5 STARS
reviews.text: Highly recommend!  Huge, clean, beautiful room -  Pub 365 BEST PLACE TO EAT (any meal) and hopefully you'll get Randall the bartender!!  Fish tacos, pub platter, breakfast burritto all fantastic...Pool looked fun too! Love Love Love Tuscany Suites!!!!

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites and Casino is truly a hidden gem just off the strip.  The entire resort is one of the cleanest we've seen, and the staff makes you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. The suites were spacious, the fitness center did its job, and the pool was refreshing. Most importantly, they have gluten free options at the cafe which was a surprise to my wife.  We will be returning soon!

reviews.title: Huge room
reviews.text: This was my second stay at the hotel, and it surpassed my first experience. I requested a room close to the main building because of my back issues, and the staff was very accommodating. The room was spacious and the bed incredibly comfortable. The staff was also friendly and helpful. My only minor complaint was an unpleasant smell in a hallway near the bathroom, but I easily avoided it by taking a different route to my room.

reviews.title: Good location for a good price.
reviews.text: Friendly employees, big room and a lot of green between the buildings.The buildings are not new, but the maintanance of the buildings is good.Only the beds are too small for sleeping with two people in one bed. Two queensize beds  should make our stay perfect. And one extra chair at the table, would be better, when four people stay in one room.And I think the floors/ceilings are made out of wood, because we could hear the people above our room, walking around in their room.We could not hear the neighbours on the same floor or below us.

reviews.title: Good choice off The Strip
reviews.text: I stayed here for a couple nights in October 2024. What's good:- Suites are large, comfortable, and generally quiet. - Staff are helpful and nice- Nice little casino- Dining options are limited but certainly sufficientWhat's not so good:- The walk to The Strip is not the most pleasant stroll you'll ever take- In my room I could hear the person above me whenever they walkedOverall it was a very good stay and I'd stay here again.

reviews.title: Great quiet secure Hotel stay.
reviews.text: Just finished our week stay at this vibrant property...excellent staff,clean rooms. We're repeat customers for 20 years. Love Tuscany Suites...close to everything, we walk most everywhere.  The Tuscany is geared to the 50+ clientele. Music from the it's plays throughout the resort. Beautiful grounds to stroke around. Lots of free parking.

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: I was very excited about staying at the Tuscany and it looked amazing and the promotion sounded wonderful however, as most things are, it was too good to be true. Once we arrived. Our room was completely in adequate. The suite was not at all a suite there was no microwave. There were no utensils no Body wash or liquids in the shower but worst of all is the air conditioner. Unit on the wall was broken and rattled nonstop and was extremely loud, we immediately called the front desk and were told that someone from maintenance would come up when we arrived back later that evening we don’t know if anyone had come or not and at some point during the middle of the night, the front of the unit fell off and crashed to the ground woke us up, scared us to death not to mention every time the unit would kick on. It was so loud it would wake us up. We got no sleep the first night. We also had an awful experience at the restaurant the steakhouse because we were sold a package and we thought we had a credit of $160 to use at the steakhouse however what we were given was a price fixed menu that we had to pay an up charge to get what we wanted and the food was awful. The service was non-existent we ended up not even being able to finish the steak and the fish that we paid extra for. It was very very disappointing and we would have never purchased that head. We known the first night. We got no sleep and had no food. It was absolutely awful. We went down to the front desk the second day and was told that it would be taken care of and they listened and said that we would be in touch with us and then we also were told that we would have a 20% discount off of our bar visits and none of that was applied. Everything was a bit and switch. I was so disappointed and not to mention the fact that I have told the story to at least five people managers included and not one person has ever gotten back to me. I also said please do not charge me until I can speak with somebody because I feel like we are overcharged and no one has ever gotten back to me and I was charged more than I thought that we should’ve been very very disappointed. We had planned on staying when we come back in January because we love the location we love to set up, but now after the way we were treated I am so frustrated that we will not be back unless this is taken care of.

reviews.title: Quiet location yet near busy Strip
reviews.text: Deliberately chose not to stay on the Strip for once, and that went well. No fuss to lose your car, no search for where the hotel reception is located in a mega large casino, but well-organized, atmospheric, and very large rooms that were exceptionally well cleaned. We were in a block in front and found the view of the Sphere very funny!

reviews.title: OK but a few Problems
reviews.text: Tuscany is spread out over quite a chunk of land. I was in building M and it was a LONG walk to the main building. Do know that this resort is spread over many buildings, not under one roof. The room safe did not work, I had to call someone to fix it. As I waited for the repairman, who was prompt and did a good job, a person burst into my room (glad I was there). The desk assigned her to my room in error. Not a good thing. And this necessitated another call to get new room keys since mine were then canceled by her. The soda machine (only on one floor) was empty the entire time. The room itself was plain but nice, lots of room, good bathroom shower, had a fridge in the main room. Noise factor was good, mostly quiet to sleep. A/C was fine, but old type in the wall and it was noisy. The checkout process was easy and smooth. Food onsite was good but limited to high end and the cafe which had no sandwiches, just burgers, limited other snacks at another food offshoot. Not easy to get a taxi. Not much outside right close at hand since off strip. I found the whole experience just OK.

reviews.title: Tuscany can't group groups together
reviews.text: Tuscany failed to group our group together.  We were scattered all over the property.  Happened in previous years so whomever is in control is incompetent or they just don't care.Happened in previous years so whomever is in control is incompetent or they just don't care.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: I have lost track now of the number of times I've stayed at this hotel because I've stayed there every time I have gone to Las Vegas.  I've stayed in other hotels on the Strip over the years, and we didn't like them as much we have liked as the Tuscany.  What I especially like about the Tuscany is its location.  It's just a short walk from the Strip, and is basically located behind Bally's (rebranded as the Horseshoe in December, 2022).  Normally, this hotel is on the quieter side, being away from the hectic Strip area.  I also like the garden landscaping and outdoor areas.  Outside of the hotel lobby area are a couple of fire pits that lend a cozy environment to the evening. The pool is a good-sized one, as is the hot tub.  Beautiful trees, shrubs, and flowers make me feel as if I am in a garden rather than in a large city like Las Vegas. The room we stay in is quite large--much larger than the Strip rooms I've stayed in--with a mini-kitchen, refrigerator, coffee maker, table and chairs, sofa with coffee table, large bathroom with both step-in shower and tub, and a king-sized bed. There is no microwave oven, for some reason. To make the experience even better is that we don't have to walk through a huge and crowded casino like in the Strip hotels to get to our room. There are three-story buildings from A-M, with the A, B buildings being closest to Flamingo Road, and the check-in building with casino and restaurants. For security, guests have to use a key card to enter the building where they are staying.  Almost everything we encountered on the property from the outdoors areas to the guest room was well maintained and seemed like first class. Dining is reasonably priced at the hotel's Marilyn's Cafe.  Portion sizes are very large and service is excellent.  Our efficient waiters Marcelo and Herman had a good sense of humor.  We ate breakfast there and had dinner there, also.  They offer specials of the day seven days of the week. We enjoyed the food they served there. I have just a couple of complaints. One is the bill, which was incorrectly detailed when I booked online.  The price that it said I still owed after paying a deposit was less than what my actual check-out bill was.  I approached the guy at the front desk and asked him about it, and he said the amount that I paid for deposit was correct. I just needed to check my credit card bill.  I think he was right, but I also pointed out to him that their online booking service needs to be corrected to reflect what a guest actually owes when checking out.  My second complaint was the elevator in the M building where we stayed.  We were on the third floor, and on our first day there we could not get the elevator to come to the third floor, even after pressing the 1 button multiple times.  We walked down to the second floor and saw the elevator just sitting there with an open door.  There was a child standing there, so I thought maybe he was playing with the elevator.  I reported this.  Yesterday, we got into the elevator on the first floor to go up to the third floor and the elevator would not move. We punched the button a few times and it didn't move.  I called the office, because there was no way to get to the third floor.  The stairways are set up so that they are only accessible for going downstairs during fire emergencies.  This is a bad setup, in my mind.  How can guests get to their upper-floor rooms when the elevator isn't working? While I was talking on the phone with the person at the front desk, the elevator suddenly began to work.  I mentioned this problem to the front desk guy when I was checking out, also. I am glad the elevator began to work, because we didn't feel like carrying our heavy suitcases down three flights of stairs. In spite of this glitch with the elevator this time, I will give the hotel a 5.  I know this was an unusual occurrence.

reviews.title: First Time LV
reviews.text: Got there late evening. Did the Pre check in ( recommemded & easy) got a requested room. Very spacious room, nice. Beds are soft and fluffy. Grounds are calm and serene.  AC worked great ( it was scorching hot in early oct) front desk ppl are pleasant, Eden is a doll. Loads of security personal, very safe!  Tuscany is a 10 min walk to central strip, not bad. My only complaint:  in the bavk parking lot, a current infrastructure project goin on,  small bulldozer woke me up at 4:30 am. Theyre breaking up concrete in back parking lot.  Front desk should do a better job of telling hotel guests. Im sure it will be much better when project is complete.PRO TIP: ASK for a inner courtyard view to avoid construction noise

reviews.title: You Will Love Staying At Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Tuscany Suites. I have stayed here 3 times now and still think it's great. I enjoy Tuscany because everything is on the property, there is fine dining, a casino and a wonderful pool areas to kick back and relax.

reviews.title: Van broken into
reviews.text: One night to visit relatives.  Over $2,000 of items were stolen from our van and there were no security cameras.  Hotel staff was less than helpful.  The LVPD were great, however.  Decent hotel otherwise but nothing special, including food.  AC in the room was super loud.  Getting a cocktail waitress in the casino was impossible. Probably better suited to a party crowd.

reviews.title: Good hotel in a great location with amazing staff
reviews.text: We enjoyed our time at Tuscany Suites.The location was peaceful and a ten minute walk from the strip. The food at Marilyn’s and Bar 365 was excellent and good value for money, as were the numerous beers on offer. The staff in 365 were so friendly, recognised us and even remembered which was our favourite beer. Thank you, especially the lovely lady from Chicago.The room was large and comfortable and cleaned regularly with good a/c.The only negative we had was that the main pool had music blaring out all day from ten in the morning, which was excessive and prevented us from using it. There was no way you could sit quietly and read a book. The hotel should rethink this in order to accommodate ALL their customers needs. We discovered too late that there was a lane swimming pool which we could have used also, however I don’t know if that had music as well. Perhaps this could be made clear to customers when they check-in.Overall a good hotel in a great location with great staff.

reviews.title: I’d like to come back.
reviews.text: Beautiful, welcoming, calm and relaxing hotel, close to the STRIP and the SPHERE.Too bad there are no dishes and microwave oven. Andthe slightly old furniture needs to be changed.But, I would probably stay at this hotel again. Thanks to the hotel staff.

reviews.title: Great holiday
reviews.text: Room was good ,beds very comfortable.|10 mins taxi from airport. |10 min walk to the strip. |Casino was good ...Would recommend  Tuscany Suites.   Very clean inside and out. Staff very friendly  ,nothing too much trouble Air con was very much needed.

reviews.title: Amazing Convention Experience at Tuscany
reviews.text: We were at Tuscany for a convention. Staff is very helpful. Rooms are spacious and comfortable.  Food at Marilyn's, Pub 365 and at catered events at the hotel was amazing.  Very tasty, reasonably priced, and lots of choices.  The convention rooms were right off the elevator, which was very convenient.

reviews.title: Wanted nice off the strip and we got it!
reviews.text: Always nice to stay in nice big suites.  King bed was way comfy. They must have been doing some maintenance on our floor because there wasn't an ice machine. no big deal. love the pool with all the big palm trees. Some expensive hotels have giant pools but not one palm tree. WT? Friendly staff, easy to get around, restaurants were ALL good. The Rat Pack show was great.

reviews.title: good base for Las Vegas
reviews.text: A great base for Las Vegas. Nice and close to the Strip. Just a minute or 5 walk to dive into the bustle of the city. The hotel is spread over several buildings.  It's a pretty big complex. The room was spacious, and quiet. The only downside to the room was the constant rumble of the air conditioning. Turning off was not an option, as the outside temp was well above 40c. If you have rented a car, you have no trouble parking it at this hotel. Furthermore, we thought it was a great hotel where you could spend the day at the pool, or take a chance in the own casino. Plenty of opportunities to eat and drink. Not cheap, but it's not cheap anywhere in Vegas.

reviews.title: HIGH ALERT AT THE TUSCANY?!
reviews.text: For those of you thinking of visiting The Tuscany Casino in Las Vegas, they are on high-alert for .   .     .  something.Talk about paranoia, I will relate my recent visit there:  On July 28, 2024, I entered the front door of the casino, where I was immediately confronted by security and treated like a criminal suspect (I had no prior history with security there).  They wanted to inspect my backpack for no good reason.  I was simply attending the coin show there so had valuable coins and personal items I didn't want 'inspected'.  I asked the guard if he also checked purses and he admitted "No".  I pointed out that whatever he was looking for could easily be hidden in a purse as well so it's pointless to check one and not the other.  I also pointed out that people are walking around with luggage and bags as well that aren't being examined.  The logic was too deep for him, so he stubbornly insisted.  So I finally said "Ok, I'll just go back to my car and empty my backpack and put the contents into my pants and jacket pockets (which they weren't checking btw) at my inconvenience.  When I returned, he then wanted to check my ID!  Why?  So I politely declined and left to find a direct entrance to the coin show where I wouldn't be subject to such treatment.  There was no separate entrance so I started walking to my car to leave.  Then 2 security guards started following me to my car so they could record my license plate and threatened to "trespass" me.  Really?  For what?  For going to my car?  For wanting to go to the coin show?  Keep in mind the following points:1.  At that casino I did not see them check any bags, boxes, luggage or purses, only backpacks as though those are the only devices that can hide anything bad.  That's just plain irrational discrimination.  If they did a complete body/baggage scan (like at the courts and airports), then I could see the utility, but this was just ridiculous harrassment.2.  Anybody with anything 'dangerous' could simply return to their car, and transfer that 'danger' to their jacket pocket and not be searched and achieve whatever nefarious crime they wanted to commit.  Problem solved.3.  No other casino I know engages in such paranoid activity and people enter and roam freely about with their bags, boxes, luggage, purses AND backpacks without incident.4.  I wrote to the Tuscany manager that week and so far haven't received an explanation, apology, or anything (which concedes my point and tells me a lot about their Public Relations).  Just a fair warning what to expect if you decide to visit their 'fun' gambling establishment.

reviews.title: Great hotel for families
reviews.text: Smaller hotels than the huge hotels on the Strip. I really appreciated the secluded location compared to the chaotic Strip and the possibility to park the car for free in the structure. The room was huge with two queen beds, just as big the bathroom with shower and tub. Furniture a bit dated but very comfortable room, with also a small kitchenette, table, chairs and sofa with armchair. I loved the pool, few people despite being a hot Saturday in August, very relaxing as well as the hot tub, operable until 22:00 (as opposed to the hotels on the strip that close the pools at 18:00). The distance from the Strip is not excessive, wanting feasible on foot, we used Uber.

reviews.title: Horrible Service and Maintenance, Clean Rooms
reviews.text: There was a hole in the floor that I almost tripped on in the middle of the night, how in the world was this room allowed to be sold? That alone was enough for me to never recommend this place. When we informed the front desk they basically just "oh no" and didn't do anything to compensate us or move us.  I felt the staff were useless in helping with any problems we had while there. The TV was set up awkwardly so we had to just watch our shows at max volume which I'm sure was very audible from the other rooms. We asked for extra pillows and blankets but those never arrived. In general everybody but housekeeping seems to be not great at their jobs if what we experienced was the norm at this location.

reviews.title: Best deal in Las Vegas and I'm a local
reviews.text: Large suite with coffee and refrigerator.  Couch and chair living room setting.  Dining table. Comfortable clean and very spacious. Great food and friendly knowledgeable staff. No resort fees and parking is free. Location is close to everything.

reviews.title: Clean and nice!
reviews.text: Great hotel, very large rooms with two beds, sofa and armchair, kitchen and bathroom with shower and bathtub. It has an outdoor swimming pool in the center of the hotel. Very distracting to find parking under your room block, I was in H block.Near the strip 20/5 minutes walk to get to the Belagio.Free parking!Very friendly staff! Recommendation!

reviews.title: No hot water
reviews.text: No hot water in room, could not take shower in morning.  Shady people staying in building, arguing in front of entrance door while smoking and had entrance door propped open.  Seems to be a timeshare or residence where people live.  No security checking the room areas.

reviews.title: Don't stay at the Tuscany MOTEL - it's not a hotel
reviews.text: Don’t stay at the Tuscany MOTEL and Casino unless you want a Reno type experience.We’ve been to Vegas dozens of times, and this is the worst property we’ve ever stayed at, the room was atrocious, broken creaking floors all night, constantly being woken up.  One morning, leaf blowers were running directly outside our window at 5 am.We called the morning of arrival saying we would be there @ 11 pm, when we arrived, the King Bed we had reserved was unavailable, at the Tuscany Motel it’s FIRST COME FIRST SERVE, it was like the Seinfeld episode at the car rental counter.  They didn’t even provide a comp drink to make us sleep in separate beds.We do prefer off-strip, but this is not a place I will ever advise anyone to stay at this Motel.  The pool area is fine, the steakhouse is very good, the casino is small and lower limits which suits many, just don’t stay overnight.There were many around the pool and bar that had the same experience and will never be back, don’t be fooled by the low price and the photos.

reviews.title: Good stay a little bit off the strip for a decent price
reviews.text: After some years we did stay again in this hotel and we had a great stay.It is located a little bit off the strip but still close by. The rooms are big and clean, the beds are comfy and you get a decent price.Will definitely stay here again when we are back in town.

reviews.title: Overall a Great Stay
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites & Casino is close to the strip, yet far enough away to be able to relax from the bustle and noise. Our pool view room was spacious and very clean.  The bathroom included both a tub and separate shower.  The tub was nice after walking around for hours on the strip.  The only draw-back (in my opinion) was the cigarette smoke.  While not in the lobby, the casino and outside eating and lounging areas were heavy with the odor.  Otherwise, a very nice stay.

reviews.title: Leaky tub, no hot water
reviews.text: No hot water in the shower, just the tub and sink, had to bade in the tub, not comfortable at all, tub was leaking the whole time we were there, reported this to the front desk, but it was like I never did

reviews.title: Room i301
reviews.text: Room was not ready on arrival, missing soap in shower , Faucet was broken.,only 1 bar of soap every day. At 3am garage truck noise, 4am receiving products noise, Overall rating should be 1 but everything besides the room was good

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text: The best off the strip hotel in Las Vegas! The staff was very friendly. The hotel rooms were really big. The grounds were very nice. The swimming pool hot tub was very beautiful! And the food there was lovely very delicious. Thank you, Tuscany and Swiz. We stayed there six days and we had a wonderful time. See you guys next year.

reviews.title: September 2024
reviews.text: Everything was good. This was my 6th time staying. This time I noticed that we did not have in-room microwaves. Which meant that we could no heat up any doggie bag containers that we brought back. Next time we stay we will get a cheap microwave from Walmart and abandon it when we leave :)  The parked lot perimeter was getting new curbs so it was all roped off. This made parking after sundown a REAL challenge. Final night of our stay we parked so far away that I couldn't find the car and thought it had gotten towed. But I would assume that the work will eventually get done.

reviews.title: Affordable Conference Location
reviews.text: This property would be considered ‘off-strip’ however not by much.  Rooms are in different 3-story buildings located around the property with the front desk, lounge (with evening live music), and restaurants available in the main building/entrance.  The suite rooms are newly renovated with a large sofa area.  HDTV was a little on the smaller side…  The premises are clean and well maintained.  There is a standard pool with good size cabanas located in the far corner.  We rented a cabana with the drink package which worked great and included good service.  There is a Starbucks within a couple blocks walking distance.  There is also a popular Karaoke bar – Ellis Island – within a 10-minute walking distance.  This property would be a good option for and location for conferences or high school reunions.

reviews.title: We love staying here.
reviews.text: Such a nice place to stay.  So calm and relaxing.  Love the grounds and pool.  Bestecca had fantastic food.  Marilyn's cafe is barely average.  The coffee shop is very convenient and good.  Great breakfast sandwiches.  Only big complaint was that the pool music stayed on til the wee hours of the morning and was disturbing.   Love the free entertainment in the bar too.

reviews.title: Wonderful Place to Stay
reviews.text: Tuscany was a beautiful place to stay.  The pool was great and the whole area was well maintained.  The food was delicious.

reviews.title: Best place to stay in LV, closs the the Strip
reviews.text: Great resort, 3 blocks from Strip right on Flamingo. 3 great restaurants on site, entertainment, great pool with wonderful bar service and HUGE rooms! Smaller, but still quite busy, Casino.Quiet location a few minute walk to all the noise and excitement of the Strip.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Excellent stay....was there for a conference for 5 nights and everything was 5 star from the pool servers to the check-in staff to the spacious guest suites....the food in all the restaurants and bars are excellent and great value....great location , centrally located just off the strip but an easy and quick walk to the strip and a safe walk at night

reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text: We were very pleased with this beautiful hotel. It was peaceful, the food and service was great and we really loved our large comfortable room.  Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Tuscany in Vegas
reviews.text: Large comfortable rooms with mini-fridge, couch, chair, table/chairs set. 2 beds plus pull-out and desk. Beds on softer side which I prefer. Super large bathroom. Very nice pool area and Caffe Bottega has excellent coffee drinks and great chicken panini. All staff very, very, polite and helpful. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Everything about this hotel is great! Mobile check-in was easy. Staff was super friendly. Rooms were huge exactly as advertised. we will definitely book here again and would recommend anyone do the same. 15-minute walk to the Sphere. Better than some 5 star rated hotels.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: Stayed one night. Hotel was close to airport which was easy to get to. Smaller casino but had nice restaurants and rooms.

reviews.title: vacation needed
reviews.text: had several issues with room but big issue was toilet had to be replaced, it took 3 men 3 hours of which we had to cancel our plans and lost our money. Housekeeping never cleaned the tub and we had to call them for shampoo and shower gel.

reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text: I've been staying here annually for many years for a conference but always extending my stay for several days.  The rooms are large, parking is excellent, restaurants serve decent food and Bistecca is particularly good.  It's a hidden gem.

reviews.title: Rooms and facilities excellent, gambling, not so much
reviews.text: Rooms: accommodations and cleanliness were exceptional.Property:  Pools and restaurants and services were all excellent.While the rooms and facilities were clean and excellent, and the return of the table games was welcome, the gambling experience was disappointing, especially the video poker. Not because of results, but because of the lower grade return (pay tables) on video poker.Once a great place at which to play, this is no longer the case. Video Poker Gambling at Tuscany is no longer practical for sustained play. This information has now become widespread common knowledge, on the websites, and more importantly, among customer discussions and feedbacks.

reviews.title: Don't eat at the Italian Restaurant Bistecca
reviews.text: Expensive prices for marginal food and the service is HORRIBLE. Even though we told multiple servers we were there for a show (in 1.5 hours) Took over an hour to get our food and some didn't arrive until later because "they dropped it", the manager comp'd the late dropped food but argued with me about any other accommodations. We normally stay there every 6-8 weeks but we've had other issues with the hotel (including giving me a key to a room someone else was already in and I walked in on them) so we've decided we won't be going back.

reviews.title: A Great Time
reviews.text: If you're looking for a great time...this is the place to be. The entire place is well maintained. The rooms and the beds are very comfortable. The casino has plenty to offer in gaming and pool /surrounding area is well kept. The restaurants and bar are a great value. We've been coming here for the past 6 years and have never been disappointed. This place is a refreshing change from staying on the strip. Come and enjoy!!!

reviews.title: Tuscany review
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 nights the first time. The rooms were so well equipped, with the very nice bedding and tv.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites has everything you need
reviews.text: Everything you need is here and included. They do not upsell by nickel and diming you for everything you use (WiFi, connectivity with apps, etc.). All included with parking that is also included and not a mile away from your room. Kitchenette allows you to stock your room w drinks and food. There is so much more but I’ll let you see for yourself. Location is great too!

reviews.title: Huge rooms
reviews.text: Rooms are very large, food at Marilyn’s was great and the price was nice. Pool service was amazing.I’d say the biggest downfall is, it’s a bit of walk to the Strip. About 15 to 20 minutes to Horseshoe/Paris

reviews.title: An Amazing place to stay!
reviews.text: We love this property! The size of the room, the friendly employees, the great pool area and the excellent food were amazing!! It’s also very quiet compared To staying on the strip, yeah it was only a five minute walk from this hotel to the strip. We will stay here every time we go to Vegas now!!

reviews.title: September 2024
reviews.text: Another great visit to The Tuscany. A superb option off strip. Just a 10 minute walk to the strip. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Once a year trip
reviews.text: If you occupy a room on the Bottom floors prepare to lose sleep, you hear everything happening above. Hard stomping and banging all through the night Hard to sleep unless you keep the tv on to drown out the sound. Other than that everything else was fine.

reviews.title: Worlds - 2024
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, great accommodations, great service.  Within actual walking distance from the Strip.  Will definitely return on my next trip.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: In town for the Eagles concert at the Sphere. Amazing btw. Room was clean and spacious. Service was great. Everyone we encountered was friendly. Would definitely recommend and will stay again if needed.

reviews.title: Never trust anybody
reviews.text: see other rating or my particular experience for my nasty check-in process.  The gal that checked me in tricked me and I didn't expect this type of treatment from Tuscany

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.text: What was liked · Off-center position with respect to the strip therefore quiet. In 10 minutes walk you will still reach the Strip/Flamigo rd intersection, the heart of the strip itself.What did not like · Soundproofing room. Customers upstairs hear walking and at night is a problem

reviews.title: Disgusting blocked and overflowing toilet, unhelpful staff
reviews.text: Blocked and overflowing toilet with sewerage. We stayed three nights at this hotel, broken up by an overnight stay at the Grand Canyon. Our first room was on the first floor with a view of a wall so very little natural light coming in. The fridge and safe were both broken. Our second room was on the third floor so lots of natural light, but when we arrived in our room there was a maintenance man in the room having just finished fixing the toilet. Not a good start we thought. The next day the toilet was blocked and awful, sewer water started overflowing to the floor. We blocked the water with towels and reported it to front desk who said they’ll lodge the job. When we checked later, they hadn’t lodged the job and the staff made us call maintenance to lodge it. We asked front desk if it would be fixed by the time we go back and they could not confirm yes, and said we could be given another room based on availability. I’d say having filthy sewer water flowing into your room is a considerable health risk but they did not care. When we returned the toilet had been fixed but nothing had been cleaned, dirty towels still on the floor and the toilet itself was disgusting. The lack of care from the staff was unbelievable. Will never stay here again and would advise others to find an alternate hotel. It’s also a 20 minute walk to the strip passing some pretty dodgy  individuals each time.

reviews.title: Happy, Clean, friedly,
