reviews.text: I went on this trip for work. But I also ended up enjoying myself very much as I always do when I visit the tuscany hotel and casino.

reviews.title: Quick Getaway
reviews.text: Overall happy with the resort - very clean. Only couple things to say:1) Fan in the bathroom very loud and since the light and fan work off one switch it has to be on.2) Server in the lounge on Tuesday night was very slow - ordered appetizers and delivered by another server, our server never came back to check on us to see if we had everything or needed anything.  We had to track her down for our bill.3) Server at the pool on Wednesday, we ordered drinks and took 30 minutes to get them, they were can drinks so not much to getting them.

reviews.title: Large quiet rooms well equipped
reviews.text: Large well equipped quiet roomsBeautiful swimming pools Close to the stripBeautiful green spacesIt changes buildings

reviews.title: I love Tuscany Suites, but service after hours for guests outside is nonexistent
reviews.text: I love Tuscany. I love that it's not a high rise and is off the strip. The room sizes are more than adequate and the maid service is top notch. The casino is a casino- the usual suspects of machines that you see in pretty much every casino in Vegas. My biggest issue is with the lack of service for guests who sit outside the pool area after hours and how early the lounge closes, pushing you to get a drink at 365 OR inside the casino where you might just drop a few pennies in a slot machine-it's too manipulative. If they would just have one cocktail waitress come outside and take drink orders, there'd be a little more revenue happening outside. Also, if you book, request building K or L but NOT J! While the rooms are all the same, the access to the side parking lot next to J (and near the casino) is a long walk and the wall against the parking lot forces you to either take the short staircase at either end of the walkway by building J. If they would cut a short staircase in between that long walkway, it would make accessing the parking lot OR your rooms better and easier for someone with limited mobility. All in all, a good experience, I've stayed at Tuscany for the last 4 visits and being a block or two from the strip really helps keep things quiet. Guests are usually older (35-60) so it's not loud or crazy-which I like. The food at Marilyn's is basic but good; the food at 365 is good but it's sports themed so the music or the television is always too loud for you to "chill" and the Botegga is my favorite place to catch a quick bite and a coffee. I haven't tried the steakhouse yet but hopefully will visit the next time I'm there.

reviews.title: Tuscany Paradise
reviews.text: Great resort.  Love that the pool is not always full and getting a chair is possible.  Great restaurants and spacious rooms.

reviews.title: Tuscany very nice.
reviews.text: Good hotel. Rooms very spacious and complete with every comfort. In the rooms there are two beds. Very large bathroom with shower and bathtub. The pool is clean , with a separate pool that makes bubbles. In the restaurants inside the hotel you eat well. The hotel is Near the center. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Non Accommodating Front Desk Person and Drilling at almost midnight
reviews.text: I asked to extend my stay by one day ( I was there for 5 nights) The front desk person did not even try to help as he said my current room was already booked.  When I asked if they could switch me, one day in advance of my departure, he said NO.  Check out of your room by 11 and book another stay and check in at 3:30.  My last night I was a little frustrated and decided just to head out early instead of staying another day.  That was fine until 11:30 at night when the maintenance people started working on the room across from me and started DRILLING!!!! They were working on the door at almost midnight. When I checked in everyone was polite and helpful once it was time to leave then I felt like they couldn't care less about my stay.  It's too bad because I think the hotel is really nice but this is the second time I had an issue.

reviews.title: Great stay at Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is a great location to stay in Las Vegas, closer to the strip.  Clean, big room.  I also noticed that the gardens are meticulously maintained using artificial grass, so is environment friendly, considering the drought in that area.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: First time staying at Tuscany Suites and Casino and was very happy overall. Will return on our next visit to LV

reviews.title: I wouldn’t come back to vegas to stay in Tuscany.
reviews.text: I did not enjoy my stay. I kept losing electricity, the TV kept going on and off, the coffee machine just didn’t work, the bathroom lights kept going on and off. I did not find the receptionists that helpful in this regard.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Very clean, quiet and good location. Big room has lots space. Room is insulated very well. Don't need turn the air condition on at night when outside temperature was 104. Service person are polite. Good swimming pools and gym.

reviews.title: A Wonderful Place
reviews.text: We cannot say enough positive about staying at the Tuscany! Poolside areas are wonderful, service out there was good, and the entire pool experience is just so relaxing.  Every restaurant inside provides excellent service and quality food and beverage. And the suites are so comfortable and absolutely beautiful.  We have been home for 4 days and already look forward to our next visit!!

reviews.title: Perfect spot away from the Strip
reviews.text: I really liked this location and would stay here again. The room was spacious and comfortable. For the price I was impressed. Just remember the extra $40/night resort fee. It's not in the initial price you pay when reserving.

reviews.title: Nice local place to stay with big suites
reviews.text: Overall the hotel suites are great and even have smoking rooms, food was good to very good at cafe, bartenders are on top of it but cocktail service on casino floor is a hit or miss.  Some are there to work, others not so much.

reviews.title: Easy time at Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: Our group meets regularly in early September at Tuscany Suites. Rooms are reasonably priced and the hotel has all the amenities we require.

reviews.title: Cleaned and well maintained
reviews.text: I really recommend Tuscany Hotel it very family friendly, Everything in the hotel is great, I wouldn’t change it for nothing.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very big room for a good price. Free parking. Just off of main part of Strip. I highly recommend the Tuscany Suites and Casino.

reviews.title: Another great stay!
reviews.text: This was our 2nd stay at Tuscany and enjoyed it once again. Friendly staff, clean, large rooms. A bit off strip but great place to stay.

reviews.title: Better than the strip!
reviews.text: Most comfortable bed ever!  I loved that it wasn’t a high rise on the crazy strip!  I loved all the trees.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: The place is near of Strip, clean and comfortable. The personal is very kind and profesional.The relationship between price and comfort is the best.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The hotel it self is amazing , clean , great location , we love the pool , the service .There's nothing negative that i can say !Is amazingly fantastic!.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Rooms are spacious,restaurants food was really good and well priced,bread pudding from pub365 and tiramisu from Marilyn’s are a must try.overall would stay here again very clean rooms

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: 1. I reserved two rooms in one order, one was using my name the other is my husband’s name, they said 3rd party doesn’t tell it’s from same order , so it’s hard to put it closer.2. After I requested it to be on the same building same floor, the elevator was broken.3. I reserved two king room + a sofa bed because we have 6 people, they said only the king bed is guaranteed not the sofa bed, I only got one sofa bed in one of the two rooms. And guy at front desk is very impatient and said there are people in line he can’t just rearrange my room??!4. Red mark on the pillow, I recorded it.5. One of the room key doesn’t work I have to walk to front desk to change it.6. No extra blanket and sheets for sofa bed in the room, I have to walk to front desk again to request it.7. Nobody answered front desk line from room. I have to walk to the front desk for any issue.

reviews.title: Relaxing haven from the busy strip.
reviews.text: Wuiet location yet handy to main strip & shows at Planet Hollywood. Room was clean & comfortable & great pool.

reviews.title: Lira Couple's Trip
reviews.text: Had a great time will definitely be back. Staff very friendly and attentive. Pool was very nice. The grounds were kept well and nice place to stroll around.

reviews.title: Great hotel, great staff - great value
reviews.text: Great place and perfect location with a short walking distance to the strip. Everything in order and spotless. Room very comfortable and clean. All staff from the Front Desk, Pool, Maintenance to Housekeeping was outstanding. Great value. I really enjoyed my stay. Strongly recommended.

reviews.title: Near to the Strip but some disadvantages
reviews.text: The rooms are large but the beds to small for two adults. Pool is not sufficient for the hotel capacity and water was to warm. Staff at Marilyn Cafe quite unfriendly. Location is near to the Strip but in the evening it is safer to use Taxi or Uber.

reviews.title: Our go-to hotel, but…
reviews.text: … they’ve done away with their $5 craps table.  What a shame. They now only have one $10 table, it doesn’t open until 7:00pm and every time we’ve wanted to play, they were only playing a half table and there was literally no one playing.  $5 tables are hard to find, unless you want to go downtown, but we always were so happy with  the table and dealers in the Tuscany casino.  On our last day in town, we decided to walk to Ellis Island, only five minutes away.  To our delight, at NOON there was a $5 virtual table and a $5 classic table.  Both were packed and the vibe was pure energy.  I said to my husband, “I’d like to bring management from the Tuscany over here right now to see this.”  We stayed there almost 5 hours shooting and had a great time.While we will continue to stay at the Tuscany (I mean, if for no other reason than for Pub 365 - thanks Jose!), our gambling days there are over.  It really is a shame.Other than a few issues with our room upon check in, (broken bathroom sink handle, sink stopper broken so I couldn’t use the sink, and a drawer from the dresser sitting on the floor - broken), it still wouldn’t deter me from booking here again.  The rooms are clean, great restaurants, very convenient location and the staff is very helpful.  Bring back $5 craps and I would up this review to 5 stars in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Business
reviews.text: I ha no ironing board. And no towels. And instead of the man that came to my room saying he wasn’t coming back he didnt come back and couldn’t get I touch with room service till the next morning.

reviews.title: Great staff, great time, great value
reviews.text: Not much else to say. Clean, and spacious rooms, friendly staff, good restaurants, close to lots of fun stuff, great pool.

reviews.title: Appreciated The Experience
reviews.text: Hotel was very nice, spacious, and clean . Lady that helped us at the front desk was very accommodating and I appreciated the early check in

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The only thing in room is the tv need to be bigger  and the air conditioner unit is pretty old and sometime it made some noise

reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites Service Staff from the Front Desk, Pool, Maintenance to Housekeeping was excellent.

reviews.title: Large, disjointed, slow
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Loved our stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Tuscany very much.   Would 100% recommend to anyone who is looking for a quiet, peaceful stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Best Bet
reviews.text: If you want to avoid the crowds and hustle/ bustle of Vegas; steps from the strip behind the Chromwell near the action center of the strip this is a great place to stay. Quiet, clean, spacious and sprawling resort describes the hotel. Wonderful, quiet pool area with foliage and cocktail server. It was a really nice relaxing retreat in LV. Plenty of secutity and nearly empty hotel lobby. No signs of casino action too for total relaxation. I will return for sure. Spa on premises too; booked up but available. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Needs severe maintenance and service is inferior now
reviews.text: I've stayed at the Tuscany probably 4 or 5 times before but this time I had several issues. On the plus side the rooms are very ample and the staff is great overall. However, the L201 room needs some serious maintenance. I reported not once or twice, but 4 times that the door was not properly working and that I had to use my card up to 10 times before I was able to unlock the room. The forth time I complained the maintenance person finally came to the room and basically said that the door worked, and that I had to try several times rotating the card key until it opens. WHAT? How is that acceptable?Also, the shower drain was clogged and the shower head was constantly leaking. I did not even bother reporting these last items because I was waiting for them to fix the door first. Which never happened.Service at Marilyn's cafe was very slow even when there were only a few tables occupied.Lastly, I've sent several emails trying to get a copy of my bill to no avail. They have not even replied back after several weeks.Again, this is a great place to stay but it does have some issues lately. I'd probably come back again, but they need to work on these details. Last year they addressed the maintenance issues quickly and they sent me a copy of my bill too, so not sure what happened this time, maybe it's a management issue?

reviews.title: Noisy AirCon and Poor Service
reviews.text: It's close to the strip. Good property and big rooms. However, the upkeep is a question. AirCon in the room is noisy as hell and quite difficult to sleep. In  Bathroom as well, the holder and other available rack items were loose and unusable. The exhaust fan in the bathroom is noisy as well and is attached to the light, so no way to turn it off. Check Out was painful as since morning they bang on the doors ensuring you leave the room asap.

reviews.title: Not Worth It
reviews.text: The bad way outweighs the good.  Most of the staff was helpful and friendly.  One night manager was terse and uncaring.  Location was good as far as convenient, but not great for safety or for people with disabilities.  While not required, there are no auto doors at entrances.  This means guests don't matter.  Some of the building doors are not ADA compliant.  Generally very quiet.  Not a busy hotel.  I didn't park, but I guess there was free parking.  Hot water in shower with good pressure.  Large bathroom (includes bathtub).Food at Marilyn's was 50/50.  Twice good, once bad.  Bistecca was excellent as was the service (kudos to Kevin).  Negatives:1.  Didn't care about guest safety.  Told them multiple times that the outside door to the building did not require a key in order to get in (all others did and only for people staying in that building at ALL times).  Gave me some BS story about they didn't want to have to keep giving out keys and said they could get in the building, but not into my room so....2.  I explained that the bottom lock in my room did not work...AND...so long as I was in my room I was safe?  What if I was coming in at midnight (which I did) or 1 am (which I did) and someone either followed me in or was already there.3.  Bed bugs. (see photo) (and I have bites all over me).4.  Refrigerator didn't work.5.  TV worked only intermittently.6.  Couldn't get anyone at front desk to answer the phone.7.  Drinks were incredibly expensive.  Asked for a cup of water at the bar and they wouldn't give it to me.  They said they only "sold bottled water."  In 108 degrees.8.  Lots of construction going on9.  Landscapers started working before 8 am.  I can understand they want to get done when it is cool but it is a distinct disadvantage for guests.10.  Cleaning crew was banging on the door early in the morning on checkout day (on a Sunday).  Ignoring them didn't help.11.  Not much in the way of a casino.The bugs and the lack of safety are more than enough for me not to go back.

reviews.title: Sphere
reviews.text: Excellent stay. Awesome rooms. Affordable meals and coffee. Service was outstanding.  Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Well-maintained property
reviews.text: Big, well-maintained rooms, nice pools.Hotel is in walkable distance to the Strip.Gym that is open 24/7.

reviews.title: Good Hotel
reviews.text: Off the beaten path.  close to the Sphere.  Walkable to other hotels.  Very  large and comfortable room.   A varied choice of reasonably priced eating options.  The swimming pool is the right size.  The bars also serve reasonably priced drinksThe staff is very friendly and helpful

reviews.title: We'll Be Back!
reviews.text: The Tuscany was a wonderful place to stay.  I think this will be our place to stay from now on. Thank you Tuscany!

reviews.title: Great Stay !!
reviews.text: What a great resort - had a fabulous stay and would definitely book again when I return to LV.  The room was huge, comfortable and CLEAN.  I enjoyed being able to walk over for coffee in the AM. The pool somehow felt cool even when it was 110 degrees outside. Pool service was outstanding, restaurant was good.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Hotel was nice check in was a joke beds are not soft very hard to sleep in room was clean pool was nice

reviews.title: smoke-free rooms set in different buildings from Casino
reviews.text: Like a suburban condo complex! Loved it.  Central building with casino, restaurants and pool, and then a bunch of 3-story buildings with hotel rooms scattered around parking lots. That layout kept my room quiet and smoke free.  About a 10 minute cab ride due West to Ceasar's Palace.  My 2-bed room + bathroom was huge!  Shower + separate tub; couch, loveseat, table, fridge.  About a 15 minute walk from the Sphere!  #deadforever.

reviews.title: Will stay again!
reviews.text: What a great place and a good location for The Sphere!  Super clean, well-maintained rooms. Perfect for the Dead & Co residency as they had Dead bands play at the bar and Copa Room. Pool and restaurants are very nice, with the exception of Pub 365, which is terribly loud and was understaffed. We finally had to go ask for our check after our table had been cleared and we sat there for 15 minutes waiting. I recommend otherwise!  I felt very fortunate that we picked this hotel!

reviews.title: Dead and Company stay over
reviews.text: The Tuscany hotel and Casino was the bomb. We had a grand pool side room with a beautiful patio. The suite was spectacular and had everything we needed. Thus place is so much better than staying on the Strip and you can still get everywhere you want to go. Five stars for sure.

reviews.title: Really Good Option for the Price!
reviews.text: This would be a great place to stay if you want the Vegas experience and not break the bank.  It is perfectly located near everything, but a fraction of the price.  Plus, it is a much more chill atmosphere, a locals feel, but still right in the middle of it all.

reviews.title: LV vacation and enjoyed a concert at the Sphere
reviews.text: Hotel was very convenient to the venue, the Sphere. The entertainment at Tuscany was first rate. The food at the main restaurant was excellent and everything I wanted was on site or very close by. Second stay at the Tuscany, really great friendly staff

reviews.title: Dead and Co at the Tuscany
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites was the perfect location for Dead Heads!!!  Talk about jumping on the bus and going for a ride.... they mastered it!  Management embraced the opportunity to cater to a group that most would turn away.  Room was huge, restaurants were reasonability priced and had a great selection of beer. Shakedown on site was amazing ... just wish the slots hit a little more!!!

reviews.title: Never disappointed !
reviews.text: third time we stay at Tuscany (6 nights). It is really one of the most comfortable hotel in LV. Rates are not expensive while the rooms are large and well equiped.

reviews.title: Oasis in the desert
reviews.text: We had an enjoyable stay at the Tuscany. Staff was friendly and welcoming from check in to check out. Clean and comfortable rooms. Beautiful pool area and good entertainment. Food in the restaurants was good and a reasonable price. A great experience! We will definitely return to the Tuscany. Thank you to the kind staff for making our stay a wonderful experience!

reviews.title: Great Location and spacious rooms
reviews.text: A fantastic value.   Our room had a dinette set, a living room area,  and two twin beds.  Very comfortable and home away from home for the three of us.   Front desk generously checked us in early, breakfast at Marylyns cafe was great, and the staff in the gift shop was very helpful.   We were in town for the Dead and Co show at the sphere and it was close enough to walk to though we took a cab since it was pretty hot out.   The hotel was very accommodating to the hordes of dead heads staying for the weekend.   There were several good Dead Cover bands in the bar throught out the weekend.   The casino is on the smaller side and is smoking though they seemed to keep it non smokey somehow so it didn't bother when it ususally does.  We look forward to staying here again the next time we need to be Vegas for a show

reviews.title: Not a Strip Hotel
reviews.text: I've been staying here for years. I like it but don't love it. Food quality has gone down, prices up. Housekeeping is very busy to the point it's hard to reach anyone on the phone. Long lines at front desk.That being said, it's perfectly adequate.Was not impressed with a $2 fee for picking up my drink at the bar as I was in my bathing suit. I thought i'd save the busy pool waitress a trip by getting my own drink but they penalize you for it.

reviews.title: Look no further!
reviews.text: Best managed property in Vegas. Stress free and easy on the pocket. Will always make this my go to in Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: My selection of Tuscany was strictly by price and proximity to The Sphere however I am sure I could not have been happier at any other hotel. The entire weekend was perfect. Every aspect of the hotel I encountered exceeded my expectations; online pre-check-in, checking in to pick up keys, cleanliness and size of room, lovely pool area, great band in the bar before & after the show, exceptionally good bartender, super-friendly staff and beautiful grounds. If I get back to Vegas I plan to stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel great location.  Bars and restaurants were excellent! Nice pool and rooms. Highly recomend this hotel. Would stay here again next time I'm in the area

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: The rooms are big.  Everything you need is nearby.  Walk to the Sphere for a show.  Short cab to the strip or dispensory.

reviews.title: July-August
reviews.text: Visiting Sphere for Dead and Company. Loved the entertainment at Copa Room, Piazza Lounge, and Shakedown Street. PLEASE have us back next year. I have already recommended you to several of my friends. Also appreciated the Shakedown Shuttle presence at the Casino entrance. Driver Michelle was very helpful.

reviews.title: Las Vegas stay @ The Tuscany
reviews.text: Very good experience would do it again. My room was very comfortable, hotel was clean and staff was friendly.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: We loved to stay here. Rooms are big, location was perfect for us. Not to far to the strip. Beds were a little bit small for 2 persons and the airco makes a lot of noice.

reviews.title: Dead and Co guest
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. Being near the Sphere for the show, going to Shakedown St, listening to the cover bands and being with the tribe was great. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay again.

reviews.title: Great off strip location
reviews.text: This was my first time staying at an off strip hotel/casino. What a pleasant change. We stayed to attend a concert at the sphere. The entire hotel was pretty much full of fans of the particular band. They welcomed our group and treated everybody great there was pre-concert and post concert music in the lounges although the casino/hotel is rather small. It provided everything we needed. The rooms were spectacularly, clean and well appointed. Parking was free and very simple to park very close to your room. There were stores and restaurants within walking distance and the Uber ride to the venue was very short. I would definitely recommend this property and it is likely my go to spot from here forward .

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: A great place to stay. We wanted to celebrate our 20th anniversary and couldn't have pick a better place

reviews.title: So much better than expected - hidden gem for sure.
reviews.text: I’ve been to the casino a bunch of times but never stayed in the hotel before and I will not make that mistake again. The rooms are fantastic, the staff is lovely, the gym and pool were great and every meal was delicious. This is truly a hidden gem in Sin City and I will definitely go back again.

reviews.title: Weekend getaway
reviews.text: Front desk personel very pleasant,accomodating,rooms very clean.Casino floor very nice,not over crowded. Cocktail waitresses,very nice and quick with the drinks

reviews.title: Best place to stay while in Vegas!
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Tuscany! Friendly staff, clean suite, great atmosphere! Super relaxing! We will definitely be back!!!

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Lovely, spacious suite. Pool was clean and never overpopulated.Entertainment was nice tooFelt in security.All staff were helpful and polite

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel, close to strip
reviews.text: The rooms are nice, clean and huge with Sofa, kitchenette and extra dining table. Pool ist fine. The Resort was quiet and close to Strip (25 min). Bathroom was also great.A Microwave would be a nice add-on, fridge is in the room.

reviews.title: Great place off the strip
reviews.text: Wow! First visit to Las Vegas where we didn't stay on the strip. WOW! This place was amazing! Not the glitz of the strip, but just down to earth nice. The staff was incredible, the property was clean, and the grounds felt safe. The rooms were very large, and undated. Beds were incredible, definitely worth the coming too.

reviews.title: Look forward to staying here every year
reviews.text: My husband and I have been going to the Tuscany for over 18 years. We love the atmosphere and always enjoy ourselves. The rooms are nice and we always get our request to stay in a particular building. The restaurants are good.  We enjoy the pool and gaming which adds to a fun vacation.

reviews.title: A week at Tuscany
reviews.text: A great place to stay with amazingly helpful and friendly staff . The rooms were very clean spacious and comfortable.  Great pool and restaurant

reviews.title: Safety, lockouts, and handicapped guests stranded
reviews.text: We like this property, but they had some serious safety issues this last visit.  If they resolve them, then the place is a gem. However, the safety of my family members outweighs any other positives.  The elevator went out and the doors to the staircases were locked.  My Mom was stranded on the second floor in a handicapped accessible room.  I could not get back to her. The issues was reported and not attended to for the next Hour we waited for help.  Other guests and I got our family members out of the building.  Thank goodness for the kindness of strangers.

reviews.title: Nice and fun place to stay
reviews.text: Spacious room. Family and parking friendly. Offstrip but in walking distane to Ceasar and fountain, sphere...

reviews.title: Excellent stay, Will be back
reviews.text: We stayed here because it was close to our event we were attending. Our room was spacious. Our room was so close to the casino and pool which we spent all day Sunday. We didn't have to leave the property. Breakfast lunch and dinner were all there!. Will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Nice place to Stay
reviews.text: Would like better access to pool, one pool for a lot of guests is not enough. Wish there was More activities for those who do not gamble and are traveling with family, kids.

reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.text: I was pleased with the spacious rooms and very nice fitness facilities.  I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Beautiful  grounds, huge room, comfy bed, and great staff at Marilyn's  Cafe, Gift shop and Security detail.

reviews.title: Very nice property just off the strip
reviews.text: Had a few small issues with the room but they were quickly resolved.  Everyone on the property was very nice and helpful. I would certainly stay again.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel at a great price! Highly Recommend!
reviews.text: Our stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino was excellent from start to finish. The rooms are very affordable and comfortable. The housekeeping does an excellent job and are very prompt if you need anything for your room. The pool was perfect and there was plenty of seating around it for when you weren't swimming. We ate at two of the restaurants and the food was excellent every time with friendly staff. The casino was fun and not overcrowded. The hotel is off of the strip but my wife and I easily walked the 10 minutes to the strip and the sphere so the location was not an issue for us. If you are not able to walk the distance it was easy to call for an Uber anytime of the day/night. Overall we had an amazing time during our stay and I would highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Locked out
reviews.text: Everything was good till was locked out of our rooms and then made to feel like I was breaking in when the battery just died on the door.  Made my day so long ruined all my plans for the rest of the day

reviews.title: Always a good time
reviews.text: not too crowded...great service from bars, restaurants, and dealers. Great place to go experience Vegas without too much sensory overload

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: We travel to Vegas twice yearly for work. The comfort and space offered at the Tuscany is a thing we count on surfing our week long stays. With efficient, patient and friendly staff, we couldn't ask for anything more.

reviews.title: Lovely place!
reviews.text: I would come again, big apartmetn, very quiet, housekeeping every day. Also the swimming pool, the bar, the restaurant in place made me feel good.

reviews.title: Beautiful place!
reviews.text: Good choice, hotel looks amazing and clean, there's everything a guest might need and the location is perfect, walking distance from the Strip

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Wonderful place to stay that's away from the strip but within walking distance. With all the amenities.

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: Good place for the price and location. We stayed in the room a lot, so the bed was too hard for my liking and the TV was about half the size of other places we've stayed.

reviews.title: Second stay in as many weeks.  I rate it high.
reviews.text: If you don't enjoy the accommodations then I am sure you are looking for something less.  A group of us stayed the second week of July and all was great.  So on my return trip I knew where I was going to stay.

reviews.title: It was okay
reviews.text: Check in attendant was kind of stand offish and not interested in conversation, got to my room and the shower door wouldn’t shut, which was annoying. Packed my fridge full of some perishable snacks and it was barely working so I had to throw away a good $60 in food. Casino and restaurants were good, the property was clean.

reviews.title: Home away from Home
reviews.text: Hotel location is very good, Verey courtious check in staff, Property, rooms/Suites are very good. Restaurtant pricing are very reasonalbel and food also very good quality and with wnough quantity.Excellent Stay.

reviews.title: Great location and property!
reviews.text: Nice quiet property with a great location. We felt safe on the property as well as walking to the Strip or the Sphere. The staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. The room was very large with 2 queen beds, a sitting area with a couch and chair as well as a small kitchenette with a mini fridge and a sink. However there was no microwave. There were also no service items like plates or silverware.

reviews.title: Worst ex
reviews.text: Bed covers were filthy with blood and fluid stains, walls are thin and can head every lil noise upstairs and next door. Was not compensated properly. Will never stay here and dont recommend staying here!

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Vegas !
reviews.text: The rooms, the grounds, the buildings are so well cleaned and groomed! The service and food is so damn good

reviews.title: Nice hotel a short walk away from the strip
reviews.text: We stayed for 2 nights in July at the Tuscany Suites & Casino. Our executive suite was very spacious and well equipped and looked exactly like the photos on the website. We especially loved the atmosphere at the pool.The food of Caffè Bottega was decent and the staff very helpful. Ability to eat outside was a plus for us.The location of the hotel is convenient. Just a 15 min walk away from the Strip but keep in mind there is almost no shadow.

reviews.title: Becoming too family oriented now
reviews.text: It is one of our favorite venues in Las Vegas. We enjoy staying, playing and eating at this facility. In prior times I would have rated Tuscany as first class, but some points need to be addressed. Small, but important to us was that there was no longer complimentary bottled water in the suites. We were told that we may purchase water at the vending machines on the first level. That did not happen being that they were empty. Another is purchasing drinks for the poolside. An automatic fee

reviews.title: Great place to Stay
reviews.text: We were invited down by Holiday Inn Club Vacations and this is the place they provided for our stay. We were pleasantly surprised by the size of the suite and the staff was great, everything you need was on site.

reviews.title: Great Choice for a Vegas Stay
reviews.text: Sprawling resort off the Strip but walkable weather permitting. Suites are spacious, quiet, comfortable and clean. Great pool. Good onsite bar and restaurants. Free WiFi was slow and our kitchen only had a small fridge and coffee maker. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Room review
reviews.text: The suite was great!LV has become extremely hard to get around with the formula 1 detours and we just can't handle this so it will be a long time before we return!  Hope you clean this up!

reviews.title: Quick weekend getaway
reviews.text: Great off strip casino that gives big casino vibes, but away from the Hussle and Bussle of the strip.  Tuscany has great bars, restaurants, and a cool casino.  Nice pool area, and friendly staff.  Definitely would visit again on my next trip.

reviews.title: Tuscany review
reviews.text: Our favorite is that the pool is open early and stays open late. And there are enough lounge chairs.One comment - maybe a couple more clothes dryers. One in the building would be nice.

reviews.title: Quality Hotel
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the hotel, I will be booking my next visit to Vegas at this hotel. I like that its located off the strip but is in walking distance,

reviews.title: Not very helpful
reviews.text: Our first two nights here after the long flight. Although booked for months non-smoking we were put in two smoking rooms. It smelled so bad, you felt sick. The beds, pillows all stunk. The air conditioning extremely loud, 70 decibels I measured, sleeping was unthinkable. The first night we could not change, the second night yes, but only at 5 pm.  The beds are rather narrow for 2 people, probably small queen size. We ate at the pub, was okay. The second meal at Bistecca. Meat was very good but expensive. Front desk always long queue, not very helpful. On the whole, we would not stay here again.

reviews.title: A great address in Las Vegas
reviews.text: After a week in the national parks, Las Vegas was the total contrast program. Tuscany is a good place to enjoy the highlive on the Stip and to be able to leave in a few minutes walk to relax in peace. Be it by the pool, at the bar or in the room. The rooms are spacious and despite carpet very clean and nice. The beds are a bit narrow but very comfortable. The staff are extremely friendly. An absolute Recommendation.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: I love how this property is off the strip but not far.  Nice quiet location and close to many amenities.This is a large well maintained property.  Truly my only complaint is for a property this large they only have a small pool and a lap pool.  I would have loved to get in the pool but it was too crowded.  This place should have two large pools.

reviews.title: Fun times!
reviews.text: Love the location, love the pool, love the rooms being detached from the casino and love they have live dealer table games! Fun stay!

reviews.title: Great Hotel off the strip
reviews.text: I have been staying at the Tuscany Suites for at least the past 10 years. The rooms are big, comfortable and always clean. The couch pulls out to a bed and all rooms have a mini fridge, table with chairs and I believe most have microwaves. One thing we appreciate is the ease in parking. Unlike the big resorts, you do not have long walks from your vehicle to your room or any part of the resort. Parking is free, convenient and secure. Another thing we like is that it is not far from the strip. You can definitely walk to the strip and back at night with no issues. Many restaurants within walking distance as well. The lobby bar is always fun with live music at night and martini happy hour which I take full advatage of. They have fire pits outside the bar which offer a nice place to relax and enjoy a glass of wine with family and friends. The pool area is small but works for our family. the casino is also small but again, works for us. There is a coffee shop that offers quick bites for breakfast and lunch that is good and not very pricey. We have eaten at 2 of their restaurnats and liked them both for a quick burger and breakfast. Nothing fancy but the food is good. We have tried staying at other hotels and we always come back to the Tuscany Suites.

reviews.title: Great stay just off the strip
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites is the perfect location, not far from anything and a beautiful, clean property with all the necessities. Would not hesitate to stay again.

reviews.title: Book Thru Tuscany not Groupon
reviews.text: Groupon should EXPLICITLY state that if you don’t have a credit card available with $150 limit your stay will not be permitted. Otherwise it was awesome.

reviews.title: none
reviews.text: I like this property, it is really nice, and one of my favorites when staying in Vegas. I wish they had free shuttle up/down the strip. The traffic was horrible. The room was nice and roomy but there was no microwave to reheat food. No iron or ironing board and the tub had no curtain? We stayed on the bottom floor and we could hear our neighbors stomping around late at night and early in the morning.  Otherwise a good stay.

reviews.title: 100% Amazing Experience!!!
reviews.text: I have been to dozens of hotels, timeshares, Airbnb and I was never satisfied with the bed. Tuscany has the best bed in their suites!! The best, clean bathroom that I have ever been to. Definitely coming back to Tuscany for any travels in Vegas!! The staff were great and with smiles on their faces even when there were hundreds of us that checked in at one point!

reviews.title: Tuscany review
reviews.text: Excellent apartment like setting  and a European feel. It did not feel like I was in a typical Vegas hotel. Spacious rooms and parking …

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the time in Tuscany. The pool was excellent, the rooms large, air conditioned and cozy. The location was great and so was the price!

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: If the pool was open later I would give it 5 stars besides that I was happy with my stay & the restaurants

reviews.title: Best Hotel off the Strip
reviews.text: Tremendous value here at Tuscany.   Four star accommodations, reasonably priced.   Room was large and very clean.   Front desk staff are super accommodating and friendly.  No issues during stay.  Would recommend.   Also a shout-out to Shaun at the front desk, he gets an A+ in customer service.

reviews.title: Plumbing issues
reviews.text: Checkin was fine. But my toilet was plugged and I called multiple times to get someone out. They never came. I shouldn’t have to pay for a room  where the toilet won’t flush! Front desk was too crowded to even ask for a credit or refund.

reviews.title: Too Bad Staff Wasn’t Nice
reviews.text: Tuscany has no much potential as an off strip property. The staff need to step up their service - and, smile people are there to have fun.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Always really good and nice. It was really clean and a big room with a lot of services. We dont have any problem during our night with them.

reviews.title: Awesome Getaway
reviews.text: My daughter and I stayed and absolutely loved it. The room was large and clean. The pillows were so comfortable. The person at check-n was so nice and the process was quick and easy. The pool was smaller than I thought it would be, but still great and clean. It was really like walking around in a little European village. I will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The whole property was METICULOUSLY maintained. The staff was attentive and kind. Our room air-condition had some problems but the staff had it fixed in no time.The check process seemed to take a long time but the staff handled it with professionalism and grace. My husband and I will definitely stay here whenever we travel to Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice close to Strip prop
reviews.text: Nice spacious suite.  No View, just of the next building across the walkway. That"s ok, I only look when I first come in. Common areas are very nice. Pools crystal clear, used the fitness center and it was well maintained and had high end functional equipment. Schedule didn't allow me to see any of the live entertainment, but it is nice they do offer it. If I had a gripe parking is a bit confusing, took awhile to find parking near the building I was assigned to. and when I returned after 1am no parking anywhere near building I.

reviews.title: Suitable
reviews.text: Family vacation with our 16 year old. We were close to everything to be able to walk to. Rooms were suitable. Wish there would have been a microwave.

reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.text: We booked our stay through a third party and were pleasantly surprised at how nice the room resort and amenities were.

reviews.title: Good hotel for a fair price.
reviews.text: Hotel staff is friendly and the grounds are clean and well maintained. Would have rated higher but the air conditioner in my room made a jack-hammering sound 2-3x per hour which made it impossible to get a good night sleep.

reviews.title: Not handicapped accessible.
reviews.text: Well, they do have a few rooms that are handicap accessible. They do not have enough when there is a large group in town. Also, their doors are not automatic. It's difficult if you're using a Walker wheelchair or scooter to open the doors because there's no button to push for it to automatically open

reviews.title: Just awful
reviews.text: My wife and I booked a room for a conference being held at the hotel. Everything was fine for 2 months until 1 day before checking in. They stated we needed a credit card to secure the room for any damages. My wife and I don't use credit cards. So needless to say, this was a huge inconvenience when I called to try to get the matter resolved. I was told conflicting information all the way to I could use any credit card to secure the room to it didn't apply to conference attendees (which at in person check-in they said was not correct and that any CC had to match the reservation holder's name). Then there was back-and-forth between our attendant checking with other staff debating whether I could use a debit card or not since I was a conference attendee. Again, none of this was stated at booking! Check in was also at three o'clock and we didn't have a room ready until five o'clock. Even then, we had to go to the front desk and ask for our room versus them letting us know. Our conference room was sweltering the first day, so then they moved everyone to another room. We ate at pub 365 and the food was incredibly salty for everyone, small portions.  The only bright spot was most of the dealers were fun and accommodating. I absolutely would not stay at this hotel again and would have moved if our conference wasn't in the same building. Wish you better luck if you book here!

reviews.title: Good times!
reviews.text: Wish my discount had been applied correctly! Overcharged $176.88! When I made the reservation online, I used Shakedown 2024 to not be charged Resort fee but still was. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Great Place, love the fitness pool without kids space and hot tub.  Love the coffee/bakery shop.  Close to walk to lots of things.

reviews.title: Great Off Strip Place
reviews.text: We attended a convention and found the hotel very nice with a great pool. Accommodared our special needs

reviews.title: Value Vegas
reviews.text: Check in line was long, Sunday afternoon with 3 attendants.  Very helpful and nice staff. Clean lobby, beautiful appearance. Room AC unit was leaking water on the carpet, a wall of outlets were out of service. The elevator in out building (B) functioned intermittently. Staff was pleasant and great! Beds were comfortable. Good value.

reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: We love to stay here every time we're in Vegas; the staff is very nice and helpful.   We had a little glitch this past Sunday, we'll try not to return when is as crowded as the past weekend.

reviews.title: Tuscany Resort review
reviews.text: Loved the resort having all I needed right there.  The casino staff are great.  y room was clean upon arrival and kept clean daily.

reviews.title: Read the room details
reviews.text: Overall, I'd recommend the hotel. The staff is great, rooms are spacious and comfortable. Just be sure if you have more than 2 people in your party that you read the room details before booking. The couches in the suites are NOT fold out beds, they are love seats. If you are relying on the couch as a bed for someone who is taller than 5 feet, consider a roll-away bed or another room. The double beds listed are at best full sized beds.

reviews.title: Tuscany
reviews.text: It was a great stay. Kind employees and great restaurants. Good service, except for the female bartender at the Toscana Bar. She wasn't the friendliest.

reviews.title: The best bang for the buck in Vegas!
reviews.text: The rooms are spacious and beautiful, and the pool and other facilities are fantastic. The different restaurants are delicious and inexpensive.

reviews.title: a very beautiful & friendly resort
reviews.text: I generally like to stay downtown when i Visit but came on a special Business trip and we stayed at the Tuscany suites - It was so much better than some of the resorts on the strip that I’ve stayed at - You walk out the door and catch the bus and take you directly down onto the Las Vegas Blvd. and then catch the deuce buses up and down Las Vegas Blvd. wherever you wanna go -, Was amazed at how much vegetation and plant material was on the property. It’s absolutely gorgeous.

reviews.title: Tuscany-a room with a view
reviews.text: The entire exterior was very nice. No trash on the ground. Clean rooms, comfortable beds, and working air conditioning. The heat was unbearable outside, but it was very comfortable inside.

reviews.title: July 2024
reviews.text: Shakedown vegas was a very fun experience. Everything went smoothly and we had a great time. Highly recommend

reviews.title: Positive experience.
reviews.text: Great hotel, clean and comfortable. New structure, spacious rooms and equipped with all the necessary amenities, bathroom with both bathtub and shower modern and very clean. Friendly staff and quiet rooms. Free internal parking. The only flaw is the distance from strip; nothing transcendental, but we talk about a 15 minute walk that if you add to the lap to do you get 40 minutes walk.

reviews.title: The pot smoking
reviews.text: Very disappointed with how many people were smoking pot couldn’t walk anywhere in the hotel without smelling it, and my daughter was harassed by one of them.

reviews.title: Love Las Vegas Hate the Cigarette smoke everywhere
reviews.text: Nothing special but effort and good location, nice late night restaurant. Cigarette smoke everywhere gave me an insane headache

reviews.title: Watch out for Hidden Resort Fees
reviews.text: The hotel room was lovely and comfortable.  Location is great for our purposes.  To note, we only stayed one night, which was our plan.

reviews.title: Retired looking for value and good seevice
reviews.text: Just wish craps table was open much sooner with $5 minimum during slower play. Slots seemed really tight. My wife played slots for hours and biggest jackpot or bonus was under $100

reviews.title: Don’t stay here if you’re pregnant!
reviews.text: I specifically requested on my reservation that I wanted to be assigned to a room closest to the front because I didn’t have a car and also close to a door because I couldn’t walk far because I am very pregnant. Bed was uncomfortable, and pillows were horrible. I would not stay here again and in the past, I always had a great experience. Things must have changed with their service and their furniture/bedding.

reviews.title: My favorite oasis in the desert
reviews.text: Awesome place. Every room is spacious and comfortable. The layout for the property makes you feel like you arent in a desert any more. Great pools and an awesome gym. Full gym, not just a treadmill and a few items. This has it all.Depending on the events around your stay, I'd have to say the rooms can vary from hundreds and sometimes thousand. That would be my only problem with the property.

reviews.title: Meet Me @ The Tuscany
reviews.text: Huge rooms, comfy beds, good a/c.Excellent food options on site at all hours. Easy walk to strip or sphere.Can't wait to be back. MEET ME AT THE TUSCANY!!!

reviews.title: Mobilty scooter stolen from Bell Desk
reviews.text: One would think leaving an item at the bell desk is the safest place you could put it. Not true. Took me four different trips to the bell desk to find out what happened to my scooter. Finally after reviewing the video surveillance they admitted it was stolen. I think the thing that most irks me is no one from the hotel contacted me to follow up.(A person from the security team did contact me, but no manager ever followed up)

reviews.title: Positive stay
reviews.text: One night stay at the end of our car tour of the parks. Good location half a mile from the strip within easy walking distance. Hotel with multiple buildings of a few floors. arranged around the pool. Spacious apartments, clean, equipped kitchen. Generously sized bathroom, large and pleasant shower with glass. The only drawback our apartment on the second floor had a view of the adjacent building, close up. Quick, courteous and helpful reception staff. Free car parking.

reviews.title: Las Vegas adventure
reviews.text: I had a really nice stay at this hotel. We had everything in the resort. Restorants, casino and pools. Everything was amazing. I loved walking around the resort always something new to see and explore. Room was clean and really comfortable. Staff was nice and helpful.

reviews.title: Another win!
reviews.text: Love the location, off the strip!  Rooms, spacious and clean.  Pool lovely and relaxing.  Restaurants, great.  Casino, fun but prefer non-smoking.  Staff, respectful and helpful.  Have been here multiple times.  As has been noted, it’s time for some upgrades and improvements to stay relevant.

reviews.title: Quiet stay, inexpensive and with all the other cool stuff you like in Vegas
reviews.text: This was our first stay at Tuscany Suites. We have visited the casino before and seen the Rat Pack and ate at Marilyn's. If I thought that was the best, it isn't - the Hotel is astounding! The room is enormous, the property is huge and well organized (and safe!) It was like staying at a college campus where Buildings are clearly marked and mapped out. The Palm trees make everything feel so much like a resort!The first night we were there, we arrived as the Grateful Dead concert was letting out. So many Deadheads!!! But everyone was having an amazing time and made the property feel cool! The room was quiet even though there were so many people staying there. The room itself was absolutely enormous. We could easily have had 4-6 people sleep in the room. There was a king bed, full sized pull out couch, a large comfy chair as well as a desk and a table and chairs in the kitchenette. The coffee machine didn't work properly and when I advised staff, they replaced it very quickly. There is a fridge that has NOTHING IN IT!!! You can fill it with all the water, Gatorade, beer and liquor you want! The walk to the strip is about 3 blocks so prepare yourself accordingly. But Ellis BBQ is one block away, Hofbräuhaus is about 4 blocks away as well as Harmon Square Mall which has LOTS of food options and the Virgin Hotel/Casino. If you are looking for a quiet stay, inexpensive and with all the other cool stuff you like in Vegas, Tuscany Suites is for you!

reviews.title: Recommended!!!
reviews.text: Nice hotel with large, comfortable and nice rooms, has coffee maker, mini bar, free parking and near the strip but the truth that the return with a few beers on top becomes endless haha. Very good value for money.

reviews.title: A review from a 10 year old
reviews.text: It was in a certain spot somebody said that it was cleaned, but every other was dry, drawers were  empty, no couch bed, pool was great though, wecame because my 9 year old son's birthday, we meant to go here for 1 night and then we will go to Hawaii.The bathroom door won't close room 118

reviews.title: Liars and Thieves
reviews.text: It finally happened where I got screwed by a Vegas hotel and the winner of that is, wait for it, Tuscany Suites. I’m waiting to get into an apartment locally in Vegas as it’s been delayed and needed to stay somewhere for 5 days. Tuscany popped up as an option on Priceline and I thought the rooms would be great to accommodate my remote work. Unfortunately I’ve had to scale back to one credit card as I’m working of debt and this one card I tried to put money on that day, Sunday, for the security deposit. I assumed it would be available right away but I was wrong. So Tuscany refuses to check me in even though I offered to pay double the security deposit on my debit card as a hold that other hotels in Vegas don’t seem to have a problem accepting. Luckily I still had a couple good offers at the Rio (it’s in much better shape these days by the way) so I headed there. Before I left the front desk the  guy working reception assured me they would honor the cancellation and refund my money. With moving expenses I had to use affirm via Priceline for monthly payments as moving is expensive and was waiting on funds to be paid to me for work completed currently and for the past few months. Anyways I call Priceline and apparently Tuscany refused to honor my request and will not give me back my money. Now mind you I offered to pay double on a visa backed debit card for their security deposit and resort fees. The first time my contact from Priceline called they said they didn’t have the money. They next day they said they can’t do anything because payment has already been made. So I’m stuck paying for a stay I was not allowed to use. So for the love of God make sure you have a working credit card otherwise they will cancel your reservation and steal your money. That’s all.

reviews.title: Visiting for my son's 21st birthday 🎂 🥳
reviews.text: Loved this place. We stayed Saturday through Tuesday. It was super close to the sphere & everything Las Vegas. Had a great, fun & friendly atmosphere, live music, pool side service, breakfast nook, and bustling casino. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Highly recommended hotel to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent hotel in Las Vegas. spacious rooms with coffee maker in the room and refrigerator. Impeccable cleanliness. Very friendly attention from the staff. Ample parking. The casino is also very quiet. Close to the main street. You have to discover shortcuts that cut the way from the Street to the hotel by going inside the hotels. 100% recommended hotel. Quality-price balance

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Very clean and only a couple of blocks from the strip nice pool and staff good food also  the panenies were our favorite we will stay here again I'm not a gambler so I don't know anything about the casino you can see the sphere from the front entrance it's so close

reviews.title: No elevator,no communication
reviews.text: They really don’t care for the ADA here. We booked the Da Vinci suite for our wedding week trip so our guests could come spend time with us in the suite. The front desk woman said the elevator was being repaired, which sounded like a one day fix.  It wasn’t  until we spoke with the repairmen working on the elevator, that we were told it was being replaced. No one told us before we booked or offered to rebook another room that wasn’t a third story walk up.  We reserved these rooms eight months in advance, and we were never notified of the elevator replacement. They  were well aware that this was our wedding week.They certainly want your gambling money but this is not a place we’d recommend.

reviews.title: If you wanna have a hood (projects) experience Tuscany Suites is it.
reviews.text: The place would be nice if they had control of it, I grew up in the hood so I know what it is like and this here is just it. I felt like I was living back in the project. I understand I’m coming into Vegas, the neighbors were so loud it’s impossible to sleep. So if you want a little sleep Tuscany is not the place! As you will not get any at all. Mind you the dogs they allow people to have is also crazy to me. Sad cuz the place is nice.

reviews.title: Charming
reviews.text: This was the second time staying at the Tuscany, and both times did not disappoint! The rooms are spacious and clean, and the cleaning staff did a great job every day of our stay!We love the layout of the facility and it felt like a quiet little community when walking back to our room! The Rat Pack show was great and we loved all the eating facilities!We would definitely recommend the Tuscany and we will be back!

reviews.title: In need of customer service training.
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay several years back so we returned. The rooms are expansive and the restaurant superb. This time wasn't so smooth. The elevator to our second floor room was not functioning, nor was the ice maker. We entered and exited through a fire exit door that said alarm will sound when opened as that was the door that exited to the parking lot. Thankfully it didn't alarm.  I booked a double room and was given a one king instead. When I called the desk they said I could use the pull-out and call when we wanted it fitted with bedding. We called at 8 pm, and were told housekeeping closes at 5 pm. When we pressed the issue they relented, but someone showed up 2 hours later and dropped off sheets but no blanket or pillow. So customer service was abysmal but the rooms are still expansive and the restaurant good.

reviews.title: Las Vegas style
reviews.text: Less renowned hotel than more famous names but it really has everything. Beautiful swimming pool, cafe and pub with affordable prices, casino. Very kind staff. Comfortable and super clean rooms. To get to the strip you have to walk 15 minutes but absolutely pleasant. 10 minutes instead from the Sphere

reviews.title: Very welcoming human-sized hotel
reviews.text: Hotel on a human scale, unlike the vast majority of other hotels in Las Vegas, with beautiful surrounding vegetation and a pleasant swimming pool, as well as a place to have breakfast, a very pleasant bar with live music and several restaurants.The rooms are distributed in several small 3-story buildings. They are large, well equipped with a small kitchen, quiet and the bedding is great.I highly recommend this hotel, located on the large Flamingo Avenue, 15 minutes from the strip and all its gigantic hotels and diverse and varied restaurants. I will return without any hesitation.

reviews.title: Great off strip hotel
reviews.text: This is a great off strip hotel. Perfect if you dont want to hassle with the big casinos, but stay close to the strip. Big rooms, very clean, free parking, great rate, nice staff. We stayed while visiting our son at UNLV. Would stay here again for sure.

reviews.title: We loved this hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the main strip in Las Vegas.  It was very nice with wonderful restaurants and a nice cafe.  The room was extremely nice, very large, very clean and very quiet.  We were not far from the pool and the fitness room.  Both well kept

reviews.title: Ok resort
reviews.text: Overall a nice place off the strip. The guest rooms are fabulous, pool and grounds are kept immaculate. Casino is small, but adequate.Guest services are slow at all times. Food was good in pub, sub par in Marilyn’s with terrible management..would not recommend this restaurant.

reviews.title: It's Official: This is my go-to hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: When I visit my brother who lives near Las Vegas, I treat him to a hotel stay our last night together. Then I'm close to the airport the next day--we both win! We stayed at Tuscany in September of 2022 (you can see my review posted 9/13/22). Our second stay did not disappoint!Tuscany is still a great value with large, luxurious rooms, with enough distance from the craziness of the strip to be a tranquil oasis, but close enough be within walking distance. Both times staying here, we noticed maintenance people everywhere, fixing this, touching up that, making the place shine. Whatever age the place is, they keep it looking fresh and new. There was a fire alarm at 5:30 am, which was a false alarm, so we went right back to sleep. We found out later that it was someone tampering with the alarm system, so not the hotel's fault. Our only recommendation to the staff is that blackout curtains would be a good added touch. The room's curtains were only translucent, and let in some light in the morning. That wasn't a bother to us, but we thought that some guests might be more light-sensitive (especially if they were out partying the night before). The on-site restaurant (Marilyn's) is convenient, very good, and a good value for breakfast.Unless I'm gifted a penthouse stay in another hotel, this will continue to be THE place I will stay in Las Vegas. They now have my loyalty.

reviews.title: Not-so-good experience
reviews.text: The check-in experience was devastating as we were made to wait for 1.5 hrs just for that. We had a cranky baby all the while which the hotel staff didn't pay attention to. When we entered the room, the room was full of burning smell and the shower area also didn't work.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: This is a nice, clean hotel available at good price.Pro:- Price is amazing, even after the resort fee.- The room is so spacious! And mostly really clean - except for the desk chair.- The bathroom is so spacious! Shower and bathtub are separate.- Coffee and breakfast available at the cafe was affordable and good enough. (I heard it's hard to find good coffee at reasonable price in Las Vegas.) Con:- The hotel cafe is attached to the casino, and was filled with cigarette smell. We ended up eating our food on the outside area. I assume that this is a common case with most hotels in Las Vegas.- We noticed dust / white powder on the desk chair. We wiped it ourselves, but questioned why room-keeping wouldn't have cleaned the chair. It was very visible when the room was dark.- No microwave- the 20 min walk to the strip was harder than I thought it would beI would stay at this hotel again if I visit Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: Great Practical Choice When Staying in Vegas
reviews.text: While it lacks the glamour and glitz of hotels on The Strip, the Tuscany Suites makes for a great practical choice when visiting Vegas. Location is good less than a mile from the Strip. It's a 15 min walk or a short inexpensive Uber. There is also free parking and the rates at the hotel represented good value for what is offered. Rooms aren't stylish but are large and comfortable. There are 2 pool areas, and the grounds of the hotel are well maintained.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Tuscany suites was awesome. The rooms are roomy suites. The grounds are very manicured and clean!!  There are two pools, several restaurants, a showroom, pub, bar with live music, and of course a casino. The prices are reasonable since it is off the strip behind the Horseshoe. Very nice staff. Fitness center open 24’. Very comfort and clean rooms. Definitely will stay again.

reviews.title: Wow... super!
reviews.text: 3rd time in Las Vegas and I have to say this is a great hotel. Giant and clean room, very comfortable bed, fridge, TV, air conditioning in the room, excellent Wi-Fi. Parking available for free which in Las Vegas is a luxury. Quiet and peaceful area even if close to the road. Nearby places and restaurants for both eating and shopping (supermarket). Friendly and helpful staff. It seems to be in a tourist village. In 10 to 15 minutes you arrive on the Strip (on the corner with the Paris and the Flamingo so to speak). Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Wonderful 4 years ago...hasty woman at front desk.
reviews.text: I really loved this place in 2019 and 2020 when I stayed there. It was great. I showed up with no reservation and got a fantastic room at a great price, and I was able to pay cash, which was wonderful, because I was bankrupt at the time and had no credit card.I attempted to do the same thing earlier today, however, the policy must have changed in the last four years.The front desk agent said she couldn't take cash for a deposit, so I took out my bank card, she said she couldn't take it because it's a debit card, even though it's a Navy Federal CREDIT UNION card. So, I pulled out my little pathetic $300 limit card, and then she began becoming rude and told me it's not a credit card that it was a prepaid debit card, even though I deposit zero dollars into it and pay it off ...so, I told her about my previous stays and she would not help me and was really rude she almost got to calling security over. I wish I had gotten her name, or asked to speak to a manager, but I just booked another room on my phone and had no issues when I checked in.  So, I intend to book online next time just to see what happens. Never in my life have I been treated like a deadbeat while I have six figures in the bank.

reviews.title: Good hotel...
reviews.text: The rooms are really spacious and the staff pleasant.The hotel, even without being on the strip, remains rather well placed.The fact that there is free parking is much appreciated.On the other hand, the soundproofing is not good and the beds are really narrow... 😔

reviews.title: GREAT hotel, very close to the strip!
reviews.text: LOVED this hotel! Tuscany Suites was a 10 minute walk to the strip, so all of  the excitement without the noise and craziness. Beautiful big rooms, free parking and wonderful pool area. Will definitely stay again on our next trip to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: Great hotel, just off the Strip. Spacious with many hotel blocks, a maximum of three floors in a green environment. The focus is more on the hotel stay than on the casino. Unlike many other hotels where you have to go through the casino to your room. Excellent restaurants available. Nice and tidy swimming pool. Very spacious room

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: Booked this hotel because of an artist playing there and the pools. Arrived to find the main pool under construction for the 2 weeks we were there and the spa heated pool’s heater was broken so not able to use this one either. The hot tub filter was broken and not able to use that for several days. There were only 5 loungers and 4 chairs by spa pool and we as well as other guests had to sit on the ground. The musical artist we came to see that they advertised on their website hadn’t played there for months. The 2 star rating is because the food is excellent at the restaurants. Would not recommend this hotel as their website was not up to date and vey misleading.

reviews.title: Nice property a few blocks off the strip
reviews.text: This is a very nice family-owned property a few blocks off the strip, and close to the Sphere. The restaurants have good food and friendly staff. The rooms are very clean and larger than most, and have a small kitchen table, cupboards, small sink, coffeemaker, and small fridge. The only minor complaint is with the bathroom. The bathtub and shower are separate, but the shower stall has no lighting in it and is very dark. The only light comes from the lighting over the vanity sink, which is nowhere near enough. There is a heat lamp in the ceiling of the bathroom which provides more light, but made the bathroom way too warm. Also, for the ladies, there is no makeup mirror. Other than these minor issues, our stay was great.

reviews.title: Grandson's 21st birthday trip
reviews.text: I last stayed at this property in 2019. Five years later, it's just as great. Well-kept grounds that are adjacent to the strip (not too far to walk, not too expensive to Uber), a quiet space near the action. Good mattresses, spacious rooms, good restaurants onsite. The coffee shop is a gem! Nice pools and hot tub. 100% will stay again.

reviews.title: Nice hotel just off The Strip.
reviews.text: Very clean property, large roomy suites, loved having a mini frig and in room coffee maker.  The hotel buidings were secure and the grounds were nicely kept.  A good location off The Strip, but The Strip was only a 15 -20 minute walk away. A good value.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable. Huge well equipped room with small kitchen area (fridge and coffee machine). Two king sized beds, full bathroom with separate toilet. Housekeeping every day. Lovely grounds, two pools - the lap pool was closed for maintenance on two of the days we were there.  We were in block N - it was quiet. Had food in both Pub 365 and Marilyn's Cafe - good quality, tasty, big portions and very reasonably priced.  Fifteen minute walk to the strip. (If you have a Deuce bus ticket you can use the local bus 202 to hop to the hotel from the strip). Rebecca M in Marilyn's was the stand out member of staff, friendly, helpful and answered all our Vegas questions.

reviews.title: Oasis is a busy city!
reviews.text: QuietBeautifulPeaceful and calmRoom was hushedGood sleepingWe enjoyed our Break Break days!Had great meals in Marilyn’s The Casino was just our speed!!Only half an hour from home!!We look forward to many more weekend get aways!We would really recommend to visitors or stay-cations!!!

reviews.title: This is A True Value For Las Vegas
reviews.text: Friendly staff, huge room. Reasonable prices for the room during the week on Booking.com A true Vegas Value. I will return again. I can't say enough about this hotel. As we traveled around to the national parks our last night and stayed  at the Madi Gras in Las Vegas. Compared to Tuscany Suites we wanted to cry. I'm sorry I missed the Rat Pack Show at the Tuscany. I also wanted to sit by the stone fire place outside the pool area. I loved the separate shower and tub. That was wonderful. This was truly a suite.

reviews.title: Stay away from this hotel
reviews.text: Horrible - would rate a 0/5 if possibleBooked 4 nights for a family trip, and was told to stay either in a smoking room or a room without elevator (no apology at all - stay or go) Chose a room without elevator (not a big problem for us) But on the second day, the front desk said the room went out of service,  and we must switch to another room by 3pm, otherwise all personal items will be removed by security. (Again no apology at all). After checking out, I got a bill with all mistakes. I was charged multiple times for all sorts of fees and taxes. Incidentals were not properly charged as pending transaction but posted transaction. The money taken out from my card cannot reconcile with what front desk told me. Stay away from this hotel!

reviews.title: BED BUGS!
reviews.text: There were Bed bugs here!  Stayed here with my son for a baseball tournament. Our room had bedbugs. I reported it to management and they filed a report with their “security team.” hotel management was horrible in dealing with it. I reported them to the Las Vegas Department of health.

reviews.title: Fantastic in every way that matters (to me)
reviews.text: My girlfriend and I had a great experience here.  We went to see U2 at the Sphere and this is just a short walk away.  We could see the Sphere from just outside the building.  It was my first time in Vegas and I was concerned that everything would smell like cigarette smoke, even though we booked a non-smoking room.  We were in a whole non-smoking building, and even in the casino, where we could see people smoking, the ventilation was so good it didn't bother us.  The pool and hot tub were nice.  We had a couple nice breakfast and lunches at one of the cafes onsite.  The room was big and comfy.  The vegas strip is close enough to be an easy walk, and far enough that you can get a break from it if all feels a bit manic and superficial after the heart-opening profundity of seeing U2 at the Sphere.  I will definitely be back here.

reviews.title: Unethical staff and management
reviews.text: Not the place you want to bring your family or even your spouse. This hotel on the weekend of 2/15 is host to a sex conference with suites being used for group sex. NOT somewhere you want your family around. Management and leadership know about this and have done nothing. We took our stuff and left

reviews.title: Lack of information and building site
reviews.text: The hotel itself is good, the restaurants serve very good food and it's very well priced.The rooms are big and clean.  It's very close to the strip My reason for the score is simply due to the fact we were not told about the building work at the main pool, so it was very disappointing to have to sit in a construction site. On CHECK OUT I was told about a smaller lap pool which was open . No good to me on checkout!!!! I was only told too because I voiced my complaint,  shame this could be an amazing place

reviews.title: Don’t stay here!
reviews.text: Worst hotel experience ever! Checked in just to have no hot water or working wifi. Had to take a cold shower before dinner and came back 2 hours later to the water still not fixed then when I was in the bathroom some guy barged in without knocking to finally fix the water. Then I’m about to go to sleep and a jack hammer starts going outside my room and had to drive back to the front desk and switch rooms and after all that they offer me 25$ food coupon as I’m leaving. DONT STAY HERE! A motel will be nicer and treat you better

reviews.title: A hidden gem! We chose it because it was within walking distance to the Sphere, and were beyond thrilled!!
reviews.text: A hidden gem! We chose it because it was within walking distance to the Sphere, and were beyond thrilled!!

reviews.title: Nice stay at the Tuscany.
reviews.text: Stayed here for 2 nights of our 5 night vacation. Hotel is clean. Rooms are large with plenty of space. Refrigerator is nice to have in the room. One of my biggest complaints of hotels and found the same here…time to reinvest in your television. The tv was small for such a large room. I know people don’t spend alot of time in their hotel room but we like to turn it on in the morning before heading out. Anyway…will definitely return to Tuscany Casino and Hotel as it’s clean, everyone was friendly and it’s close to just about everything.

reviews.title: Not a Single Night's Rest
reviews.text: We liked the hotel facilities but our room's soundproofing was extremely inadequate. We were kept awake every night of our stay as the guest in the room above was very heavy-footed and constantly pacing, emanating in incessant and annoyingly loud thumping through our ceiling every night and all night from dinner hours through sunrise. Only in the mid-afternoons were we unable to get any rest. We  contemplated requesting a different room but I was recovering from a medical procedure and felt that moving to a different room would have been too risky. Therefore we held out hope for a different guest to check in, but we weren't that fortunate and instead endured the noise for the duration of our stay.

reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel!!!
reviews.text: Always a great stay, this is an awesome hotel.  Marilyn's and Pub 365 are amazing, and the casino is pretty good too.The suites themselves are very spacious and are very clean.  And it is a quick walk to the Strip.  This is not my first time here, and I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: ancient, noisy heat/air unit in room--fan blades made a racket, needed ear plugs
reviews.text: The biggest problem was the old heating and air conditioning unit that needs servicing. It kept cycling on and off because the fan blades were loose or warped and made a huge racket. I turned the heat up when I left so that it would be warm when I returned and I wouldn't have to listen to it as much. And I slept with ear plugs. I told management about it; they said there was nothing wrong with the unit. So I assume all their units are in poor repair because they can't/won't recognize a problem.I paid $600 for 5 nights. I liked that it was a few blocks from the strip rather than being right in the thick of things. About a 15 min walk to the strip. I had a non-smoking room that was clean and didn't smell.
