Though the hallways were musty from both smoking and moisture issues--it rained for 3 of the 6 days and water seeped in the doorways.

reviews.title: Best kept secret in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is my home away from home , I am an owner at a Las Vegas resort and kften I find myself booking with the Tuscany, it's like having a time share without the mostly fees.. it afford an excellent view , plenty of game play , they have even added table games and yet not so much that it distracts from the ambience that is ,, the Tuscany. They ha e a very nice sports.bar PUB 365 , try the Unicorn beer and Burger I recommend it 😎, plan the petrct clioles.get away and ennis the Rst pack show it will make your stay memorable. Who know I might even see you there ..

reviews.title: If you don’t like peaceful rest, this is the place for you
reviews.text: I was excited cause the room is huge and felt clean. but i can’t sleep because all you hear are people fkn in one room, and people stomping around from 4 to 7 am in the room above me. no rest. no peace. i’m exhausted. This was a total price gouge rip off. never in my right mind would i stay here again

reviews.title: Great option with a car
reviews.text: I flew solo from Fri night late to Wed and Tuscany worked out great for me. Nice big room that smelled nice, complete with kitchenette (you can ask for a microwave apparently. I wished I thought to ask for one). I liked that the rooms are sprawled out in separate buildings with your own free parking right outside, which I loved as a nice base of operations for the city. It's off the strip, the streets are all multi-lanes with tons of traffic - you can't really walk anywhere. So if you have a car, stay at Tuscany. The downside to the separate buildings, is the casino, restaurants, fitness, pools are a bit of walk. It poured the whole time I was there so that sucked, but the room was cozy even tho the TV was tiny and annoying. There is free wifi that is limited to 5mps. You can pay $10 for faster speed, but that still wasn't really fast enough. So parking was free (yes!) but functional wifi had a fee (boo!). I ate alot at the 365 pub. Decent food, a ton of draft beer choices, not crazy expensive. As I discovered in Vegas in general, people don't really talk to you so I sat at the bar chatting with the bartenders mostly. Marilyns place had good breakfast and other cheap options. I didn't eat at the nice restaurant. The lounge has happy hour everyday with half priced martinis every night. Yum. And live music every night although it's kinda lame lounge act stuff. But hey, live music is live music. I didn't check out the Rat Pack show but it looked fun.   The casino was smoking but they ventilate very well for casinos. I wasn't gagging at all walking through it to get to restaurants. The fitness room was dated and kind of dirty but I made due. I didn't use the spa. Since it was raining I didn't use the pool or hottub, although the hotub looked awesome. So overall, I'd say stay at Tuscany if you have a family and a car. Definitely reasonable cost, you can trust the positive reviews, and it makes for a great base to explore the city.

reviews.title: Nice rooms but…
reviews.text: Stayed for two nights in early February.  I selected the hotel because the prices were reasonable, there was free parking and the Rat Pack is Back show is in the Copa Room.  The rooms are in several different buildings.  The plus is you don’t get casino noise.  The down side is that it feels more apartment complex or dorms than resort.  The room was huge and clean without smelling like bleach.  The water was hot but our shower drain was slow.  A microwave would have been helpful.  We had an individual approach us on our third floor hallway asking us to smell a shirt he was holding out, which was odd and predatory.  We made it into our room without incident but didn’t feel great this individual was either an odd guest or had made it into the secured L building at the back of the facility.  I reported to security and they said they were sending someone to investigate.  I presume they did but they never followed up with us.  I should have asked to be moved to make my daughter feel safer but our room was secure.  The area around the pool is nice if you manage to get a room closer to that area.

reviews.title: Excellent meal
reviews.text: Super meal included with the ticket to the Rat Trap cabaret. Excellent service from our lovely waiter. Had a soup starter and steak for main and a delicious pudding. Could not fault it. We were surprised at the excellent meal included in the ticket for the show as we're inexpensive tickets.

reviews.title: BEWARE - sharp metal objects in pillow
reviews.text: Beware of sharp metal staples and pins in their pillows. Scratched myself on the hand (easily could have been on face or neck) just by moving the pillow around, light bleeding. After notifying reservations/front desk they didn't seem to take the issue seriously, asked me to call their security team.

reviews.title: Will stay here next visit to Vegas
reviews.text: Had an excellent stay at the Tuscany!  Check in staff were friendly and helpful, room was very clean and housekeeping did a great job.All rooms are located in separate buildings from the casino so nice and quiet.  Courtyard areas are well kept.  The entire facility from casino to restaurants to washrooms kept very clean.About a 10 minute walk to the Strip, you can see the Sphere from the front of the hotel if you want to get some pictures.

reviews.title: Oracle conference
reviews.text: I paid $USD 150.00 that was to be refunded within three days of my church out, but upto now I was not paid my refund of $USD 150.00 and not getting any feedback regardless of many messages sent. I am requesting for the refund.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Rooms are huge and beds very comfortable.  It is quiet and well appointed.  The bathroom has a separate toilet area, tub and separate shower.  Beautiful.  We were in Building B which is close to the lobby.  I would recommend that.  The property is very large and some buildings are quite a walk from the main area.  There is a kitchen area with a pod coffee maker and a small fridge.  It would be helpful to have a microwave.  We are both tea drinkers and asked for a kettle and were advised they don't have any.  We were able to make tea a cup at a time by running water through the coffee maker.  I didn't like that the conference room smelled of the smoke from the casino below.  If I can do a separate review on the "spa" I will, but there is no spa, just a room for massage, which was not great. The pool area is lovely with comfy chairs and the pool is nicely heated so I enjoyed swimming, even in December.  Hot tub was great.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel.
reviews.text: The suites are set up with several buildings throughout the property. The property is very green with lots of planting.  The property is located centrally and within a couple of blocks from the main strip.Each suite is very spacious, as you can see from my attached pictures. There is a casino attached to the property.

reviews.title: What a nice property!
reviews.text: We spent the night here on Dec 5, booking 2 rooms for ourselves and friends traveling with us.  Both rooms lived up to the description completely!  They were truly HUGE!  And VERY quiet.  The beds were comfortable, albeit not 'new' but nothing to complain about either.  Bathroom was big and had a shower and a seperate tub, very uncommon anymore in hotel rooms.  We could have used a couple extra towels but I should have asked when checking in.  Everything was really nice.  No lines and we didn't have to walk through a casino to get to the lobby - a big PLUS for me.  We parked right out front and had absolutely no issues at all.  I would absolutely recommend this place if wanting something off the strip with great prices - book on their website, it's cheaper than the 3rd party apps.We ate at the Pub - decent prices and a great happy hour too! For breakfast we ate at Marilyns, equally had decent prices and quick service.  The pool and hot tub were closed, which was too bad, I really wanted to check them out.  Next time!We walked to and from the strip.  There were a lot of people doing the same.  We walked back to the hotel about 10pm and there were no sketch people anywhere we saw.

reviews.title: Great place to stay.
reviews.text: Stayed for three nights on a trip to see U2 at the sphere. I was really glad I stayed a bit off the strip with the F1 construction in full force. This hotel was very quiet comfortable and clean. The pool area was lovely. Room was big and everything was functional. Check in and out were easy. Liked that the casino was set apart so you didn’t have to walk through it. Only complaint was that it was hard to get something to drink by the pool in the afternoon. Nothing was open except for inside the casino.

reviews.title: Think twice about staying at Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites is on the edge of a seedy area and there were sketchy individuals walking past this property at all hours of the day and night. My car was parked in the lot along Flamingo Ave and I discovered that during the night someone tried to pry open its trunk, leaving obvious damage. I informed the manager on duty and she didn’t seemed surprised, just told me parking there was at my own risk and to go down the hall and file a report with security, which I didn’t see any advantage of doing. If I could do it over I’d book a hotel closer to the Strip which offered a parking garage so my car would be safer. Beware!

reviews.title: Rest near the Strip
reviews.text: A wonderfully laid back hotel in the middle of the city. The suites are located in different low-rise buildings. Nice spacious rooms. The pool is very relaxed and there is a nice cafe with good coffee and breakfasts to take away. The casino is next door, you don't walk through it at all. It is a lot quieter and nicer than the gigantic hotels on the strip. It's only a 10-minute walk to the hustle and bustle there.

reviews.title: Good stays at Tuscany
reviews.text: When I was moving I stayed off an on at the Tuscany Suites. I felt it was an excellent hotel. Spacious rooms, comfortable beds, up-to-date TVs, nice sofas. Overall great. My only complaint was I couldn't bring my dog with me. Went to the swimming pool, nice. Had margaritas at pool side. For breakfast I was able to get croissants (although they serve other things) and latte at their cafe. I also ate breakfast in their restaurant. The cost was reasonable and the staff was great.

reviews.title: USS Grayback Reunion
reviews.text: The room was very large and more than adequate for our stay.  The coffee maker was a nice feature that was used.  We did not need to use the frig with so many eating places nearby. The large bathroom was nicely arranged with a separate door for the stool, separate tub and shower and an adequate wash sink.

reviews.title: Very nice stay
reviews.text: Comfortable room. The bed had the right amount of firmness. We had a delicious breakfast at Marilyn's Cafe located inside the casino. Great central location, just off the strip. Parking was available just outside the building we stayed in. They had several buildings that were on the property. We stayed in Building N. It had a resort-type look to it.

reviews.title: Off-strip fine
reviews.text: We arrived around 6pm. Had done pre-check-in online and the queue wasn't long. There was some confusion about resort fees and credit card hold. We only stayed one night as it was close to our event - a 15-min walk to the Sphere. Room was spacious and clean. Staff around lobby were friendly and helpful - more so than at other Strip hotels we stayed at.

reviews.title: A great time.
reviews.text: My room was very large with sitting area,  kitchen table, fridge and wet bar. The bathroom had a standup shower as well as a tub. The room was very clean. The pool area was nice and relaxing. I liked that the casino was small and not so noisy like the strip. I would recommend if you want to be a little bit away from strip. I will definitely book again. I tried for December but they were full.

reviews.title: Reunion
reviews.text: Someone opened our door and started to walk in. I yelled door shut and a voice said sorry checking phones. Front desk didn't know anything about that. Wife was filled by someone after she wouldn't let them into the gym. Told maintenance guys and he ran off. Room smelled of alcohol each time we walked in.

reviews.title: Super Oasis in the middle of Vegas!
reviews.text: We hold our Reunion and Memorial for Black Lions here every year because the personnel are so friendly and the prices at the various restaurants are not inflated like at other Strip Hotels. The Bell Captain (Sonny) was unbelievably helpful at a high stress situation and deserves a commendation. Daiwa, the pool waitress, is one of the nicest and most cheerful and helpful employees anyone could hope for. I love this place and so do my Viet Nam Buddies from 28th Infantry Regiment of the 1st Infantry Division. God Bless you all.

reviews.title: For an atmosphere like in the south
reviews.text: Beautiful suite and above all clean. Affordable restaurants with daily menu. Welcoming casino. 10 minutes from the strip. Everything is easy to access. Beautiful landscaping with palm trees and lots of landscaping. Very pleasant. Do not hesitate to choose this location.

reviews.title: A full house of amenities
reviews.text: Very pleased with the Tuscany --from the rooms and all the other amenities the resort has to offer.  One hardly needs to leave the premises as everything from food to entertainment is available, not to mention a beautify pool environment and exercising room for those that like to keep in shape.

reviews.title: Nice quiet place.
reviews.text: I checked in Online and let it be known that it was our anniversary.  When I arrived I was asked for all IDs again and told no rooms would be available until 3 PM.  At 4 PM we got our room, no mention of our anniversary and were charged an additional $150 damage deposit.  This is the 3rd time we are staying with you, we are Henderson residents and retirees.  No other hotel anywhere in the US ever charged us a damage fee.  Yes it was reversed but it makes your hotel appear to be an unsafe place to stay.  Also why would I bother to do anything online and then have to do it all over again when I arrive?  Know your customer.

reviews.title: Good hotel but nuisances which spoiled our stay
reviews.text: The hotel is huge like most hotels in Vegas and a little off the strip. The rooms are very spacious, not very modern but very pleasant with a large bathroom. The bedding is quality. Unfortunately when we were there we had a very noisy first room, door slamming constantly, infernal elevator noise every 5 minutes. We asked to change rooms but despite the change it was still noisy due to the air conditioner and the day and night exterior work in connection with next month's Formula 1 event. No insulation. We barely slept for 3 days. This is why I cannot give more than 3 stars even if the value for money for Vegas is good.

reviews.title: Overall fun!
reviews.text: As always we had a great time at one of our favorite hotel casinos. The staff is always polite and unhelpful . The atmosphere, the gambling, and restaurants were all great. We had a awesome dinner at Tuscany Gardens which has great steaks and Italian dishes. The gaming floor was clean and inviting.

reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: Clean and comfortable off the strip casino with hospitable staff.  Food was good if a bit pricey but generous portions. Pool has cabanas and plenty of seating. Accommodating to my group of friends and family.

reviews.title: Memorable
reviews.text: Checkin service is fast. Staff are nice. The happiest thing is that the room is quite large. The place is quiet since casino is on the other side. It made me so relax at the moment when we were there.

reviews.title: NSLA
reviews.text: We come every year since 2019. Tuscany has been a great resort and venue. My favorite place to stay in Las Vegas. I prefer not to stay right on the strip and Tuscany has all the amenities I like for a comfortable, relaxing get away, whether it is business or extended stay for some fun.

reviews.title: Great smaller and quiet all-suites hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying in Tuscany Suites about a week ago in Las vegas. But I really liked about the hotel these days is that there's no gambling machine noise in the hotel portion of the hotel. The hotel is reasonably quiet and nicely appointed. The suite rooms are extremely good sized it would be good for a group of people.The price that I paid for the hotel was also extremely reasonable when compared to other properties located in a similar area.I've stayed here several times in the past but liked it enough this time that I was compelled to write a review.

reviews.title: Book here!
reviews.text: Not luxury rooms but the beds were nice and rooms were spacious. Pool area was nice. Just hate it closed at 10pm. There is a cafe on site for coffee and pastries at a reasonable price. The people were wonderful. Book here!

reviews.title: Fun, friendly and convenient
reviews.text: Had a really enjoyable stay at the Tuscany resort. The rooms are spacious and well maintained. The staff are very friendly, especially the team at Pub 365. The hotel is conveniently located just a few minutes walk from the main strip. Check-in and out were quick.  Overall a very pleasant stay away from the main hustle and bustle but close enough to be there in a few minutes.

reviews.title: Tuscany is yet to let me down
reviews.text: I have stayed at Tuscany several times now, during Vegas visits, and honestly speaking Tuscany is yet to let me down.  If you are sick of being treated like "just a number" by the major chains, and if you prefer a more relaxing and less crowded experience, then give Tuscany a try.  It's an old school and "treated like a person" kind of guest experience that I totally like.  And the property is very fairly priced for the room size and location, and very well maintained.  Oh, and by the way, the casino slots are usually set very fair when compared to strip properties.

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: Our weekend getaway! The best place to be! It’s 10 minutes walk from the central Las Vegas Strip.  Has comfortable rooms, free gym and parking. Has beautiful swimming pool and jacuzzi and great dining and entertainment.

reviews.title: Great little Gem - Locals Vibe
reviews.text: This place is a gem, if you are more laid-back and do not want the loud music pool party experience.They welcome families too, which was nice. We brought our toddler and had a great stay.The rooms were clean and big, and the bed was nice, although a little too firm for my liking. The only thing about our room is there was a little light that crept in from the window, that the curtains would not cover to the end past the window. That was my only annoyance, because I sleep in a blacked-out room at home. The food was great, I ordered a prime rib special from the diner downstairs, that was amazing. Breakfast the next morning was good too. And - I played slots, and won enough money to cover our expenses, so overall I was very happy with our visit!

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites has it all
reviews.text: This resort has it all- beautiful all around.  Peaceful, comfortable, clean with all the amenities you could ever want.  Sometimes you just do not want to be on the strip.  This is a perfect place to stay.

reviews.title: We had a great stay
reviews.text: We had an excellent stay at the Tuscany Suites. The rooms were spacious and clean. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because the towels are old and need to be replaced and we could have used a small microwave oven.  We tried the coffee shop, cafe and sports bar and had a lovely experience in each of them. The pool looked great but was very crowded.

reviews.title: Nice Trip to Vegas
reviews.text: Very large hotel complex. Sufficient parking spaces available free of charge. Very large room with separate seating area, desk, small kitchen with fridge. A coffee machine with pads is also available. The bed is very large and comfortable. Large bathroom with separate shower.Everything very clean. The entire complex and the hotel are very clean and well maintained. The staff is very friendly. The casino invites you to linger. Pub 365 is also very good. Large beer selection. The food is also very good. 10 min. walk to the Strip.

reviews.title: Upgrades needed
reviews.text: Room was a nice size, TV was too small for the room, no good cable channels, bathroom had some previous guest boxers & shirt left in there (nasty & trifling), no microwave 🙄🤔. Updates are needed bad

reviews.title: Won’t stay again
reviews.text: First room I was put in had spiders, even found a couple in my bed and in my pillow. I asked the front desk for a new room and the woman who was assisting me was very rude and said there were no rooms left for me to switch. She had an accent and long hair. Didn’t get her name. House keeping came and found another spider so I went back to the front desk 20 min later and the gentleman was very kind and immediately gave me a new room after she said there were no more rooms left for me to move to. I was offered to speak to a manager but never saw one. All the rooms are very outdated and smell like mildew. I won’t stay again. Especially after how the first woman treated me. Horrible attitude.

reviews.title: Great place. Mehh food.
reviews.text: Overall, it’s a great place. Good service, facilities, and location. Only negative is the food at Marilyn’s Cafe is  kinda mehh. Of course it’s priced accordingly, so I guess you get what you pay for!

reviews.title: A very pleasant  stay as always
reviews.text: As always, a very pleasant stay. Good breakfast at Marilyns Cafe with a very friendly staff. Some very minor remarks for room O206:- In the bedside lamp was one of the bulbs not working.- Make sure the correct amenities are placed and not 2 conditioners and no shampoo.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Reunion
reviews.text: We were at Tuscany for a reunion.  We arrived at 10:00 AM on a Monday morning.  I knew that we would not get a room at 10:00 AM, the ladies at the front desk said it would be 3:00PM before we could get our room.  I checked our bags with the bell hop and we walked to the strip.  Spent a few hours at the strip and returned to the hotel at 2:00 PM.  Our hospitality suite for the reunion was in building "G" so we had to get a key to allow us access to our hospitality suite and when we got the key to "G" I inquired about or room, still not ready.  I went to the hospitality suite and met up with 3 other couples for our reunion and to my surprise they had been assigned a room, and had just arrived at the hotel, now I wonder why I have been at the hotel 5 hours and still do not have a room.  I go back to the front desk, and I am told it will be 5:00 PM for my room, to say the least I was UPSET.  Asked to see a supervisor.  Explained the issue and it takes him about 5 minutes to find us a room and get us checked in.  We are assigned to building "J", so now we have two different set of keys.  Had to have key reloaded twice because the key for "G" kept failing and the key for "J" would only allow us entry on one end of the building.  We had plans for Friday morning late an early afternoon.  After breakfast around 9:30 we attempted to open the safe and it will not open "low battery warning" I contact the front desk and ask to have someone come open the safe, they send a Maintenace man.  He can't get the safe open and tells us they will have to force the safe open, after an hour wait another guy shows up and spends almost an hour attempting to force the door open, does not have the correct tools and has to go get more tools.  Come back and finally gets the safe open but the door is not no good.  The entire safe has to be replaced, third man shows up with a new safe and it takes almost an hour to replace the safe.  Bottom line we can finally leave the room at 2:30 PM and have lost all of our plans for the day.  I stayed at Tuscany every summer from 2000 to 2007 for a week and it was super.  This place has gone downhill in a hurry, Casino is a mess with only machines no live tables, restaurants are a mess, we went to 365 for dinner on Friday night, got a table and waited 35 minutes after we ordered and still had not received our DRINKS.  ONLY ONE WAITER, one bar tender and one bar back on a Friday Night ??????????.  It should have been a warning sign to me that there were only about 6 other customers in the place when we sat down.  Needless to say, we left and went elsewhere for dinner.Sorry Tuscany you are off of my list of places to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Steven's 21st Birthday
reviews.text: It was a clean and large room. We were accommodated with our room requests and had a great time!  The staff was wonderful and very nice.  They even remembered us as we walked through to the Casino and bantered with my son about turning 21. It was a great stay and the pool was perfect, including the towel and drink staff as well as clean restrooms near the pool.

reviews.title: Affordable, Friendly and Very Clean
reviews.text: Very Friendly Atmosphere Very Clean & QuietGuest Service was outstandingAll amenities were available on siteGreat location - Very Secure - Ample Parking - Rooms were spacious- Beds were very comfortable

reviews.title: Little gem off the Strip with human beings
reviews.text: We are normally used to the big names on the Strip in Vegas we were are attending every year an industry convention. Last year we really felt ripped off : crazy prices, attitude toward tips and loss in the quality in general made us feel really frustrated. so this year we tried something different : the Tuscany. And boy!! that was a very good call. The hotel is situated off the Strip but only 15/20 mins walk from Sands Expo, it is very good as in some massive hotels at a closer range, it takes you 10/15 mins to get out. So it's a match here. The hotel is full of coherence. By that, it stands for what it is and doesn't pretend otherwise thru plastic accessories. It is a very nice hotel : the rooms are big, clean and comfy, made daily thru a great team of cleaners always kind, the restaurants are good and offer excellent value for money, way above the big names. Kudos on the choice for local beers. The gym is well maintained and 24/7. We didn't try the pools but heard good things about them. The staff is very helpful, kind and laid back. This is the first time we are talking to knowledgeable people with a smile in a relaxed atmosphere - far from the pretending-to-be-exclusive fancy artificial places where an AI (maybe without the I) could run the show.  The bottom line is : if the Tuscany stays what it is  - a human managed / nice and very decent place to stay without the buzz and whistles - we will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Every time we stay at Tuscany it is Fantastic!!!!!!
reviews.text: Tuscany is a Great hotel! The Staff is Fantastic from Check in & House keeping is Great! Check out is easy & Facility's are super! I cannot say enough good things about Tuscany Suites & Casino!!!!! We stay at  Tuscany every couple years & it's always a Great Place to stay!!!!! No better place to stay in Las Vegas, Location Price & facility's & Staff are by far the best in Vegas!!!!

reviews.title: Hidden fees and security do not do there job.
reviews.text: When we checked in there were only two people helping. As I stood in line for about 15 minutes two other people walked up and broke in line to check out. They were told by a Gentleman that worked there that if they needed to see a clerk they had to wait. One did not and the receptionist still helped him even after the security guard let him have a free ride also. Everyone in line was not happy. Next the $46 a day resort fee is a joke. I have already paid you to stay there and now I am charged another $221. This hidden fee made my decision about ever coming back to your resort.

reviews.title: Grayback reunion. We have had several thee at Tuscany and will return in 2025.
reviews.text: The front desk help with keys they kept deactivating each day and I’d go to desk and they reprogrammed them. Marilyn’s restaurant was a regular to get things I could eat with my eating disorder. Was visiting during ur 40th anniversary and attended the Rat Pack program. Another fabulous display of talent.

reviews.title: Hidden gem in Vegas
reviews.text: Very happy with everything. Friendly and helpful staff. Everything perfectly clean. They let us check in earlier which was very appreciated after 3 nights of camping. Breakfast was delicious. Room very spacious and a bathtub was a nice little bonus. Definitely coming back

reviews.title: great hotel at a good price
reviews.text: hotel with casino among the palm trees, excellent location - very close to the main streets in the center, comfortable rooms, nice interior of the hotel, nice and helpful service, relaxation at the pool

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: We stayed here whilst in Vegas for a couple of nights. Apart from us getting lost a couple times (I can’t follow map directions) the complex was perfect. It isn’t too far from the strip but far enough away to not hear the hustle and bustle. Our bedroom was large and comfortable with coffee making facilities and a fridge. The bathroom was clean and tidy and well laid out. We loved staying here and will be back on our next adventure to Vegas. We never got to use the pool, but it was always busy in there and looked absolutely lovely

reviews.title: The staff makes all the difference
reviews.text: The staff is exceptional. The desk staff was so helpful and kind. The bar staff were friendly without going overboard.I had a beautiful room with a view of the pool and as a solo traveler the presence of uniformed security was reassuring.

reviews.title: This place is great!
reviews.text: We love the Italian restaurant here. Food was amazing and the Rat pack is back did not disappoint. Love the hotel.  It was clean and large rooms to relax in.  Pool was great after a lot of walking.  We became rewards members and received free coffee and discounts for the resort. Great view of the sphere

reviews.title: Enjoy play slots there n eating
reviews.text: The rooms are very nice and clean. The outside of the hotel was very nice the staff there were very helpful and friendly like the food at the pub and Maryland’s. There are a lot of parking stalls and overall nice environment.

reviews.title: Exceeded Expecations
reviews.text: Beautiful grounds, pool, fire tables.Spacious and functional room with large refrigerator and the windows open 🙌Very professional and attentive staff.Very clean with regular cleaning of common areas.Great dining options.Felt safe with active security presence.We didn't have to leave the place for anything.

reviews.title: FUN
reviews.text: ENJOYED MY STAY . COMFORTABLE CASE AND GREAT CAFE . UTS A REAKKT NICE PLACE TO HAVE FUN AND STAY. PARKING COULD  USE MORELIGHTING SOME PLACES ARE SUPER DARKIN THE BACK.COFFEE SHOP IN THE MORNING HAS THE BEST OATMEAL AND I MEAN THE BEST. 'ONE OF MY FAVORITE PLACES TO BE

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: We loved this resort so much we didn’t leave for four days. We met many amazing humans, both guests and employees alike. We aren’t really Vegas people but we will return to the Tuscany Suites for sure

reviews.title: Fun and relaxing.
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites is the place to stay when you want to save and pay for the value you get.I love staying at The Tuscany. The rooms are big enough and very comfortable. This place has all the amenities you need. Multiple bars and restaurants. The atmosphere is clean. They have two pools and a gym. The Tuscany is a half mile from the strip but definitely walking distance. This is the place to stay.

reviews.title: Stuck in the back
reviews.text: They put me in a building in the ass-end of the parking lot.  Every morning at 6am I was awakened by the F1 bleachers being built.  Pretty awful all things given.  And they don't use toilet seals so sitting on a toilet at this place is a little bit like a rocking chair.   My third or 4th stay here, and I’ve pretty much had my limit of tomfoolery.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: I have stayed at The Tuscany for over 20 years. Everyone is so welcoming and friendly, beautiful relaxing hotel. The casino hostesses are amazing, food at Marlyn, 365 pub is good. Tuscany Gardens Italian restaurant is beautiful, definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: mediocre
reviews.text: The fire alarm went off in the middle of the night.  Our room was not made up on two separate days.The facility did not have a concierge.  Prices were high for the quality of the facility.  The Coffee in the room was mediocre.

reviews.title: A great reunion venue!
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and efficient. The rooms are very spacious and nicely decorated. The price of the rooms for our reunion was great! I thought the food was very good for a banquet, although Elvis French Toast made me chuckle.All in all, a good time.

reviews.title: High school reunion
reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay for our high school reunion. Rooms were clean and the room was cleaned daily. Restaurant prices were a little steep but then again this is Las Vegas. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who asked me about where would be a good place to sty.

reviews.title: Family
reviews.text: The trip was to celebrate my husband 79th birthday. The bathroom did not  have enough t towels for 4 adults We had double beds full queen very small and sheet not fitted to bed very loose . The room was clean . I only had an issues with the beds

reviews.title: Always have a great time here
reviews.text: I personally love everything about this hotel i use to stay here with my family when I was younger and now I bring my family here. Amazing food love how the pool is open until 10 pm here. I love how close it is to new sphere it has the perfect view

reviews.title: Tuscany was unorganized and didn't care about the customer
reviews.text: Felt like Tuscany was unorganized and didn't care about the customer.When I tried checking in, they didn't have a room for me in the same building in my group. They said the building (J) was closed (even though I had people in my group already checked in there), and wanted to put me in another building for a night before moving me to building J. Also, my phone in my room didn't work, so they couldn't give me wake up calls. Ants in the room too.

reviews.title: Money taken from my room, spiders and cockroaches
reviews.text: The worst hotel experience I’ve ever had. So many things went wrong with my stay. And the some front desk was not kind or accommodating. I was here for a week long seminar and many of us in the group had issues

reviews.title: Would come back again!
reviews.text: This is such a nice, lush, and quiet property close to the strip!  We really enjoyed our deluxe queen suite.  Clean, nice bedding, ample pillows.  We especially loved the private commode area so someone can still get ready in the shower or at the bath vanity.  Only two drawbacks were that the ice machine on our floor didn't work, so had to take the elevator to the 1st floor.  Also, the jacuzzi hot tub was not heated.  We looked forward to that but it was cold water.

reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: The rooms are huge, beautiful and clean love being off the strip, but it’s so close to walk to it. Your hotel has everything we needed restaurants coffee, shops, fire tables, bars, pools, and the casino will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Good Value, Off-Strip, Big Rooms and Great Staff
reviews.text: This property is a good value if you want a low-key off-strip stay. We selected this property to be within walking distance of the Sphere, as we were in town for a concert. It was a fairly easy walk from Tuscany to the Sphere up Koval. There is an AM/PM mini market up the block for snacks and drinks. The room was clean and spacious. We were on the second floor and could hear heavy clomping of foot steps from the room above. Maybe request a top floor room if you are sensitive to noise. We visited the pool one day and it was a nice environment. Plenty of chairs and a towel attendant. They do have drink service at the pool and the server was friendly. Overall, a low-key relaxing vibe at the pool. Not a hip, party spot, which was perfect for us!We ate at Marilyn's Cafe for breakfast one morning and it was a good value with very friendly staff. Also had grab and go salads from the little coffee bar and they were very fresh and tasty.Front desk staff was friendly and accommodated our early check in request. We had also noted that when we pre-registered via the email message they sent the day before.We walked to and from shows on the Strip including after midnight. It felt safe walked, especially because there is a lot of F1-related construction on Koval and Sands, so a big construction present and also police. Final comment ... if you want to be in the glitzy mix of the strip, this is not the spot for you. It's about a 20 minute walk to the strip. If you want a good value, low-key, chill spot that is clean and friendly ... this is the spot for you.

reviews.title: Feels Like a Tropical Getaway
reviews.text: We were three friends staying in one room in this older hotel.  The room was huge, well-equipped, clean and well-maintained, as was the entire property. The staff were friendly and efficient.  Extra special was the outdoor pool area, which felt like a tropical getaway.   Although very close to the Strip, this hotel felt like an escape from the Las Vegas madness. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites - Our New Favorite Stay
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites provides a respite from the madness. Just a couple blocks off the Strip, it’s close to everything. It’s also elegantly quiet. A tasteful refuge if you’re looking for some sanity. This is not to say stodgy. There’s a lovely bar area just off the lobby, with adjacent outdoor seating. It offered a break from the mania. Adding to the quiet is that the Casino is located in a separate building, but just a few yards away. Our large rooms were nicely decorated, and perfectly clean. We appreciated our room’s living space / kitchen area.  Bathroom included stall shower, tub, and separate water closet. Rooms are located in low-rise, two story buildings set among well-landscaped and maintained European garden style grounds. Multiple restaurants on site, including coffee bar, diner style coffee shop and high-end dinner house. Finally, our group agreed the staff was excellent, in particular Carolina at front desk. Our compliments on high degree of gracious service and true hospitality.

reviews.title: OK stay at Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: Hotel was nice. Rooms are big, and clean. Casino was good, and Circa sports book Kiosk on site is a nice bonus. The pool was nice, but kind of small and not enough chairs.  Stay away from Building M.  it's the farthest from the front desk, and it's very noisy with F1 construction going on 24 hours a day. Very loud at night!

reviews.title: Quite, relaxing and ideal getaway
reviews.text: Staff was helpful and courteous the whole time especially when I locked myself out the room and needed new key.  Security was hardly noticed yet I felt secure the whole time.    Bravo  definitely Will come back

reviews.title: Fabulous for extended stay.
reviews.text: Loved my room, spacious and clean. Loved the hotel overall. Nice pool, gift shop and restaurants.  Could hear people upstairs a bit easily.  Had a clogged sink drain but was fixed quickly. Overall very happy.

reviews.title: Triple check your reservation, get names of people you speak with.
reviews.text: I would have given 5 stars had the hotel provided what I had requested upon making my reservation. I made a online reservation. I followed it up with a phone call to confirm I’d be able to have a ground floor room, due to medical reasons and not able to use elevator. The gentleman on phone said it being added to the reservation request. I made my reservations 30+ days in advance. When we checked in, they only had a 3rd floor room, and said I could not access stairs from outside.  I will not be able to stay here again unless they provide ground floor. Overall, hotel was pleasant. Front desk manager at checkout said she’d comp me one night stay due to the mix-up. My bill charges don’t reflect the credit yet, so not sure that was even done.

reviews.title: Tuscany suites
reviews.text: Room was large and clean. Engineering had to fix mini fridge (froze over), but never addressed water leaking from shower door. Had to ask for microwave at front desk. Also Had to ask/get coffee pods every day of week long stay rather than getting enough at one time.

reviews.title: Definitely recommend
reviews.text: Great customer service and very nice room. Loved the size of room and everything hotel had to offer. Fantastic restaurants inside and beautiful landscaping. Nice and quiet right off the strip. Definitely recommend!!

reviews.title: High school reunion
reviews.text: Great time. Room was spacious and clean. Staff was helpful and amicable. Pool was great. The cabana that we rented was great. Amenities were very nice towels and the area were nice. Casino was very cool and enjoyable.

reviews.title: Convenient location and good value
reviews.text: Good location for our stay. I was competing in the Nevada Senior Games at UNLV, so the location couldn't have been better! We walked across the street to Panera Bread, Fogo de Chao, etc. Also, we enjoyed Marilyn's, Pub 365 three times, and the Bottega for coffee and breakfast in the mornings. Hotel was quiet, great room service and nice, spacious fitness room

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites & Casino has large rooms, comfortable beds and cushions, and fresh towels every day. As requested, we stayed in a quiet part of the hotel, and we didn't hear anything from the neighboring rooms. There are several restaurants and a bar/pub in the Tuscany. We always had breakfast at Cafe Marilyn's and had dinner once. The portions are huge and the coffee was excellent. The staff at Cafe Marilyn's were very friendly, attentive and always in a good mood; we felt comfortable. We spent 4 nights in the Tuscany. The location is also perfect, only about 15 minutes walk to the Strip and about 15 minutes to the Sphere (visiting this was the reason for our trip). I would stay there again anytime.

reviews.title: Great space; extra fees charged
reviews.text: Large room with excellent amenities; the bathroom was luxurious, only helpful addition would be a microwave. One bad taste was the additional $45/ per night resort fee which was a surprise at check in.

reviews.title: Amazing family trip
reviews.text: Our stay was excellent ,our rooms were very clean and spacious, beds comfortable,the service and staff was amazing , very polite at front desk and felt very safe the area is very convenient neat the strip and not dangerous at all , family hotel vibe .will come back definitely !

reviews.title: The jack of all trades
reviews.text: Excellent distance off the strip 10 minute walk. Great sushi/liquor store/hair and nails directly across the street. The restaurant is intimate and romantic at night, great food. Bar tenders are friendly and make stiff drinks. The pool is clean. Rooms were spacious. It was nice to have the mini fridge for leftovers and drinks during our stay. House keeping was always on it! New towels/ a fresh bed bath toiletries every day! Zero complaints. Price was right, place was clean, very quiet I slept amazing. I even won a few times in the casino. 10/10 will stay with Tuscany again.  I could see this place working for couples, tourist, family,  and business type trips it’s the jack of all trades and will fit into whatever Vegas vibe your feeling that day

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Very clean and spacious rooms. Many amenities available on site. Within walking distance to many places, especially the Sphere. Also next door to the upcoming Grand Prix. Would recommend to family and friends. Bonus is that you don’t have to walk through the casino to get to room or restaurants!

reviews.title: Great play to stay
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites and Casino is by far our favorite place to stay when we are in Las Vegas for business.  Tuscany is very accommodating and has all of the amenities we need to enjoy our stay.  The staff is very friendly and professional.  It is always a pleasure to stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel, right across from everything
reviews.text: Our stay was great, the front entrance was amazing. The guest were great, but I requested a coffee maker because my room did not have one. I had to call them twice on my phone because my room phone wasn’t working. When they did bring me the coffee maker it did not work and o never got my coffee ☕️, so bum.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Very quiet and relaxing Staff were very helpful and approachable smiles all around The cafe was very delightful and service was outstanding and the food was very tasteful Will definitely be returning

reviews.title: Good value for money.
reviews.text: The room is large and quite comfortable with room for a couch, dining table and two beds.  But the room and bathroom are quite dim, particularly the bathroom.  Also the sink is small so you end up splashing water a lot.  The shower is tight as well which is ironic given how large the room is.  But for families with children, it's nice as there is a full size bath in the bathroom as well.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Super attentive, very quiet hotel in the middle of all the Las Vegas party, ideal to rest and be calm after a whole day of pure partying, the cleaning service was every day

reviews.title: Great stay spoilt by unreturned deposit and extra charges to be paid on arrival.
reviews.text: A pleasant stay marred by being asked on check in for a $150 retention especially for a 75 year old pensioner, not returned on check out and still not returned two weeks later and a resort charge not expected in the price. I will be contacting my travel agent Travel Republic to seek return of these unexpected charges. Las Vegas receives many overseas tourists from countries where the price you pay includes all charges, but it is a nasty shock. I also complained about a continuous hum in my suite which was not dealt with.However Tuscany Suites was a great place to stay, huge room with effective air con, pleasant staff, great surroundings and location and reasonably priced restaurants. European and Asian  visitors do not expect extra charges on check in when in other countries this would not happen

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Fast check, attentive staff, great room, wonderful bed. Pool area is clean and has wait staff. Casino has nice brewpub with good selections. Casino is small but good variety of games. Smoking casino with small non smoking area

reviews.title: Couples left with nothing…..
reviews.text: I didn’t get the room I reserved on the Internet,, just felt like my needs wasn’t met. I wanted to propose to my girl and why did I had to pay more when they didn’t give me what I wanted. I travel from Oregon and they didn’t care….

reviews.title: Great trip!
reviews.text: Great place!  Room was very nice and clean. Bed was very comfortable.  Late night food at the pub was very good.  Pool area was nice.  Close to the strip and all the fun.   We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great family trip.
reviews.text: Check-in was quick and easy.  Rooms were extra large, extra clean and extra relaxing.  All of the restaurants were perfect.  Location is walkable to what we had on our agenda.  We even preferred to stay at the Tuscany and just chill.  It was a great trip.  The youngest two travelers, 15 and 10 said they missed it as soon as we left.  We will be back for sure.

reviews.title: Tuscany earned an A+ from me.
reviews.text: Superb service and accommodations. Clean, spacious and ample/free parking. When the refrigerator and television had some very minor issues, a service tech arrived in a flash. Another stellar stay, as usual.

reviews.title: Great Spot right off the strip but still close enough to many casinos.
reviews.text: Very roomy suite. I always try to book this hotel when possible. The casino is without table games, but we were so close to other casinos where we could play. Great spot! Our suite had a couch folding bed as well, so it could have fit 4 people if needed.

reviews.title: Cars stolen and broken into
reviews.text: Cars stolen from hotel as well as cars being damaged and broken into. Rude security and uncooperative management. Don’t stay at this hotel if you want a pleasant stay in Vegas. This hotel also requires you to be inside after dark.

reviews.title: Nice hotel close to the strip
reviews.text: We had a nice time at Tuscany! Our room was big and we could parc our RV almost next to the building. The staff was nice, friendly and helpful, too.  We can also recommend the food in the 365 Pub and went to the Casino, before we left. The pool area looked nice, too. Sadly we had no time to enjoy ourselves over there.

reviews.title: Comfy and Inexpensive
reviews.text: Excellent place to stay for an awesomely reasonable price. The room was clean and very roomy. It is close to the Strip, as well. There is a large bed, and a sofa that can be made into a bed if you should have overnight guests. Coffee machine with coffee pods are a serious plus!

reviews.title: Overall a great stay
reviews.text: Check in was quick and easy, food at Marilyn’s Cafe and Pub 365 was excellent, and our king suite was perfect. There were two thing that dropped the score from 5 to 4. First, being located in the last room at the far end of our floor in the back corner of the property (N building). It’s almost as far back as you can go. And the only entrance is in the back of the building. And we were at the furthest room on our floor. So we had to walk to the other end of the hallway, to the elevator, to the one door. There are stairs at the end we were at. But they lead down to an emergency exit you can’t use for normal entry and exit. We did learn after the first day, it’s a shorter trip to the pool, casino, and dining options, to take take your car around to the front and walk. Second was the wine selection at Marilyn’s Cafe. We would expect restaurants at a casino or fine hotel to have at least some wine options other than small individual serving bottles of Sutter Home. The prime rib dinner we had was fantastic, and deserved a better wine pairing than that. I know these are probably little things to a lot of people. But some might feel the same. All in all it’s still a great place to stay, and one of the more reasonable rates in town.

reviews.title: Beautiful place to stay.
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. Very well keep property. The pool is well-kept and clean. Spa was at a perfect temperature. We actually won a decent amount of money in the casino here. We will definitely be back to stay at this hotel.. We had a wonderful time.

reviews.title: This is always our number one choice when staying in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Usually for business, sometimes for pleasure, we prefer the Tuscany hotel and casino for several reasons; it is consistently good, every time. It is clean. I am aware that when staying at a hotel, someone else probably stayed in the same room the night before - but I don't want any evidence of that. It is a good value, Just a mile or two from the strip it is often half the price of some of the popular hotels on the strip. Friendly, helpful staff. In an age where customer service is usually just lip service - if you are lucky - these guys and gals are pleasant and professional. On the rare occasions there have been issues, they are always handled promptly and satisfactorily. My only suggestion for the management; your staff is busy and there are many guests that need attention. We had a small problem upon check-in that was quickly handled, but while the gentleman with whom I spoke was very good at fixing problems, I felt he never really listened to me. Listening is key in customer service and it only takes a few seconds to achieve.

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: I usually stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino because the suites are really nice and clean. The in house coffee shop always makes great coffee and the staff in every dept are always friendly and helpful.  I love the property being just a short walk to the strip and the ease of asking for things if needed. THIS visit, however, has almost lost my favortism due to a dirty bathroom counter, I won't specify anymore there.  The AC  was loud and not functioning and the tv remote wouldn't work.  We called for help and the AC and remote were tended to but the maintenance person dropped a screw, I stepped on it barefoot then my friend stepped on a bobby pin same evening. Thankfully we weren't injured. The outdoors of the resort are always immaculate and with the outdoor pools, it's a very nice place to relax. Food is excellent in all the eateries too. I would love to give 5 star, but this visit was barely 4.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel for trips to Las Vegas Strip & MSG Sphere
reviews.text: Excellent hotel which is ideally located if you are visiting Las Vegas Strip or MSG Sphere. The hotel facilities are great, the rooms are spacious and well decorated, the onsite restaurant has excellent food and the hotel's casino also has its own restaurant.

reviews.title: Very convenient
reviews.text: Exceptional good. Good service. very exceptional good food good service parking was amazing front desk was helpful casino was clean food was excellent services all together great I would invite family and friends to stay I would recommend it to all my friends at work

reviews.title: Big room - have to take elevator
reviews.text: Great hotel - mildly annoying that you cannot walk upstairs - you have to take the elevatorNice big room, friendly staff - everything else was great - cafe was decent, but we found better breakfast a short walk away

reviews.title: Wonderful stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: Very large room! Great to have kitchenette area, full couch, chair and dining table! Friendly staff. We loved the pool and location away from the busy strip. Still close enough to walk to the action if desired.

reviews.title: Great amenities and amazing staff
reviews.text: The customer service and amenities at the hotel were excellent. We went to every restaurant during our stay and enjoyed the casino as well. Our servers at the Tuscany Gardens was amazing, his name was Kevin. My husband and I had agreed it was the best dining experience we ever had! Also my daughter and I spent the day at pool and our waitress, Davia I believe her name was, she was absolutely phenomenal and made she we had everything we needed througout the entire day. All of the staff were very friendly and helpful. Our only issues were there were two light bulbs flickering in the hotel room    And when I asked a maid for a light bulb she said the hotel didn’t have any 😳 Also the beds were not As comfortable as I had hoped. But we would like to stay there again  and we would likely get a room with bigger beds to help our own comfort.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Relaxing place. We enjoyed our stay here. It is just blocks off the strip, but that makes it much more calming and tranquil. It is clean and staff is very welcoming. We stayed 2 days here and then headed off for a week of hiking. After that, we came back to Las Vegas for 2 more nights and had a horrible night at another establishment, so luckily, we were able to get a room here and ended our vacation on a good note. We would recommend Tuscany Suites!

reviews.title: Cleanliness
reviews.text: Rooms and property could have been a little cleaner.  I use to stay here every week a couple of years ago.  Property maintenance and cleanliness has gone down hill.  For the price that we paid for weekend stay…I’ll be looking into other options next time.

reviews.title: Clean, spacious, great customer service
reviews.text: The hotel was nice for the price and nice trees and walkways. Good location close to downtown, great customer service, they helped me with a microwave that I needed in minutes and nice swimming pools and jacuzzis with clean water.

reviews.title: NIce enough room
reviews.text: There was a long line up on check in and only two people working the desk.  The room itself was clean and a nice size, shower was nice , the fan in the bathroom was very noisy.  The big issues was that well we were there the temp was around 100 all three days.  The A/C in the room could not keep the room below 75

reviews.title: Relax
reviews.text: I am happy with the hotel and the parking lot is very convenient that I can park my car and walk to the room and that's the way I like. Another thing is be a slot machine. You got to have like a lot of new one but it's okay and to be honest that's what it is.. I'll tell you the way it is. Thank you

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Easy check in, love the rooms and amenities. Great staff and the grounds are kept up very well. Always look forward to coming back. Very close to where we have to go and there is plenty of parking. Try it!

reviews.title: Happy experience
reviews.text: The room was large and super clean.  The king-sized bed was comfortable and plenty of pillows provided.  I enjoyed having a 24-hr. breakfast menu available -- food was delicious! Beautiful landscaping added value to my stay.

reviews.title: Quiet and near the strip
reviews.text: We stayed here for four nights in early October.  check in was good , nice and fast and girls on desk polite and professional.The suite was clean and large.  We ate at Marilyns cafe and the food was good and reasonable price .The casino had very little atmosphere and like so many, we ended up playing at nearby Ellis Island and The Silver Sevens.   This maybe because all the table games have gone.   the casino we felt was a bit tight too.Tuscany, has lovely gardens with a few small pools and is a good place to relax and unwind.The Strip itself is about 20 mins walk away.I have to say i was a bit disappointed by the rude girl behind the counter in the coffee shop on Tuesday evening around 8pm, her manners and sarcasm toward the chap in front of me was down right rude to say the least.Apart from that, it was all in all a good stay and if you want a quiet off strip property, then this is the place. beware though ,of the  resort fee of nearly $50 with tax per night that will be added to you're room.

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: We loved our stay everything was perfect clean rooms area staff was amazing casino was great and clean. Good good food and gift shop was so great I bought several items. Our stay was fantastic with Tuscany.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: It was a beautiful stay, I loved everything about it there. Room was amazing!!! Everyone even security was very nice. I was so relaxed and enjoyed myself (didn’t win any more tho lol) but really enjoyed my four night stay.

reviews.title: We'll be back!
reviews.text: My husband attended the 2023 TBMA Conference at Tuscany, so we booked a room to stay there for a few additional days.   Although we visit Vegas frequently, we'd never stayed here, but are looking forward to doing it again.  Not only was Rm J214 HUGE & very clean, but in a quieter wing.  Staff we encountered at check-in and throughout the grounds, casino, etc were all extremely pleasant & helpful, actually appearing to care that guests were having a good time.  We didn't require maid service, but when inquiring  if we could pick up a few extra coffee pkts for me while he was at meetings, it wasn't 5 minutes before someone knocked at our door with some. Grounds were well manicured with 2 pools & of complimentary parking.  Location was close for walks to the Strip and/or to see the new Sphere & we appreciated the minifridge to chill our wine.  Good eateries onsite or nearby as well.  Extremely reasonable for Vegas, even with the resort fee.

reviews.title: The Tuscany Suites and Casino, Home from Home!
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino, an ‘Oasis in The Desert’.  A welcoming well run, warm and friendly place to stay where Team Members offer guests a great experience. The resort offers plenty of amenities from Fine Dining at Tuscany Gardens to Cafes with all tastes catered for.  Pub 365 offers you an amazing choice of world class beers and great food also. Great live entertainment in the Copa Room where Martini Happy Hour and appetizers are offered. The rooms are amazing offering you space to relax and sleep before you enjoy the pool, lounge hotel entertainment, stopping for a conference, or a trip to the strip, which is close by before you do some gambling!  The Tuscany Suites and Casino, really is the only place to stay in Las Vegas, value for money and the all-round guest experience cannot be beaten.

reviews.title: Great location, clean room, friendly staff, what more could you ask for?
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our three-night stay. Staff were all friendly. The breakfast cafe had great food at a good price. The room was spacious and clean. They brought new towels and made the bed every day. The pool was very nice -- clean and perfect temperature with enough chairs for everyone. I really like the location - quiet and close enough to walk to the Strip but not part of that crazy scene. We'll stay here again for sure.

reviews.title: I love staying at the Tuscany
reviews.text: Rooms are clean, cleaning service is fantastic! My only disappointment is the the carpet in the hallway smells really bad and the floor squeeks so I could hear the people above me walking around.  I stayed in Building C room 210.

reviews.title: Avg stay
reviews.text: The room was very far, the hotel is only busy with making money. Hotel need to see if older people are there and provide some assistance . Parking was free which is good. The casino was very average and was ok

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: Very clean and comfortable hotel. Not a giant skyscraper but rather a smaller more intimate setting. Swimming pool. Very nice- clean -and hot tub. Beds very comfortable. Italian restaurant on site. Fantastic. Late night bar very convenient. Ideal location.

reviews.title: So relaxing!
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  Great service.   Coffee shop had the best avocado toast!  Large comfortable room.  Amazing massage at the Spa.  Gym was large and had a good variety of equipment.  Perfectly located a little off the strip.

reviews.title: Old world charm
reviews.text: You can walk to the strip without the traffic hassle. Rooms are big, clean, and comfy. Restaurants  are nice and reasonable. Good sized casino. Beautiful grounds. We always stay here and are never disappointed.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: I absolutely will stay at this hotel again! Very beautiful, very clean and the staff was very nice. We had a group function and they accommodated us all. The rooms are very spacious. They 100% take care of there guests.

reviews.title: Private getaway with myself and spouse.
reviews.text: Fantastic property rooms were nice amenities were great. I did not feel like we were staying in a hotel it was more of a small villa. Nice pool great restaurant. Walking distance to the strip as well as easy access for ride assist to other Las Vegas attractions.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: Large spacious rooms, very clean, well kept property, restaurant choices on property are great. Close walking distance to the strip, but also good restaurants near resort.We are not really Vegas people but drove down from Edmonton and used Vegas as a basecamp to go see attractions outside of vegas

reviews.title: Big suites!
reviews.text: Really nice big suites with a mini fridge, and free parking. About a 10 min walk to the strip. Small casino with video gambling games, no tables, but it was nice and not crowded. Great food at the Pub and Marilyn’s Cafe.  Our room had a view of the new Sphere which was nice. Good location. We’d stay here again.

reviews.title: More than I expected
reviews.text: Rooms are comfortable exceeded my expectations easy to drive in and out with my truck and trailer... good spot for family and friends to get away, peaceful and quiet spot not far from the strip and near good restaurants!

reviews.title: Family vacations
reviews.text: Super quiet place for a good rest, my brother and I spent about a week in Tuscany and our experience was as expected. Super recommend for a family or a business trip.Keep going on with the good service

reviews.title: Customer Service not there strong point
reviews.text: The card reader for the door had a bad battery... so we were locked out of the room. Walked to front desk and they rescanned the cards and said they would call maintenance. Walked back to the room, waiting 30 mins before walking back to the front desk. Blah blah blah... "we dispatched maintenance" but I guess we were NOT a priority. Walked back to the room, 15 mins later maintenance showed up. They tried their fob with no luck. "We have to call security." No battery swap, no physical key? Another 15 mins security shows up and uses their fob and it opens.. 1 hour later. Security said having the card by cell phones will do that, BUT we just got the card re-activated. Since it worked, no additional work was done. The next morning, locked out again....

reviews.title: Under the Tuscan Sun
reviews.text: A different side of Las Vegas if you’re looking for a relaxing hotel with a resort feel, you can still visit other hotels / casinos if you want something more lively.Rooms are larger than most standard rooms, very clean and very well kept , and friendly staff.We have been staying somewhere else in Vegas for many years and after staying at The Tuscany will continue to stay there.

reviews.title: Cozy Home Away from Home
reviews.text: All the staff at the Tuscany were so welcoming, warm and accommodating.  Registration and check in/out was seamless.   We had take out for breakfast every morning from Marilyn's.  After the first day, Michael from Marilyn's  restaurant new my name and room number, what we like to eat, and made me feel like I was his best friend.  He made this review excellent. If you stay here, stop by and order from Michael and tell him Ms. McGee from O307 said hi.  He is excellent.  In fairness, the hotel rooms are a little outdated but they are super spacious. The casino was good but there was no live craps, roulette or black jack games.  The pool and fitness center is excellent.  Even has a hot tube and lap pool at the fitness center.  It's right off the strip so traffic is not bad but close enough to walk 1 block and be on it.

reviews.title: An oasis in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We had a booking for 3 rooms. We had asked to be in the same building and floor but that had not been done.  Bookings were quickly reorganized to same building but different floors. Disappointing that the original request wasn't actioned.

reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: Very good  , enjoy with the family  , I will decently come again , and will recommend with friends and family , it was very peaceful and quiet place to stay , very clean we really love the room and the service , the only thing was that no one came to do room services , no one clean our room …..

reviews.title: Great stay but be careful of your room choice
reviews.text: Enjoyed Tuscany meals good service good but we’re disappointed with our room. Paid for a pool view room but our room was right behind 3 pool cabanas which totally blocked our view of the pool. Our room was also quite noisy from above.

reviews.title: Nice and clean. Close to airport. Friendly Staff.
reviews.text: Very friendly and non-intrusive staff. Enjoyed the cocktail lounge. Laundry was coin operated, hard to find and hard to find quarters for so I ended up packing a bunch of dirty stuff home with me. Restaurant (Tuscany Gardens) was delicious. BUT they put me in a room very far from the front and it was right next to where they were building the new F1 track...at all hours of the night. I sleep like a rock and I was still awakened multiple times for from the beeps and grinding. I also would have rather had one of the full kitchen suites, but they were sold out...supposedly, even though the place didn't seem very full. Also, it's right next to the airport, though I didn't notice a whole lot of air traffic noise. Just a few times.

reviews.title: Good Hotel and Service
reviews.text: Very good value for money, good food and a pleasant atmosphere. Spacious, well-maintained facility, good location (500 meters to the strip), spacious rooms, the only point of criticism is the very loud fans in the bathroom.

reviews.title: 4 day - Business conference
reviews.text: We enjoyed a great experience from check in to check out. The hotel, conference centre and other amenities were great. It is close to the strip and various restaurants. Since it is not a huge property, everything is very handy.

reviews.title: Relaxing accomdation!
reviews.text: Very comfortable rooms which is a big size. Also low rise building that you can get to anywhere by flight of stairs. Landscaping around the building is very warming & cozy. The pool helps you to relax & make you feel your a tourist.

reviews.title: Perfect setting!
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Tuscany five times!  Love it.  Quieter atmosphere, beautiful grounds, large  comfortable room, service is good!   I'm a swimmer and love the lap pool.  Will hopefully come back in 2024!  Diane

reviews.title: Couldn’t have ask for more
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites & Casino is in an excellent location just walking distance from the strip or a quick Uber ride.  The accommodations are excellent and the staff is marvelous.  A variety of great food and an inviting pool area.  When we return, the Tuscany will be our home base while in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Love the Tuscany! The smaller casino is just right and the people are extra friendly. The 365 bar has excellent food and drinks. Check in was fast and easy. Rooms were large and clean. The pool has plenty of room for everyone and the weather this time of year is perfect!

reviews.title: Good Stay.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay.   There are plenty of spaces to park, the rooms are clean, quiet and roomy.  The grounds are really nice and there are a few different food options.  The Italian restaurant is amazing with great service.

reviews.title: Our stay at Tuscany was perfect!
reviews.text: We loved the Tuscany.  It is only about a 15 min walk to the Strip.  So it very convenient without being in with the crowd.  Our room was spacious, clean and relatively quiet.  The restaurants were very good and the prices were much better than down on the Strip.The staff we came in contact with were very friendly and helpful

reviews.title: Great hidden spot off the strip
reviews.text: Great room, large and clean. Great pool. Staff was great. Below average gaming area. You had it right before covid, I would recommend going back to the set up you had then. Restaurants were also good.

reviews.title: Quite elegance, spacious room and great service
reviews.text: Loved it! Best we've stayed at in Vegas and this was our fourth time in Vegas!Beds were comfortable, everything we needed was available on site, so didn't have to venture into the chaos...unless we wanted to.

reviews.title: Great hotel off the Strip for a great price.
reviews.text: Great hotel just off the Strip. Not super fancy and garish like Caesers or any of the other large hotels, more boutique, just what we like. Our room was king non smoking poolside balcony (H308) was perfect. Large, clean and we could see the new Sphear through the trees. Great location for easy acess to the pool, restaurants and casino. Pool and hot tub area very pretty and clean. It is about 10-15 minute walk to the Strip. Daytime no problems, night time I wouldn't do it alone as a woman, but fine with a partner or a group. Overall we would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Beautiful and relaxing
reviews.text: Loved this place! So serene and beautiful amongst nature, away from the hustle of LA, perfect combination to come home to relax. Suite was big and spacious, and very clean. Close to strip for Uber or walking. Great all you can eat sushi restaurant right in front of the hotel.

reviews.title: Since it was a discounted rate stay due to seminar taking place So I believe you get what you pay for.
reviews.text: Since it was a discounted rate stay due to seminar taking place So I believe you get what you pay for.

reviews.title: Retired couple get away!
reviews.text: Staff is always so cordial and welcoming! Love the comps! When will "Hot seats" and other perks on Senior day be re-instated? Also, last visit the complimentary coffee was served up in a really tiny deposable cup!

reviews.title: Amazing, book the room with the balcony
reviews.text: Amazing stay, first time visiting Tuscany Suites, staff so lovely, resort and room beautiful,  so close to the strip.  The rooms are huge and we even had a microwave and our own private balcony which was so close to the pool. One of the best hotels we have stayed at in Vegas

reviews.title: Best ever
reviews.text: Loved it. Had a great time. Very nice.would recommend to everyone. Close to every thing. Could walk if you wanted to. Beautiful color changing ball you could see from Tuscany, Room was big and couch bar sink. Huge bathroom.

reviews.title: Would stay again! Felt safe and comfortable
reviews.text: I was a little apprehensive staying in Vegas alone for a work trip. I’m in my mid thirties but look more like I’m fresh out of high school which causes some interesting situations and makes me feel extra vulnerable. I arrived close to midnight and actually felt super safe (still had my mace in my hand just in case!) and the room was SO clean and comfortable. As is normal in most hotels, when people were talking and walking down the hallway I could hear them, and the people above me sounded like they were stomping until 3am, but I couldn’t hear them talking. I will say the number for room service never connected me, but when I called guest services they were able to connect me and I was able to get breakfast. The gentleman who delivered breakfast was exceptionally friendly and accommodating. My room had coffee but no cream or sugar and when I ordered breakfast they brought me a bunch of cream and sugar. I would 10000% stay again especially for the price! All I need from a hotel is cleanliness, a nice fresh bed I can sleep in, hot water, coffee, and friendly staff, and all of my needs were met. The hotel was better than I expected.

reviews.title: Good choice for quiet hotel
reviews.text: Nice clean hotel in a quiet area 1 mile from Ceasars Palace.Pretty pool area with good cafe & seating in the shade for breakfast or lunchBig rooms with small kitchenette, microwave etcGreat free parking

reviews.title: The best hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We love The Tuscany Suites.  The rooms are huge and with only a short 10 minute walk to the Strip.  It also has tranquility that the other hotels do not have.  I’ve been here from the UK 3 times and wouldn’t dream of staying anywhere else. However the reason I have given it 4 out of 5 is because some members of staff only on reception and in the coffee shop were rude in my opinion.  My advice is if you hate your job/people etc, go find another job 😕

reviews.title: Great stay. They have smoking rooms!
reviews.text: Loved this hotel. Stayed at a place in the strip and here and I preferred here. Hands down.  Good room price. Not far from the strip. Booked a smoking room. Few places left in vegas seem to have them.

reviews.title: Best place to stay
reviews.text: Great place to stay. It’s like having your own studio with kitchenette & living room. Love that you do not have to walk through a casino to get to your room. Easy to park next to your room. Easy access to freeways & strip.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel for us
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our 4 night stay here for my husbands 30th birthday! The hotel is just off the strip away from the hustle and bustle - which was perfect for us! But you can walk to the strip in about 15 minutes! Rooms are huge, clean and the queen bed was extremely comfortable! All the staff was extremely friendly & attentive. A big bonus is that they have a cafe open 24 hours which helped for our early excursion to the canyon! The pool was lovely also! Clean and not overcrowded! We felt this hotel had everything & we would happily return!

reviews.title: THE HANGOVER !!!!
reviews.text: Very nice Suite & Casino !!!  From the bell hop to the Front Desk , they were total professionals. No room noise, totally silent. Cant hear people above us or around us. We played out music in our room with no complaints. Very large suites. We arrived around 5:30pm and still got a complimentary microwave. Fridge worked well. Bathroom was great, had toilet separate from rest of shower ,tub and spacious vanity /sink. Very close to strip. We stayed in Apartment B  room 1103, right by ice machine/soda vending and entrance to parking lot. Super close to valet. Did not go to pool, due to partying into hotel room till 930pm. Caught Uber to the Linq promenade, about 10.00 charge (don't forget the tip). Than it was The Hangover Part 4 for our Party of 5. I played the character Fat Jesus and Chow.  So for now......So Long Hay Boys !!!!!

reviews.title: Tuscany suites
reviews.text: Great property. Room was spacious and clean. Casino is small but delivered great service and affordable drinks. Only complaint was the beds were tiny. I thought I booked two queens but the beds were only doubles.

reviews.title: Las Vegas gem!
reviews.text: Excellent stay! Large, quiet rooms, beautiful grounds and friendly staff. We will definitely be back. We booked for a 3 night stay to attend the Life is Beautiful festival. The rooms are spacious, comfy and very clean. Housekeeping was quick to bring additional towels and blankets when requested and the front desk was friendly and attentive.

reviews.title: Birthday at Tuscany
reviews.text: A relaxed stay for my birthday celebration. Friendly and helpful staff! The dinner at Tuscany Garden was as good as any 5 star restaurant on the strip! we can hardly wait for our next time in Vegas and our stay at Tuscany Suites!

reviews.title: Best hotel ever
reviews.text: Good quality rooms a good price for the day, most of the famous hotel’s doesn’t have this price specially in weekends, is really hard to find a good price room for next day, usually they charge a lot just because you didn’t do it on time.

reviews.title: Great.
reviews.text: Great staff. Rooms were clean. Beds were comfortable. We really like being being off the strip but with easy access(app 15 minute walk).
