Smaller hotel/casino, with app 360 rooms, which is nice. Pool is not overcrowded. We've been coming to this Pro Seminars conference for 15+ years and have always been well treated. Great place to relax  after an evening of fun and frolic.

reviews.title: For the most part I was comfortable and felt safe!!!
reviews.text: I found the staff to be excellent in their jobs and made me feel welcome upon my arrival for a week stay.  They kept my room very clean throughout the week....Now for some improvements for your guests1) New shower faucet would defiantly help!!! Put in hand held faucet a priority for women and older population.

reviews.title: Great place, quiet yet 10 min walk to strip (Caesars Palace)
reviews.text: Several changes have taken place at this hotel since Sept 2022, that I am not so happy with. The biggest change is the reduced items available at Marilyn's restaurant, but the food is still great, reasonably priced, with large portions.The price increase at Tuscany Gardens, but food is fantastic!- Pasta and Fish Entrees: $30- $50- Steak Entrees: $50- $72

reviews.title: It was a pleasant trip.
reviews.text: The room was very large.  Room was serviced every day. Beds were comfortable and Marilyn’s restaurant was convenient and good food.Casino did not have table games which caused us to visit other casinos.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel near center
reviews.text: Everything was great. We really enjoyed the pool. The AC was working well. The room was really spacious. All the needed toiletries were provided. There was even a small kitchen in the room, however some basic cutlery would be nice to have. The parking for guests was big and close to the hotel. The only drawback was the waiting time for the check-in, but this was mainly caused by one oppresive guest.

reviews.title: Great room with a view!
reviews.text: I got a fantastic room with a view of the sphere. I was totally surprised at how nice the room was. The entire staff was friendly and professional. The food at Marilyn's was delicious. The gambling was fun.

Room service was excellent as usual. Hotel amenities were superior, as usual. One thing very noticeable was the lack of service help in Pub 365. We sat down for lunch on Monday and waited for a waitress...or anyone to come by. After 10 minutes we walked out.

reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.text: I have been coming to the Tuscany for the Pro Seminars conference for the last 7 years.  Also enjoy staying at the Tuscany.  I normally would rate you a 5 but this time I was frustrated with the lack of fresh water to drink and the bartenders only providing waters that I had to pay for.  The odd bartender would provide it in a plastic cup with ice when ordering an alcoholic drink but was also declined  by many.  I remember there being water fountains around the hotel and looks like they have been removed.  Small issue but with the heat in Vegas fresh water is important for hydration.

reviews.title: Tuscany Hotel and Suites, Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great, helpful, polite staff. Rooms are big, spacious and well furnished. You have to request for a microwave though, I requested for one whilst I was booking initially, but this wasn't provided, so we had to ask again. We were initially booked into a room in a block that directly faced a huge construction site that was being built for the 2023 Las Vegas Formula One grand prix. Work was going on all night, and it was impossible to sleep. Thankfully we informed the front desk the next morning, and were moved to a much better room in a different block. Again, we had to request for a microwave to be brought up. Another important thing that guests should be made aware of, is the distance of the hotel to the Las Vegas Strip. It is a good 25-30 minutes walk for a fit person, so if you plan to visit Vegas solely or mostly to see the Strip, this may not be the best hotel to stay in as you'd have to get expensive taxis or drive daily if you don't fancy walking. Overall a good experience. I'd probably stay again if I had the option of hiring a car.

reviews.title: Warning round the clock construction in the area.
reviews.text: I've stayed at the Tuscany several times before and generally have been satisfied with the stays. However for my last stay my room was in the L building and my window  faced the 24 hour a day construction of the stadium for the formula 1 racing event that occurs in November. Needless to say the constant noise from the construction made sleeping difficult. I mentioned this when I checked out and was told they were sorry for the noise. I feel refunding the resort fee (which seems high given I don't use any of the facilities such as the pool, gym, etc.) would have been appropriate. As a minimum they should warn guests ahead of time for rooms on that end of the property and try to move you to a different room if the noise would bother you.

reviews.title: September visit to casino very disappointing when compared to past visits.
reviews.text: Accommodations and services were outstanding.However, the disappointing downgrading of the video poker to "poor rating" for "fair return on investment" AND the removal of LIVE table games greatly lower our incentive to include Tuscany Casino as a preferred destination in Las Vegas.We used to greatly look forward visiting Tuscany, however, Tuscany no longer exists as a "go to" casino.

reviews.title: Outstanding stay !!!!!!
reviews.text: Could not ask for a better visit. This casino has everyting to offer. Shows were great. Staff always offered to help. Clean rooms. Good size rooms. Very good food selections but close early (9:00 PM).

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Enjoy the size of the rooms, quiet and peaceful  surroundings. Good service with excellent restaurant along with the conference facility that is efficient and comfortable. The security is also evident which adds to the comfortable atmosphere enjoyed

reviews.title: Love This Property
reviews.text: I have stayed at this resort for years and find it amazing.  From the huge rooms, friendly staff, great dining options, excellent value, nice pools and manicured grounds.  A short walk to the strip and superb dining choices many of which are a short walk away.  Just ann all round place to stay.

reviews.title: Extent service over al
reviews.text: Staff very helpful .new  Teams liked the rooms  old teams also with bock price Marcella Sanchez excellent with services provided { Note) check in time 3 pm some players waiting till 5/530 for rooms other players got rooms within 1 hr but some people just impatient.  Talked to cleaning staff they don't let front desk know rooms ready till all rooms they have to clean r all done so some rooms were empty for 2 hours when the front desk could give rooms out sooner  and people wouldn't have to as long just suggestion

reviews.title: Thank you Tuscany suites management and staff for another great vacation
reviews.text: Our fifth stay at Tuscany suites,  always recommended to family and friends when visiting las Vegas. Large clean rooms, great pool, friendly staff, good restaurants and casino.On site security 24-7Great entertainment nightly in lounge.

reviews.title: Conference
reviews.text: I booked two king rooms in building C for my wife and I as well as one for my son and his wife well before our arrival. When we got there we were in two different buildings. Two associates checked in a day later and were in building CJust a little inconvenient otherwise a nice time as usual

reviews.title: Clean & convenient
reviews.text: This place exceeded my expectations! Parking was excellent. The place was clean and comfortable. The price was right. And the restaurant food was delicious . The casino was convenient. We were only staying for one night so it was perfect and no hassle with the hussle and bussle on the strip 👍🏼

reviews.title: Great Facility and Great Location
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the Tuscany Suites & Casino. From registration to checkout, the experience was positive and satisfactory. This was my first experience with the Tuscany and I will not hesitate to consider them for my next stay in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: It was horrible! I have stayed several years in a row with no complaints. This time was terrible. Leaf blowers outside our room at 7am. Safe issues daily (waited 90 minutes for maintenance). Wife was unable to charge to the room because name was not properly added, etc

reviews.title: 51st Anniversary celebration
reviews.text: We came to Celebrate our 51st Anniversary. This was our fist time staying here. We absolutely had an awesome time. Your Staff were very friendly & helpful. We will be returning again in the near future.

reviews.title: Very kind and thoughtful.
reviews.text: My husband was flown to a hospital from another state. This hotel could not have been more helpful to me. Everyone was kind an helpful. I was exhausted and alone and the hotel staff made sure that I was on the bottom floor and close to my vehicle. I appreciated that so much.

reviews.title: Pro-seminars
reviews.text: The stay was excellent..... this was my second visit and I really enjoyed the stay. The facility has everything that is needed - casino, bars, restaurants and the seminar halls. This location is excellent for big seminars or even parties of large magnitude.

reviews.title: Nice off-strip property, hotel part of  experience disappointing .
reviews.text: It was our tenth wedding anniversary celebration. Property including casino, bars and restaurants were very good. Food was good staff was friendly and lounge entertainment was good. Hotel experience was extremely disappointing. We reserved and paid for a pool view with lanai. (Picture of view from our room attached.) Management staff was very accessible through DM on social media and email though.   Offered a remedy of show tickets and restaurant credit.

reviews.title: Large suites
reviews.text: As always, the suites are very large. Plenty of space. Everything is pretty well up-to-date, and the room is very comfortable. The property is pretty sprawling, so if you are assigned one of the buildings toward the back, you’ll do a lot of walking. Although, the parking lots do allow for close parking of your car to nearly any building.

reviews.title: Very pleased - Dan and Luan
reviews.text: Clean, wonderful layout, many amenities, very hospitable, courteous and a beautiful room.  Restaurant, pool, casino were all excellent.....we'll come back and would recommend this property to anyone.  In all the visits over 50 years to Las Vegas - we agreed that this was the best, all things considered.  Thank you

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Clean campus, nice ambience. Pools are in good shape, and exercise room is large and excellent.  There are good shows.  The strip and some good eateries are close enough to walk.  One suggestion: The suites could use a microwave.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: We had a great time at the conference. Our room was large and clean and the staff came in every day to make the beds and tidy. The food was excellent at the Italian restaurant. We would definitely come back to this hotel in the future.

reviews.title: We stay 2 times a year for 4 days for the last 20 years
reviews.text: we always enjoy our stay clean quite easy strip access. Good resturants and slots. we love the pool area and ease of stay. We have been enjoying the Tuscany for over 20 years now and we love that we get the same building every time we stay.

reviews.title: Our Las Vegas Tuscany Getaway
reviews.text: We enjoyed staying at Tuscany because there are a number of restaurants easily accessed and with high quality food.  There is a variety of gaming options and the Piazza Lounge provides quality entertainment.  The rooms are large and provide a homey feeling with a small kitchen and living room.  However, we have been disappointed to see some of our favorite items removed from both Marilyn’s and Tuscany Gardens.  How you have a cafe without a grilled ham and cheese sandwich or an upscale Italian restaurant with no Veal Parmigiana or Veal Marsala is a real head scratcher.  Your wine prices are really high.  Your new Tuscany Garden Manager was nice enough to comp us the $80 dollar bottle of wine we ordered but just as an example that is nearly 4 times the shelf price.  We also noted the musical acts that appear on a regular basis are really good.  The ones who are not regulars tend to be at a much lower level.  Your bartenders are outstanding.  We note with disappointment you have removed Straight Bonus Poker from the Piazza bar Video Poker machines.  We were happy to see you returning table games.  We basically find all your team members to be observant and helpful.  The grounds are beautiful and very well maintained creating a lovely relaxing setting especially around the pool.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites & Casino is a great place to stay
reviews.text: I enjoyed staying at the Tuscany Suites & Casino. Clean facilities, good and friendly interactions with the employees. Will be back to stay at the Tuscany Suites & Casino when I return to visit Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Never disappoints
reviews.text: I have stayed at The Tuscany now around 12 times, and it never disappoints. Staff is wonderful, rooms are great, pool is perfect, grounds are nice and it is quiet. Will be back again. The entertainment is fun, the bartender (Chase?) was friendly and took care of us well. He makes a damn good dirty martini!

reviews.title: Great stay off the Strip!
reviews.text: The staff at Tuscany Suites & Casino make the entire experience just that much better.  The rooms are big and well-appointed.  Bed is comfortable.  A few issues with some things being a bit dated or in need of repair (shower head, sink plug), but nothing terrible. Will come again for sure.

reviews.title: Relaxing stay
reviews.text: Great clean quiet hotel.  A little walk to the strip but it’s safe and we all need the exercise:). Seems to attract an older group but who am I to talk at 71 :).Hi security so I always felt safe.  I would recommend this hotel.  Also the price was very reasonable.

reviews.title: Love the Tuscany!!
reviews.text: We keep coming back to the Tuscany! Because of the fantastic staff, large comfortable rooms, relaxing pool, great restaurants.  It's a real hidden gem! Special shout out to Daiva at the pool - we love her!

reviews.title: Generally quiet yet close to the strip.
reviews.text: We very much enjoyed at the tranquility and beautiful landscaping of the Tuscany Suites. Our room was very large and comfortable. The one complaint I would have is that they expected you to be out of your room so early in the morning for cleaning. We constantly got notes under our door saying they were skipping our room because we had to do not disturb sign up this was at 10:00 a.m. kind of early to be out in vegas. Secondly on the weekend a group for a conference arrived and we're Extremely Loud and rowdy. They saved almost all of the seats at the pool prior to their arrival from their meetings so there was nowhere for anyone else to sit and relax yet those chairs remained empty for most of the day. That should not have been allowed. The comfort of all of the guests should be taken into consideration.

reviews.title: Best Place to Stay !
reviews.text: Best sweet hotel great staff good, really nice pool and very very clean. Definitely 10/10 better then the strip hotels this is near the strip cozy and calm. Also, it's not a huge building. It's very small buildings with Villa type sweets and they're very nice.

reviews.title: Peaceful stay in a busy city.
reviews.text: The room was perfectly clean, the shower was great and the room was quiet. Thank you for a great stay. Employees terrific too.  The mattress was very comfortable too. The location is great and Lyft drivers are able to easily pick you up and drop you off.

reviews.title: Good but construction noises were loud
reviews.text: The only bad thing about the stay was every 4:00 AM constructions noises outside is so annoying and disturbing. We stayed in the L building which was next to the construction site of Formula One Race. The management should have compensated the guest affected. We mentioned it to the person when we checked out and she seemed awkward about the situation instead of saying she would let the management know about it. They should stop using those rooms until the problem is resolved.

reviews.title: Wonderful Trip
reviews.text: We Loved having  the Lanai just outside our room!  It was so relaxing to sit out there among the Beautiful landscaping!  We also enjoyed the Marilyns restaurant alot, very good food.  The casino is just the right size.

reviews.title: Needs better ways to check rooms and amenities i the rooms
reviews.text: We go to Tuscany a few times a year and it’s usually very good. This time. There was a couple of hiccups that I hope that they will take care of before the next time we’re there.  They obviously got new towels for the hotel, which is a Plus however, they are soft but there’s so new that every time you use them all the white fibers from the towel come off on you whether it’s your hands or your feet or wherever  and then u need to wash off the white fiber after using the towels2) the telephone in the room did not work properly. I was able to dial was Housekeeping any other numbers dialed got a recording call could not go thru. that is not good in an emergency situation. I hope they fix the phone system as well.  3) I checked the sheets every time I go before we even use the bed and they’re always stained in one way orThe other so there needs to be better checking of those clean sheets beforeUsed on the beds.

reviews.title: Great but could be better
reviews.text: The hotel and room was good. The only part that I didn’t like was getting to the bldg from hotel lobby. Go carts (those used in home courses) that drop guests to their bldg will be a nice touch and will enhance your hotel experience.

reviews.title: Relaxing stay away from the srip
reviews.text: We stay at Tuscany several times a year.  Easy check in, convenient walk to the suites. Easy access to the casino.  Very comfortable and quiet. This stay was almost 3 weeks. Pretty steady payouts at the casino, friendly staff. Slot attendants are very sociable and helpful. Marilyn’s restaurant is terrific. The staff is outstanding. German, Gabriel, Sal, Angel and Saul are very attentive and remember your previous requests. Above and beyond customer service.

reviews.title: A safe, beautiful and clean location, just off the Strip
reviews.text: The front desk staff was very pleasant and helpful, able to secure me a quiet room and my request for a microwave came quickly. The room itself was impeccably clean and quite large. The A/C worked almost too well. Plumbing was good, no stopped up shower drain, just had to wait a minute for plenty of hot water. Housekeeping was excellent. Cons; lumpy pillows and an extremely firm mattress. Most people would like that, I suppose. I ended up sleeping on the sofa that had foam cushions. Close to the Strip and security throughout the property. As a solo female traveler I felt safe here (stay alert in the neighborhood though). The pool and grounds are gorgeous, food at the Pub quite good (I highly recommend the shrimp tacos). I did have a terrifying experience when I was mistaken for a person passing funny money because we paid with the same type of bill. I was truly horrified! Bartender in the lounge made me a wonderful, refreshing mocktail. Late Swing/Graveyard beverage service in the casino could use a bit of help. I had to track her/them down each visit for my water order (yes, I do tip). Overall, if the beds weren't so firm, I would definitely return on my next trip.

reviews.title: went to a concert but every year we go for my birthday in july
reviews.text: always good very clean rooms nice staff i ask for a especial room n yes we got the room we want n housekeeping very nice thank you see you next year or maybe in November we have 2 com nights every moths

reviews.title: great time
reviews.text: great room and casino. very nice people that made my stay enjoyable. food and servers were good. casino has a variety of slot machines and is returning table games to the casino. i would recommend the tuscany to anyone who wants a fun and relaxing vacation,

reviews.title: Nice place but attention to major problems did not happen.
reviews.text: The room was clean and maid service was great.  However,  the air conditioner in my room was not working correctly.  Every 28 minutes there was an internal banging noise coming from the unit.  All day and NIGHT.  It was very disturbing and kept me awake.  I complained to maintenance and was told they would look into it.  After another night I checked to see why it was still making the noise at the front desk. I was told they would take care of it.  The whole time I was there nothing was done.  It was not a good experience.  Anna Garmon room d106

reviews.title: Run down and below standard
reviews.text: Positive: the room was big.  Marilyn’s cafe was delicious and reasonably pricedNegative: the restHuge hairball on shower wall, shower faucet needs repair,  bathroom sink faucet didn’t have hot water, a nice kitchen cabinets with no silverware or dishes, only plastic glasses- just really low quality interior AC was basic loud wall unit.Loud hallway in a wood framed building

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: It is a beautiful place. Good location, lot to see. You can walk all over and still feel safe. Staff is good and helpful. If I had one critique it would be how expensive the bar is. I bought my alcohol in the casino.

reviews.title: Benefits for staying and being a loyal customer
reviews.text: The service desk employees were fantastic. I also loved the fact that we were in B complex and on the first floor. Thanks for that. There is one thing I was disappointed with and that is myself and my son in law were each suppose to get 25.00 free play and 25.00 food voucher I got my food credit but Greg did not.  Also neither he nor I got our 25.00 free play. We checked with the players club and the lady told us that we had no free play. I said they told me at the desk that we did. She informed me that they don’t know what they are talking about. I thought that was rather rude. We have been coming to the Tuscany for the last 6 or 7 years except for one year in between.

reviews.title: Great Hospitality
reviews.text: Was there on business.  The venue was a conference at Tuscany Suites & Casino. Lance Pao was the event coordinator for Tuscany. Lance is great!  That man does not sit still for a minute!  Great hospitality.

reviews.title: Great place for families and fun times
reviews.text: Wow! What an amazing resort! The room was so spacious and clean. The pool was great! Tons of places to relax by the pool or hot tub. Good sized pool and open late. We loved how close the parking is to the rooms and the care taken to ensure that vehicles are safe. The casino was fun. Table games were not operational but coming back soon. There were lots of slot machine games. The location is super close to the strip and super close to the sphere. You can actually view the sphere from the front entry. We will recommend especially for families. Thanks Tuscany for the fun times!

reviews.title: Spacious,Clean,Friendly and Tranquil!
reviews.text: So pleased that we stayed at Tuscany Suites and Casino. Hotel is very clean, staff pleasant. Rooms spacious. Bathrooms updated and HUGE. Ate at the sports bar and also the "family restaurant" both had good service and food. Pool area was tranquil and beautiful. Hotel is only 10 minute walk from strip, near Bellagio and Ceasars. Recommended for couples and families

reviews.title: Decent place to stay
reviews.text: Very clean and quiet, off the strip yet close to the monorail.We were in Vegas for a convention.The walk to the strip is about 20 minutes, it was a nice central location.I booked 3 months in advance and paid a great rate.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem Off The Strip
reviews.text: The Tuscany has an "Old Vegas" vibe without feeling like it's days away from demolition. The resort is clean and well-maintained. There is free parking. The employees, from the bell hops and housekeepers to the front desk reps and security, are friendly and helpful. The rooms are nicely appointed and spacious. The casino is small but loaded with great games. While we did have some issues with service at two of the four eateries on site, it was overall a great stay. Would definitely consider staying here again and would recommend to others!

reviews.title: Stay at Tuscany with IFCON group convention
reviews.text: Greetings,I Reported Shower after my first morning shower. Water handle loose would not stay in place as rotate counter clockwise. So water either cold or too hot because handle drops all the way down to max hot water level (no tension).I Reported this via call to desk twice my first full day there no repair was ever made.Could not get room safe to activate initially.Elevator out of service from early 9/3 and still out when I checked out 9/4. Staff told me it would be fixed by morning but no,  when I went to use it around 10AM 9/4 still out of order. I am 70 and have back issues from 3 fractures. Only one bellman on duty and I was heading to checkout before farewell breakfast 9/4 so I carried my 2 suitcases and backpack down in 3 trips. Why is there only one elevator in the entire building?I was in H-303 by myself.I requested wake-up call (with a person at desk)  on friday 9/1 for sat morning 9/2. No  wakeup call was made. The in-room alarm clock is broken that did not work either.I was with a group of over 300 staying there multiple nights for IFCON. I have stayed at Tuscany previously with a large group and did not have any of these issues.Overall stay was a Fail. Would not recommend IFCON stay again. Would appreciate follow up.Sincerely,Byron H-303 8/31-9/4.

reviews.title: Fun in Rain
reviews.text: The rooms were clean, the staff were great, enjoyed the pool with drinks available. I loved that they had a laundry room, plenty of restaurants available around the premises, walking distance to the strip. It rained all weekend in Vegas but that didn’t stop us.

reviews.title: fun vacation but accommodations need improvement
reviews.text: Restaurants and Shows are great, Casino is good, rooms need renovation. The fan in the bathroom was like an airliner landing on the tarmac, the window air conditioner which goes on periodically to keep the room cool was like drone overhead. What made up for it was great staff, restaurants, shows, and casino.

reviews.title: The staff is great and the food subpar
reviews.text: The room was comfortable. The women cleaning our room, the front desk people, the waiters/waitresses and the bartenders were all great. The issue was the food at every restaurant. Every meal we had at every restaurant was subpar.

reviews.title: good over all!
reviews.text: My 4th stay... I love this hotel, the grounds & the staff!My only hitch was that my room request/assignment wasn't followed. I'm not sure who was responsible for that... the hotel or the group I was with?

reviews.title: Quiet hotel
reviews.text: It is a quiet, family hotel, it stands out for having spacious rooms with a refrigerator, laundry area and dining room. We asked for a microwave at check-in and they delivered it to the room in less than 15 minutes. Very good cleaning.The large pool, with many lounge chairs.It's about 4 long blocks from the strip, but I definitely recommend it.All the hotel employees were very, very friendly, especially one of the receptionists who I don't remember his name but he told me he was from Colombia, was very, very attentive.They also receive one or two packages at no cost.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: Lovely hotel in an excellent location , close to the strip . Easy to walk to main attractions or get a taxi . Huge suite rooms , fantastic restaurants and coffee shop. Clean and comfortable rooms for a good price

reviews.title: Excellent Off Strip Resort
reviews.text: Excellent stay, exactly what I expected and wanted of my LV trip - close enough to the action/half a block from the hustle bustle of the strip’s four corners, at a great well run clean laid back resort with great staff all around, I would definitely stay here again

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text: This is truly a fantastic hotel in Las Vegas. You are not on the strip, but just outside it. I thought that was a big advantage, because the hotel is more quietly located than other hotels. The hotel had a very nice swimming pool with nice beds, towels and enough space. The room was very spacious and very clean. Someone also came knocking twice because a kitchen light didn't seem to be working and they wanted to solve it immediately. I would recommend this hotel to everyone!

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Always a great time.Very helpful.There for a convention. Rooms are big.Great pool. Great bar, coffee shop.It isn't the glam life like on the strip but very very pleasant. I actually like it. A lot more calm and larger rooms than pretty much anywhere

reviews.title: Last minute stay
reviews.text: Called at 1:00 AM to see about vacancy and was in bed in the room at 2:00. After a flight fiasco, and no way to get out of Vegas that night, Tuscany Suites really came through. The rate wasn’t that high for a last minute stay. Room was clean and bed was comfortable. Slept really well.

reviews.title: What a great property
reviews.text: Had a great time. The property was very clean. Room was huge and very nice. Staff was very helpful. I was even able to park with my trailer. I would not hesitate to book again in the future. Thank you

reviews.title: Will Be Back
reviews.text: We love staying here, great room, and wonderful staff, food at Marilyn's is great! Several of our friends have stayed on multiple occasions, including search and rescue dog team, love that they accept animals.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Great location, spacious room and lovely pool, free towels and beds. Close to the strip, nice staff. Casino and restaurants next door with lots of options to eat. Not too expensive and of good quality

reviews.title: Bad odds at video poker
reviews.text: I have been going to the Tuscany for years along with members of my family.  We love to play Double Double Bonus Video Poker.  Recently, the casino drastically reduced the payouts for this game.  Love the rooms and the hotel, but the gaming experience is now too expensive.

reviews.title: Love It
reviews.text: Love it! Easy to get in, loved the spacious rooms, the pool was nice!  I liked not having to walk all the way through a casino just to get to your room the villa energy was great when you worked all day!  Plus it was across from my favorite restaurant, Fire Fly!

reviews.title: could have been better
reviews.text: nice property, could be better managed. check in /room allocation delayedloud as room opposite the construction site. Pub 365 : service not that great on 1st sept:- rude server- had to wait 40 minutes for the drinks, when reminded, the server was rude " said they had a big party in the next room so we should be patient".- the servers ask you load the app to get gifts , however the bought beers could  not be linked to the app so basically a rip - off.

reviews.title: It is good stay experience
reviews.text: Nice service,and clean room ,clean swim pool. convenience to strip, and shopping. The construction everywhere is only hold back. Front desk is very nice and helpful. Casino room smoking smell is very strong

reviews.title: Hotel is good ,Casino is horrible,just take money.
reviews.text: Room is good,service is  good,restaurants is good but casino pay is horrible,every month is worst more than before...slot machines are empty  people stay and play 10c because when sit they lost money and continue with 10c,20c.... can't go back home in a half hour ,just came...this is shame...looks like almost robbery...if someone got some jackpot this is usually turist,casino attracts them to come again.I am 3 times per week at casino and they never called me at tournaments for  free play from komputer but when I use room I was called,computer doesn't know who is from Vegas ,just selects guests...I love all workers,they are good but you guys who made paying,you are so greedy...casino is not secure ,3 times from me was stolen my two purses and one time debt card...You need to open machines ,don't be greedy,old Tuscany owner passed away years ago,he was businessman good,he wasn't too greedy like you....just let you know what players talking about Tuscany Casino's up stairs management!Have a nice day!

reviews.title: Excellent solution to enjoy Las Vegas
reviews.text: Located a few minutes walk from the heart of the Strip, it has huge free parking, swimming pools and gardens. It offers very large and well-kept suites, clean and welcoming. Excellent solution to enjoy Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Best Casino Hotel to enjoy Las Vegas!!
reviews.text: Very quiet, nice landscaping to walk through. My wife said it was one of the nicest hotels she has stayed in. Marilyn s Cafe had the best food close by. Pools were relaxing. Away from busy noisy traffic, Great to relax and enjoy Las Vegas.

reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text: Great Customer service and clean rooms.The rooms are nice and big full with lots of towels and rags in the restrooms.The beds are big complemented by soft pillows. The staff there was great they help me with any issues I had.

reviews.title: Tuscany suites hotel
reviews.text: I alway there many times that is my favorite place. Also easy car parking first floor than building. This Tuscany suites hotel nice bedroom more space. Hotel is very quiet and cleaning hallway and inside bedroom too. I have no problem. Next time, I always reservation same Tuscany suites hotel period.

reviews.title: Great for the price
reviews.text: Overall it was good experience. Affordable compared to the strip. Quieter and very close. Service at all the restaurants and pool were pretty slow. The hotel feels dated. There is a lot of maintenance needed. Every single elevator was running slow, offline or had a broken button somewhere. Again it was okay but they need to invest some serious money back into this hotel

reviews.title: nice hotel bland restaurant food
reviews.text: The hotel was nice and clean. The room was huge for Las Vegas. However the food was not good. The dinner service at one place and it could be because they were training new staff. I can't believe that the restaurants got the Best of Vegas awards.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Awesome customer service. We felt like VIP’s. Our room was serviced late in the day when we called because we were resting. Enjoyed the casino as well and the restaurants inside the Tuscany. We enjoyed the swimming amenity as well.

reviews.title: Great Value!, Nice Hotel, Well Worth It!
reviews.text: I was very pleased with my stay at the hotel. I found the front desk staff very accommodating. I did not realize I had booked run of the house rooms ( had booked 4 rooms for family members) and wanted 2 double bed rooms and 2 king rooms. When we arrived (at 12:30am) they could only provide 4 double bed rooms so we took that for the night and they made the change the following morning. Nice location, close to the strip, easy Uber to almost anywhere. Nice restaurants and coffee shop, good casino. Thought it was a very good value for the money. Rooms were spacious and clean. I would definitely use in the future. Price was so much more reasonable than on the strip and we were there Labor Day weekend.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites is a great experience.
reviews.text: The rooms are very spacious with great amenities. The house keepers are excellent and thorough. The restaurants, Fitness facilities, check in staff, valet and Casino on site, were all top notch. The only thing is that I wish the whole casino was non-smoking. It's a short walk to the Strip.

reviews.title: Bad Internet Services
reviews.text: Over all, quite good .  Your WIFI set up is so ancient.  Offering free "low speed" then charging for an upgrade is so ancient and misleading.   Rooms are great though.  Very cooperative staff at the front desk and on the grounds

reviews.title: Comfy but No Breakfast
reviews.text: Room was very large and comfortable. Maybe a little outdated but still very clean. The complex is huge - multiple buildings. Our building did not have a front desk - if we needed something we would have to walk past several buildings. And, no breakfast was available unless we bought it. Water refill stations would also be nice - in triple digit temps it got very expensive to keep purchasing bottled water.

reviews.title: Surprise hotel find off the strip
reviews.text: First time staying off the strip, and I was pleasantly surprised by this hidden gem.  About a two block walk from the strip.  Property was well maintained and had a very relaxing atmosphere for a Vegas hotel.  Nice pool area.  Great restaurants too.  Prices were very reasonable for a suite.

reviews.title: Easy stay
reviews.text: Loved how the casino was not over crowded and we even won a little.  Not too far away from everything else.  Las Vegas walkable!!!!!  Pool looked nice but we never had the time to get in it.  We will probably go back.  Beds are kinda hard, only draw back.

reviews.title: Lovely stay at the Tuscany
reviews.text: Wonderful from start to finish! Helpful friendly staff, very clean rooms, nice environment. I love the placement of the Tuscany. Not on the strip but close enough to easily go have some fun. Thank you so much we had an excellent sat and will be back.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Excellent hotel to stop at . Stayed 2 weeks and was well looked after . The casino is not the most exciting but your 6 min walk from the horseshoe . The pool is excellent and your well looked after by Dania the pool lady .

reviews.title: Fabulous place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with a large pool. Friendly and helpful staff. Lots of food choices, live entertainment at night. Large, comfy, clean room. Quiet and peaceful, but only an easy 5min walk to the strip.

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Great place to stay with fabulous entertainment Relaxing resort with lovely pool area.Rooms are large and comfortable Great food too ! Thanks to Daiva and all the staff for looking after us. Looking forward to our next visit

reviews.title: Quiet, clean and friendly
reviews.text: Stayed 1 night, arrived at my room and turned on the air conditioning. The unit put out only warm air, called the front desk and maintenance replaced unit. Instantly had a cold room. Love this place very quiet clean. The staff is very polite and professional.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Staff was one of the best we have had on our trip, everyone was helpful, courteous, and friendly.  The room was superb, clean, comfortable, and quiet.  A great experience and would heartily recommend.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: The service, staff, rooms are great. The food at the Pub wasn't bad, but they can work on improving a Piña colada. However, you can hear every step taken from the floor above. It's very annoying at 4am.

reviews.title: Relaxing and restful.
reviews.text: As usual a top notch place to stay. Only three issue I had was a speeding towel delivery truck driver, a person possibly casing parked cars in the parking lot, and construction  traffic on Flamingo. It's my 3rd or 4th time staying there. I'll be back.

reviews.title: Meet with friends
reviews.text: The room(apartment)was great,clean,satisfied totally with my stay except that i have a lil misunderstanding about the price but everything was resolved in the end.The bathroom and bed was great,coffee in the morning,etc...

reviews.title: Nice place to stay in Vegas.
reviews.text: Liked that the hotel and casino are in separate buildings.  It was not noisy and smoky on check in. There is a bar area in the hotel with live music and a couple of restaurants on site. Conveniently located. Plentiful parking. AC in room was very noisy but everything else was great.

reviews.title: Our honeymoon that wasn't so sweet at first
reviews.text: I had a horrible experience when I first got there. I was crying and hyperventilating in your lobby because it was my wedding day, and my make up and hair people were in the lobby waiting for me to get my room,so I could get ready but since I couldn't check in I had to get my hair and makeup in the bathroom of your hotel. I couldn't believe this was happening all because I didn't have a major credit card. But the kicker was after all of that to have my card used for my stay and all the hurt and embarrassment and stress and devastation and fear I experienced on the biggest day of my life could all have been avoid. Other than that the resort itself is perfect and beautiful. Very peaceful,easy to navigate, gorgeous pool and a very romantic fire pit. The restaurant are excellent and the location is EVERYTHING!!!! I would definitely stay again because other than the one manager who gave us a very hard time the staff was very friendly helpful and very nice and its literally the perfect location! Thank you for a lovely stay!

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: beautiful and friendly. very nice cleaning people. when in need for anything it was brought up immediately... thank you we hope to be back soon!!!!!beds and room where very lovely and comfy bathroom was spacious as we had four women together..

reviews.title: Great Stay, Great Location, Fair Price
reviews.text: the only thing that could have made it better was getting water from the front desk without a charge, it was nice to receive water to the room though! My group had a great time! We could see a glimpse of the Sphere from our room and walking out of the lobby it’s fully visible which was awesome!

reviews.title: Lack Of Courtesy
reviews.text: The hotel its self is not bad but they proceeded to do construction on room above me my entire stay, Not exactly what you want to wake up to in the morning is drywall repair and for the morning that I was not awoken by construction it was because they were washing my window with a water hose. Make sure you get to the pub before 1 even though its advertised open until 2 it closes at 1. This hotel lacks in common consideration and courtesy. I will not be returning.

reviews.title: Awesome as usual
reviews.text: Off the strip but walking distance to most places. Parking abundant and easily accessible with no fee and close to your room. Rates always great. For a cafeteria, Marilyn's food is better than most restaurants with better than average pricing. If you want an  upscale dinning experience go the the Tuscany Gardens. I've been staying at the Tuscany Inn for the last 5 years. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites is a hidden gem and definitely underrated. The grounds are gorgeous and well kept. Many upgrades and refreshed areas. Most clean hotel in Vegas. Energy efficient all throughout property.  Ambience provides a European feel. Short walk/car ride to the strip. Family friendly and no shady characters in sight. Staff is so welcoming and friendly! Truly, a great spot and stay.

reviews.title: Nice Digs
reviews.text: A roomy and very comfortable Suite. The fact that the Buildings are apart from the Casino make the experience much quieter. Really enjoyed the stay.Will definitely consider planing my next trip, weather business of pleasure staying here.

reviews.title: August Vacation to Las Vegas
reviews.text: Despite rainy weather we had a great time in Vegas.  Love the lounge shows at Tuscany Suites.  Staff was amazing as always.  Location close to the strip is nice.  We would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Awesome but resort fees ruin the over experience
reviews.text: Overall great experience, nice room, clean.  My only complaint is the mandatory resort fees charged that we never use. I didn’t know these fees would be changed until I was checking in.  Booked online through 3rd party

reviews.title: Pleasant and relaxing hotel-casino
reviews.text: Free parking without the need for a valet. Several buildings of up to 3 floors. Our two queen room was huge, with a living room and kitchen. Tree-lined paths between the different buildings.Pleasant pool area. Several internal restaurants and cafes where you can dine or have breakfast.Not too far from the Bellagio fountains (about 10-15 minutes walk).Compared to the mega complexes of Las Vegas or skyscraper hotels, this hotel is less chaotic and more relaxing.I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.title: Top Hotels!
reviews.text: Top Hotel!!! Rooms as large as if they were a studio apartment and clean, large bathroom. Comfortable bed. If you want to have breakfast you can go to the "caffè bottega" which is a place inside the hotel. Good location. For me it is 10 in all this structure.

reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: We had an amazing and relaxing stay! Our room was big and comfortable. It smelled nice and clean. A dinig table and chairs plus a sofa made us feel home. There was a mini kitchen area but no supplies were provided. Although, we found the TV to be small for the room and the beds seem not for double. The pool was nice and enjoyable. Retaurants were available so no need to go out but near the hotels are several restaurants as well. We enjoyed staying here, we will be back!

reviews.title: Complete
reviews.text: Room were great , staff was very helpful and friendly t/o the property. Definitely will stay again. They had everything needed to just stay on property, only thing missing was table games . Restaurant was awesome as well

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: Beautiful suite and minimal expense...it has a nice swimming pool, free internal parking, clean and beautiful...if I returned to Vegas I would 100% return here...a stone's throw from the strip, among other things in its most beautiful part ...very low figure indeed

reviews.title: There for convention; and enjoyed every moment!
reviews.text: The suites are huge! The beds, and bedding, wonderful.The food is spectacular; even the happy hour specials are first class!There is free live entertainment every night, and The Rat Pack is Back is so fun to flash back to the 60’s when Everyone was offended; and nobody cared!!!

reviews.title: Perfect stay off the strip
reviews.text: It was a quiet and cozy night’s sleep! Nice pool and the  room was spacious and clean. Would stay there again. Restaurants were close by and the cab ride to the strip was around $15 including tip. What a fun time we had!

reviews.title: Rooms are old and smell
reviews.text: Very disappointed!! We have been staying at Tuscany Inn for years. And always happy because rooms were clean and spacious. This time the room smelled so bad like cigarettes and it was a nonsmoking room. And everything in the room was so old. We won’t be back. 😡 And hotel staff was not accommodating or apologetic about the smoke smelling room. We checked out as early as possible and we’re out of there.

reviews.title: Weekend get away.
reviews.text: Disappointed. I’ve stayed several times and was let down because of no card tables. Beware that they add a 22% service fee at the pool. So do you still tip after the service fee? Well I did for the sake of the server.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: Check in and Check out was easy and not in the casino. Room was comfortable with a nice view. Amenities included coffee in the room, a refrigerator and much more. Great cafe and live music in the evening in the lounge/bar. Would stay again

reviews.title: The place is nice .
reviews.text: The place is Nice without the hassle of the strip hotels. They need table games . The  grounds and pool area were clean . Pub 365 is Outstanding .The main hotel bar is what you would expect of a hotel in Las Vegas .

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: We like the hotel, the staff were really nice the pool was great and our room was clean and comfortable. It had coffee, a small fridge and table to sit at. It is close to the strip, and easy walk and much less noise. The only negative thing was we thought the lobby had a funny smell.

reviews.title: My solo getaway
reviews.text: It was a very peaceful solo vacation and spend time in prayer with Jesus. I was able to complete all of my Summer session in school. I purchased a timeshare for the first time. Very exciting decision for future vacation plans. Thank you 😊🙏🏿

reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: Perfect walk distance from Strip, easy parking, perfect pool, big rooms, very good bed. It is my second time in this hotel and I`ll come back for sure. Best value/benefit in Vegas. Very good amenities.

reviews.title: The working vacation that was all play
reviews.text: This was one of the best " Get aways" ever, it was so nice I stayed a few extra days..  Every morning when it came time to check out, I just couldn't do it, the Tuscany was very accommodating and I would add another day,, I did that twice and so now it's Monday morning and I must return to reality,, until next time ...

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: Best hotel off the strip!  Our go-to forever when it comes to staying in Vegas.  Within walking distance of the strip but without all the craziness of the strip casinos. Gigantic rooms with lots of amenities, immaculate, awesome staff and great rates.   So happy we found you!

reviews.title: Satisfying customer
reviews.text: We enjoy our stay at Tuscany Suites. The staffs are friendly and the room is very spacious and clean. We like that it’s away from the strips but not too far. I recommend Tuscany to anyone, especially our friends and family

reviews.title: In Las Vegas without the typical confusion
reviews.text: Far from the confusion of the strip which can be reached with a twenty minute walk.Although small compared to the typical megastructures of Las Vegas, it lacks nothing of what you expect in the city of entertainment: swimming pool, casino, restaurant, bar, pub and nightclub.

reviews.title: Return Visit
reviews.text: Friendly staff, clean room. The food is great, and I love their cappuccinos. Always a pleasure. I messed up and made the reservation for the wrong date and they rectified the error and did not charge me for the mistake.

reviews.title: Not the greatest visit
reviews.text: Rooms were only ok Room was not spotless, shower would not maintain temperature. Shower valve was broken. Took over 2 hours to get batteries changed in tv remote. Customer service was untrained and didn’t know proper procedures.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Like a big holiday village in the middle of Las Vegas. Very cheap, extremely comfortable beds, microwave brought immediately free of charge on request. 15' walk to the Strip/Bellagio/Eiffel Tower. Very nice staff, parking in front of the door, low additional charges, great pool.

reviews.title: Nice, relaxing hotel
reviews.text: We spent 4 nights at Tuscany’s, very nice , resort style hotel, more on the quiet, relaxing style, this was exactly what we were looking for,  to stay away from the crowds on the strip.The room was clean, spacious (avoid block A on the road side),  we spent 1 night in this block and we changed the room as it was noisy, we could hear the traffic outside), the staff was very nice and helpful to accomodate us.The gardens / patio are well maintained and the pool is clean with quality chairs & shades, towels are provided.We also enjoyed the food options at the hotel, Cafe Bottega was our favourite with delicious coffee, smoothies, sandwiches, muffins and salads!The hotel is at 10-15 min walk from the strip, which was perfect and we also used uber(good prices)  to go downtown or to further hotels.We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel and loved our Las Vegas experience, we will definitely return!

reviews.title: A Person
reviews.text: I love the Tuscany for its friendly atmosphere. I have a favorite machine  at which I sit. The employees are very helpful and the environment is clean. I always have a good time here. It is also not overcrowded.

reviews.title: Short Vegas Trip To Visit Family Who Spends A Lot Of Time At Tuscany
reviews.text: Our room was as described and the bed was comfortable, housekeeping was on top of everything....Service at Marilyn's was good as usual,  (German) was awesome and made us laugh... on Sunday  8/20, The Pub 365 was terrible,  our server Katrina was rude and the looks she gave me when I questioned her were unacceptable...if looks could kill, I'd be dead.  We talked to the manager at the Pub and he was useless as well...I understand wanting to stand up for your employees, but what about the customer?  We ended up speaking with the MOD for the resort and he took our statement and gave us 4 free drink tickets, offered to pay for our dinner at Marilyn's and ensured us someone from upper management would be contacting us since we were staying there....well, we paid for our own dinner, and gave the drink tickets to someone else since we were gambling and drinks were free...Five days later and still haven't heard from "upper management ".The 2 star rating is based on the Pub experience.

reviews.title: Bad  Experience and Guest Service
reviews.text: We have stayed here before and loved it so this time we decided to indulge ourselves with the upgraded Executive Pool View with Lanai as described on their website. My wife had planned on massage, and we love the restaurants onsite and the nightly entertainment. Well it all started shortly after we arrived: We arrived at 2:30 PM & we were told our room would be ready in 15-20 minutes, they were putting a rush on it. OK not bad as we were a bit early, at 3:10 PM, were were told yes they were in room cleaning another 15-20 minutes. At 4 pm, the front desk told us might be 5 or 6 pm. That's ridiculous. Room was finally was ready around 4:35 PM. When we finally  got into our room about 5 pm after moving car, (and waiting on valet service for luggage), the closet doors were off the track, and we had requested a microwave which was suppose to be in the room and wasn't. The biggest disappointment came when we opened our curtains to our lanai.  We had paid for the upgraded Executive Pool View Room with Lanai. We had a view of the backs of two huge lanais. All canvas Tents: NO VIEW AT ALL. The best they could do was move us to a cheaper room the next day, and charge us less. (They had an empty room next to ours with the view we paid for) that was empty, but later that night they checked someone else into that room. The first desk clerk called told us we could move to it, but another clerk called back later called and said we couldn't and didn't have a room with the view available.  We will never be back. Here is Tuscany's Description on hotel website:    Enjoy an upgraded suite, overlooking our resort lagoon style pool and lush landscapes.  Our Pool View Executive Suites offer a prime location within the property, offering even easier access to the resort and casino facilities.  (check out our photos of the room they gave us)! We had loved this place, and referred our friends and clients there. Never again. We booked a room the next morning at a larger hotel on the strip, received early check in, upgraded room with the view we paid for...same price.

reviews.title: Humble and understanding staff
reviews.text: Awesome experience here, staff and security were helpful and friendly. 5 stars. Huge room, was never bothered. When we needed help security and front desk staff was there. Fast wifi. Air conditioning worked great.

reviews.title: Please refund 1 room on this Tuscan Hotel trip
reviews.text: Hello ,we need a refund on one of the rooms ,we booked 2 rooms and we we arrived the hotel had a problem  and would only give us 1 room - it took an hour to get us in .and after driving 5 hours we were stuck with 1 room very uncomfortable and didn't sleep well  .This was business and the hotel situation was ruff .please credit 1 room .Thank you Richard West / Credit to Lena Andre card

reviews.title: Pull Out Couch, No sheets.
reviews.text: I stumbled in at 3am with no reservation. I told the front desk person I need a bed and also a pull out couch bed to accommodate my family.  I was told no problem. I got to my room and there were no sheets waiting for me for the couch bed. I was told by the manager the next day that I had to ask for them. I think it’s poor protocol to not have them sent immediately once it was clear I was using the bed. I as a customer should not have to ask for them a second time. I slept on the coach bed without sheets  because I was too exhausted to call housekeeping at 3:30am for something that should have been sent automatically. The manager did take of the resort fee which I appreciated but I think as a management staff your protocols need to change for this situation. Especially, when I’m paying that much money for one night and the check out was 11am. It was not a good experience and it could have been had your team thought through this vs. putting it on me to ask.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Tuscany. We ate at Pub 365 and it was delicious! We used the pool and the kids had a blast. The rooms were a nice size and the mini fridge was a nice bonus.  We will definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Spacious rooms
reviews.text: The rooms were big and spacious which was a big plus. The only minor issue we had was finding  pair of socks underneath the bathroom sink which was probably left from the precious guest. Then we received bath towels that had brown stains on them.  We were on the 1st floor so it got annoying when the guest in the room above of us (their child) were running and jumping up and down. Next time I will request to be on a higher floor.  Overall it was a nice facility and will return again.

reviews.title: Fun Visit
reviews.text: We loved the size of the rooms, the pool was great, cabana service was excellent. Food was very delicious at all restaurants. Gift shop has everything you could need and more. Walking distance to strip. Casino was decent.

reviews.title: Stay for tournament
reviews.text: Was quoted one price over phone got charged more and power went out multiple times during the ATA tournament at the hotelIce maker was broke on our floor as well didn’t get in same building with friends

reviews.title: Fun time
reviews.text: I love the lap pool and gym. The Rat Pack show was great and soo funny. I am telling everybody about the show as it was that good. The rooms were spacious and very clean. Great coffee choices and sandwiches

reviews.title: We found our new home away from home
reviews.text: Only stayed the night because of a family celebration.A beautiful spacious suite, good staff, nice little casino.Stayed in a lot of casinohotels in the past, this one is excellent for a good price.We'll be back!!!

reviews.title: Top hotel
reviews.text: Good, clean and spacious room, spread over several low-rise buildings. At a relatively low price per night compared to other hotels. 2 blocks from the Strip, intersection Flamingo road. Free parking. Friendly staff.

reviews.title: Clean Clean Clean
reviews.text: Everything was awesome. I have told at least 20 people to book there next year. They gave a special price for the multiple rooms we booked for the conference. My room was clean in Building F, Third Floor. No smoke smell. And the keys worked as expected. The only downside is that I received an email asking when I wanted to check in, and I stated 1:00pm. I came from the airport and was told I could not check in until 4pm. Why ask your customers what they need if you have no intention of honoring their needs? The bellman did keep my bags so I was able to go get lunch and meet up with others. But I was not able to freshen up and had airplane clothes on the whole time...that was not the best.

reviews.title: A Great Place at a Great Price
reviews.text: The Tuscany is my hotel of choice in Las Vegas.  It is right in the middle of the 'action', yet less hectic and over-crowded than the high-rise resort-casino hotels.  I also love the free and ample parking, which is somewhat of a rarity in Las Vegas these days. The food, drink and entertainment was excellent!  Friendly staff, great rooms and good rates.  What more would anyone want in a resort casino hotel?

reviews.title: The best price / comfort hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Tuscany Suites is a great place just off the strip, super friendly staff, big rooms nice pool & facilities and all at reasonable prices.The Casino is also big enough and they have regular competitions / events

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel for the value!!!!
reviews.text: I was very impressed with this hotel! Came in for a business trip decided to stay off the strip, and what a great decision that was! The hotel was super clean, staff was wonderful, and my room was fantastic!! I got the pool view executive room 620 ft.² and it was the perfect choice. The price I paid I thought it wouldn’t live up to the photos I saw online it but I was wrong and it exceeded my expectations!!I highly recommend this to people who don’t want to be on the noisy Strip!!! It was an easy walk from the hotel to get to the Strip.

reviews.title: Casino
reviews.text: The place was awesome worker are nice and very helpful I will be back thanks again and the casino was good and very friendly and clean my wife said she had fun for her birthday and want to come back so we will definitely be back

reviews.title: Great sized rooms in a quieter location
reviews.text: Good location just off the strip. About a 15 min walk to Las Vegas Blvd. Low rise buildings.  Cafe is pretty good for food, unimpressed with the Pub (Pub 365) especially the food choices.Rooms are a great size with plenty of space to scatter your stuff

reviews.title: Best place to stay
reviews.text: When I head to Vegas, I always stay at the Tuscany, I love the pool and all the surroundings of an old Italian building. I also love the fact that it’s a couple blocks off the strip so it’s not crazy 24/7

reviews.title: Have stayed here several times
reviews.text: Love this property.  Beautiful grounds.  Great home cooking restaurant with reasonable prices.  Nice casino.  Plenty of free parking.  Big room and bathroom that were quiet.  Our first room had a leaking air conditioner that soaked our carpet so we moved to a different room.

reviews.title: Tuscany ... just ok.
reviews.text: Overall the room was "acceptable"The couch is extremely uncomfortable 😫 The shades wouldn't close all the way. The screen door was broken and it took nearly a day to get the refrigerator to work.Your staff was friendly. Bummer your restaurant was closed. The Pub was a drag. Workers weren't great.Food was at times BAD and not a mention of "oh can I get something else for you" ... Paid alot for the 2 rooms. Not sure what I will do in the future.

reviews.title: Great value and excellent Italian restaurant on grounds.  Nice pool.  Renovated rooms.  Ask for a top floor.
reviews.text: Great value and excellent Italian restaurant on grounds.  Nice pool.  Renovated rooms.  Ask for a top floor.

reviews.title: Had a great time!
reviews.text: The set up was like apartments, not hard to get around. I liked that we didn't really have to leave the hotel to enjoy ourselves. Tuscany had it all...entertainment, restaurants, cafes, a gift shop, and close to the strip!

reviews.title: Greats!
reviews.text: Friendly staff! Room are big and great! Casinos amazing! Food is great! Easy to get around! Bars at the casino are Amazon! Highly recommended for the price! Quiet rooms! Had a great time here for 4 days!

reviews.title: Large rooms and good service
reviews.text: Staff was great, the size and the servicing of the room was perfect. The large guest room was refreshing since we were not crowded in. The restaurant was great and my friend loved he carrot cake. We will certainly be back.

reviews.title: Nice room, friendly staff, quiet location
reviews.text: A great place to avoid the noise of the strip. Everything there is nice, rooms are comfortable, and I always enjoy my time there, this is maybe my 5th or 6th time staying there while visiting in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Check in was easy, very quiet and our room was spacious and comfortable. My only complaint is that we wanted a microwave, and we called while we were out seeing a show. They wouldn’t deliver it unless we were there. So we didn’t get back until 11:30 and then had to wait. But it was fairly quick and he was super nice. I will definitely stay here again

reviews.title: Close to the Strip without the $$$
reviews.text: The room was large and clean. Unlike other hotels in Vegas, the room had a kitchenette (with coffee maker and fridge), dining table, and a desk. Relatively close walk to the Strip, less than 15 minutes.

reviews.title: Good option for hacker summer camp
reviews.text: Great  location  off  the  strip. Good  options  for  breakfast. Very  helpful  staff. A little  bit  old, but quiet enough for reading on the pool and family-oriented. Extra bonus: you get a good view of the sphere.

reviews.title: 5 Stars from the Family!
reviews.text: The hotel is great! We 50th Annual Family Reunion there and it was amazing. The staff was so polite, kind, helpful and professional. The rooms are newly renovated. They are large and spacious!  The ballroom size was perfect for our family function. The pool area was so nice and kid friendly.  5 Stars!

reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: I really love staying at the Tuscany. It’s the third time I’ve stayed there. It’s a great hotel. I love the restaurants everything is very conveniently located. It’s only a quick walk about 15 minutes to some of the other places in the middle of the strip.

reviews.title: Always a good experience, and a good price
reviews.text: The Security BSides Las Vegas conference has been at Tuscany for many years, they've always been great to work with. The hotel rooms are large, and kept clean- and you can't beat the price. The location is right off the strip, and being off-strip means it is easier to navigate the rest of the city, on or off-strip.

reviews.title: Nice property only blocks from the strip;
reviews.text: Nice clean and spacious room, only thing missing was a microwave oven. I've stayed here many times and it never disappoints.  You get no noise from the strip traffic and the staff was very courteous. I look forward to another visit soon.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
reviews.text: This is an absolute hidden treasure! The prices of the rooms are very affordable. The rooms were very clean, as were the outside grounds. The only thing I would like to see is maybe some sort of shuttle for the buildings that are further away from the street and lobby.

reviews.title: Mostly Good
reviews.text: I've stayed at this hotel a few times and love it. During this trip I was a little disappointed as the bathroom was not fully cleaned. There was hair in the bathtub and hair on the shower walls. I had to wipe down the counter as well.

reviews.title: My stay at was Perfect
reviews.text: Excellent! We totally enjoyed our visit what we have talked about the most is our stay at your hotel! Thank you we would love to come again... Send your special deals we might come back sooner! Thank you for everything!

reviews.title: I very happy staying at the Tuscany.
reviews.text: I come to Vegas every other week for the last 3 months and I very happy staying at the Tuscany. Issues come up no matter what resort you stay at, but I really like the way the Tuscany handle them. Thanks for making my stays comfortable.

reviews.title: Bad service for a wheel chair person
reviews.text: You should train your employees better so they know how to deal with discapable people because I had a very bad experience with your service and how you did not help when it was needed or when I asked for it

reviews.title: A nightmare
reviews.text: The check-in was an absolute nightmare. The person at the reception did not give me the type of room I had booked. It seems he did not know which rooms have king bed, queens beds, extra sofa-bed. After a while I insisted to talk to a responsible person. Finally more than two hours after our arrival to the hotel, I got what I had reserved.Rooms spacious, but with many broken things.Housekeeping staff friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Just perfect; great location, beautiful grounds, lovely bars
reviews.text: For the USA, this hotel is fantastic value for money.  The grounds are beautiful, our room was out of this world, so spacious.  It is fantastically located at the end of the 'strip' with just a 10 minute walk and you are into the action in Vegas.  If there was one disappointment, it was that the casino was all slot machines, so if you want poker or roulette etc. you'll need to walk to other casinos.  But all in all, would very much recommend this wonderful place.

reviews.title: Evo 2023
reviews.text: Overall great stay! I would stay again next visit! Very spacious room and the amenities super clean very accommodating and accessible.Thank you for a very comfortable stay, it really did make the trip worth it!

reviews.title: Hotel Stay
reviews.text: Great property-we liked the feel of staying at a "smaller" hotel instead of a big high rise.  Rooms are huge & spotless.  Good location too-off the strip but within walking distance of everything.  The restaurants are great too.

reviews.title: A good time and some minor flaws.
reviews.text: Bathroom shower door needs adjustment. No big deal. Towel holder on wall fell off. Toilet seat lid won’t stay up. Unable to lock main door due to misalignment. Other than that, I love staying there. Classy, low density, relaxing.  Will definitely return.

reviews.title: Great hotel in a great location!
reviews.text: Great hotel in a great location and at a fair price for Las Vegas! Small structure of several buildings of 3 floors each and surrounded by palm trees. It feels like you're near the sea. We're a 10-minute walk from the strip: so we have the advantages without the disadvantages. We are calm!!The bedroom and bathroom are super big and very chic! Everything is super modern and nicely decorated. We have a table and chairs for eating in the room. There is a large fridge, it’s great!The pool is very nice and they lend us towels! Plus it closes at 10 p.m.! So you can relax after a long day of walking.You can park the car for free in a car park which is closed at nightThere are restaurants at the foot of the hotel if you wish.The bedding is great too: we slept really well. Very well soundproofed roomsIf I had the chance I would go back without hesitation!!! It's just magnificent!

reviews.title: Below average
reviews.text: The fridge was off when I arrived and the carpet was wet. The uncleaned shower had old soap and the cold water never got hot. I have stayed here a few times but this will be the last time. It is quite dated and the standard has dropped significantly.

reviews.title: OK hotel but bed too small
reviews.text: Hotel well located next to the strip however bed too small for 2 (120 cm) for the USA it's surprising entertainment in the evening in the hotel however it was indicated kitchenette and no dishes we had to ask for a microwave oven so apart from a refrigerator there is nothing

reviews.title: Very good price-performance
reviews.text: The room was clean, the shower was hot and self-parking and WIFI were important to us!The pool is also good.You could see the Sphere well from our hallwayNext time we're in Vegas we'll book Tuscany again

reviews.title: Good but too bad for the swimming pool
reviews.text: The rooms are beautiful, spacious and comfortable. The hotel is very pleasant and on a human scale.The only negative point: the swimming pool, too small with many children and young people jumping and screaming in the water until closing at 10 p.m. On the other hand, many people swim dressed and I find that it is not hygienic, in fact the water in the pool was cloudy. In short, with the heat in Las Vegas in the middle of summer, it's a problem.

reviews.title: Perfect accommodations
reviews.text: Room was spacious and clean, even though we would still be in the room when cleaning was being done, we always came back to made beds and new trash bags. Great price for the area and the hotel itself had a casino, spa, pool, and restaurants. Close to the strip and the monorail at the Horseshoe hotel, which we used daily. Friendly and helpful staff. Easy check in and check out process.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel casino in Vegas
reviews.text: Nice hotel and casino. About 10 minutes to the Strip. Free parking and nice pool. Everything very neat and clean. Very large rooms, ideal for families. Large complex with several complexes.

reviews.title: Excellent for the price.
reviews.text: Rooms were spaces and the staff was super friendly.   Only complaint, the furniture was a little worn.  The grounds were well taken care of and it would be a nice place to spend relaxing or taking in some casino activity.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I’ve been staying at the Tuscany twice a year for the last 5 years ish. This last trip was the final straw.  Also there was a negative incident during our previous stay that forced us to move rooms I won’t bother outlining here.  Will never stay there again. I realize it is 110 outside in July but they should not rent rooms that don’t have adequate AC. Our room never got below 79 degrees at night. We were in Vegas for work and it was miserable trying to sleep and function the next day! Talked to Manager and maintenance and the solution was to swap the AC unit out for another antique beat up old unit, that worked for 5 mins then stopped producing cold air. These rooms with the old AC units should not be rented. Either spend the money to replace them or don’t rent the space! To add insult to injury the ice machines in the building (n) stopped producing ice. I complained to management and they did nothing for us. Nothing! No gestures of good will. It’s as if they didn’t care if we ever came back. I realize something’s are out of their control but I feel they don’t value my business so I’m done with the Tuscany Vegas.

reviews.title: Not great for families of more than 3.
reviews.text: You get what you pay for. The rooms were very spacious but the beds were tiny. 2-full size beds and no pull out couch. A family of 4 can not even stay comfortably. Room service was not great.  Our room was clean but our friends had to be switched rooms as they found dog poop under the bed. I didn’t realize when we booked that the property was like an apartment complex. To get to the main casino or restaurants you had to walk outside in the 115 degree heat so we chose just not to use our own hotel for those things. There are two pools but both quite small considering how large this property is.

reviews.title: Beds are not queen
reviews.text: This is our second time staying here and we loved it but we are currently staying here (check out is 7/31/23) and so far we requested a double queen room and the beds are clearly not queens! Definitely doubles!!! We have 2 teenage boys that are 0ver 6’2 and both have queens at home and they can barely fit on the beds that were provided in our room! Not to mention my husband and myself can barely fit as well!! The last time we stayed here the beds were a true queens!! This is a disappointment given the fact that we will be here for 6 nights!

reviews.title: Inconsistent but somewhat enjoyable.
reviews.text: Everything looks good, but it has to function well too. Fridge and hot water issues. Card was supposedly declined but I received a confirmation email in May. Why did I get it then? Debit not allowed... should be better.

reviews.title: Attending the champs show..
reviews.text: Room was ready in advance,Clean.. No complaints at all!’Food at restaurants were great Bellman was very helpful, the gift shop for same basics was a bit pricey …Would highly recommend a stay at the Tuscany

reviews.title: Will no stay again
reviews.text: Bath are to old, customer service is terrible, the company of no,every thing I asked for was a no no no . building to far from the lobby. No shuttle bus to the airport.Resort fees to high.Good location, very close to the attractions, was the best of my stay.

reviews.title: Safety hazard!!!
reviews.text: We stayed in room B311, an executive suite with two queen size beds. The room was nice, however the toilet was so low to the ground for a child! My 80 year old mom, sat down to use the toilet and went to get up, and fell forward onto her knees! Zero bar, too grab onto! My mom is in incredible shape, zero meds and weight trains! She’s not an elderly 80 year old woman!  I would never recommend this place ever, I filled out a complaint! I know this is a safety issue for future guests! They have yet to respond to our complaint!

reviews.title: Nice rooms but go anywhere else for gambling and entertainment
reviews.text: The front desk staff did their job but we’re not very friendly.The “half price” Happy Hour was great and the drinks were delicious. The bartenders were polite and friendly and made good drinks as well as good conversation. And then I got the check. There was a Happy Hour service charge which literally added back in the “half” I thought I was saving. NOT COOL!!The casino was small and kind of sad and there were very few people in there .

reviews.title: Horrible Experience!!
reviews.text: Our suite was dirty! Hair in the shower and sink! The compensation was a $40 food and drink credit for three adults. What are three adults going to do with a total of $40 in Vegas?!  Also, one of the rooms was supposed to have double beds, and we had a king size bed.

reviews.title: Nice place.
reviews.text: Nice clean room, good restaurants, nest to eat at the restaurant due to a $1 take out charge on every item. ATM fee was only $3.50. Not to far from the main strip and about  17 min walk to the big wheel.

reviews.title: Excellent clean Hotel and full Casino, a real gem, just off the Strip!
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites & Casino, believe me, is a pleasant surprise, a bit of a hidden gem 2 blocks off the strip ! I have stayed at most of the 4 and 5 star hotels in Las Vegas and it is so pleasant as you don't have the tumult of people that you have in almost all of the Strip Hotels.It is only a 10-15 minute walk to the strip, and at an excellent price, which you may not have the ultra luxury that you may look for, but ist has almost everything that most  hotels and casinos have, but scaled down.I highly recommend trying it out, I will use it exclusively for any work related business I often have in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Too hot to live here. Grateful for the ac.
reviews.text: It was a fine place to stay in Vegas. Good food, mostly quiet in my room. Other than the hotel price being more that I eco, the only one complaint I had was with the bathroom. The sink was a little clogged and the toilet seat was broken.

reviews.title: Week day visit
