reviews.text: Slots were decent, not much sports betting, we’re not able to get a king size bed but still enjoyed our stay. Also Marilyn’s menu is not as good as it used to be. We spent time on the strip and Fremont street as well to get some diversity.

reviews.title: Black spot in bed
reviews.text: I was disappointed when I checked in. When I got to my room, there was a black spot in the bed. I call the front desk. I  was told the only thing they could do was bring me new bedding. I would have to make my bed up myself. I informed the man that I was talking to that this is unacceptable. I do not work for the hotel I’m a paying guess.

reviews.title: Great week!!
reviews.text: The food was great and everyone is so nice and friendly. It was very relaxing time for us ! The only thing to improve on was the bed. It was too hard. It would be good to put a grab bar in the shower.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: No microwave in the rooms. Major delta for me with such high food prices and no way to heat leftovers. I would have loved to go a cheaper route with food purchases but it was impossible Not every family can afford over $150 per meal.

reviews.title: Great Trip!
reviews.text: We were able to check in to our room early and didn't have any issues during our stay.  The hotel was clean and the staff was friendly.  We enjoyed meals at Marilyn's Cafe and Caffe Bottega.  We will definitely consider staying here again.

reviews.title: An oasis in the middle of the strip
reviews.text: The hotel is ideally located near the strip but quiet. It felt like an oasis in the middle of the hôtels towers around. We felt like in tuscany for real! The suites are big, clean and comfortable. The only minor flaw is that the beds are a bit small for 2 adults. The staff was helpfull and efficient. We had a great time there. Thank you

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The past 8 years we have done a July Vegas trip.Most of the time we have stayed at Tuscany Suites and whenever we stayed elsewhere we wished we were at Tuscany Suites. It is a awesome place to escape from the craziness of "the strip".

reviews.title: Canceled
reviews.text: Usually love staying here, but they canceled our reservation for not having a credit card to use for deposit. Other Vegas hotels do not require them so it was unfortunate. Had to find somewhere else same day.

reviews.title: The Tuscany Resort and Casino is a Fine Property but could be improved.
reviews.text: We had a nice experience overall, and I particularly liked the fine evening entertainment and the Rat Pack show/ excellent dinner. Unfortunately, the poster for Wed. night's free lounge entertainment time was an hour off which caused us to leave the poolside an hour early to see the musical performance. Posted entertainment times should be accurate.I asked for a microwave at check-in, and when I made the reservation online, but the requested microwave never arrived. I could have asked a third time.The reservation process and service were great. The room was spacious, well-maintained and clean. However, we were disappointed that our 3rd-floor pool view windows were dirty. I paid extra for the pool view, which unfortunately had dirty spotted windows. Pool view windows should be prioritized and squeaky clean. Who wants to look out through dirty spotted windows when they've paid extra for the pool view? Other than this disappointing issue, the room was great.I didn't appreciate the included tip in the lounge tab total, which was undisclosed. A tip line on the receipt does not show an amount, so it appears as if a tip is not included in the total. However, a tip Is Included in the total, which is split among the employees. Imo, that issue needs to be addressed, and other guests I spoke with felt the same. It's fine the way it is as long as you don't mind double-tipping!They have nice, free poolside shade umbrella tables, but more are needed. Shade is welcome on hot Vegas days, and more available tables and shade umbrellas would be an improvement for pool users! Either that, or they should build more shade over the pool area.Overall, the Tuscany Resort is a clean, well-maintained property we would highly recommend to others. They have nice amenities, free parking close to the rooms, good restaurants and bars, reasonable Las Vegas prices compared to many other hotels, and friendly staff. They offer guests a secure, pleasant environment, and we look forward to visiting again.

reviews.title: Shocking  behavior at this resort
reviews.text: I stayed at this location  for a work business trip. My company has stayed there  for many years. This year the hotel decided  to shut down the pool for a private  party for five days. No info before  we arrived that the pool would be closed. The group that shut down the pool was called Big Bear. From what I understand, it was a male gay organization.  Not only was the pool shut down, but the amount  of noise out in the hallways at 4 am was ridiculous.  The pot smoking out at the entrance to the buildings by this group was sickening.  Advertisements were left on the room doors promoting a gay party in the fall was unnecessary.  I complained to the front dest that this solicitation was unacceptable.

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites & Casino survey
reviews.text: The property was clean, homy with very professional employees.Unfortunately, having to leave early and coming back late at night or early in the morning, prevented me from discovering and enjoying everything the beautiful site had to offer.

reviews.title: Delightful little resort-style getaway
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay here, this was the first time staying Vegas purely for pleasure and family instead of business, and Tuscany was exactly the sort of relaxing, laid-back environment that served as an oasis compared to the heat and hectic bustle of the strip. Would absolutely stay there again on subsequent visits.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: We were very happy with our stay over all. Clean rooms friendly feont desk staff. On site security was on their game . Beds were a little stiff for our liking.  Other then that our stay was amazing. Will be booking again!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: We have stayed in many resorts over the years, and this is our favorite resort and casino! All the staff were friendly and welcoming. The food in all the restaurants was delicious. We enjoyed the happy hours at the restaurants with deals on food and beverages. We are happy that they brought back a casino host Jennifer who was great! The perks/rewards for playing at the casino were appreciated!

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites
reviews.text: Found this hotel to be excellent value, i was in Vegas to play WSOP and the location was excellent, also the food and drink in both the Bar/Pub and restaurants was excellent quality and price, the pool area was very good, i would recommend this hotel and will book again myself next year

reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: I stay here quite often but this time was the worse. The air conditioning was not working in our room, the pool was dirty and had debri floating around and sticking to you. Housekeeping kept opening the doors around 9a trying to clean the room before check out and scared my kids, MULTIPLE TIMES!

reviews.title: So sn so
reviews.text: Heavy construction in area no one told us about small beds no options to get a rollaway bed we had double not allowed breakfast was same fare tasteless food room service was slow to respond to our needs

reviews.title: Tuscany Suites Rooms
reviews.text: The pillows were very uncomfortable and made it hard to sleep well. Overall the team is simple and clean. It was a great spot when having a rental car since parking is free. The gym and pool are great bonuses with the hotel

reviews.title: Dirty room
reviews.text: Dirty room urine stains on un-flushed toilet seat. A lot of dust. I only rented the room for the night bc we were too tired to drive back so at 2am I wasn’t trying to call down and switch rooms. When I checked out they didn’t ask how my stay was so I didn’t say.

reviews.title: We loved our stay!
reviews.text: We've stayed at the Tuscany a few times. We love the room space. The food onsite is excellent. Hotel is always clean and staff is always friendly and helpful. Hotel is walking distance to the strip. Kitchenette with no microwave but can be requested. Pool is good size. Entertainment onsite. Free and easy parking. Beds are comfortable. Price is great.

reviews.title: Clean
reviews.text: The room cleaning should always stay the same, in the beginning of my stay it was awesome cleaning then the cleaners started being different not as greats as it was in the beginning, maybe they tired?

reviews.title: Great value! Would book again!
reviews.text: Amazing value for a 15 minute walk from the strip. Very quiet property to get some rest between the excitement of Las Vegas. The room was very large, clean, and had all the amenities of a traditional hotel room with a few extras!

reviews.title: Another great stay in my favourite Vegas property
reviews.text: I stayed 9 nights in Tuscany during the last week of June and the first week of July, and this was not my first stay at the property.  I was again so pleased with my overall experience.  The location is central, the property is safe, the rooms are large, they provide a fridge (and microwave on request), and free coffee pods/machine in the room, and housekeeping is automatically provided without the need to "opt in".  I find the property so relaxing when compared to the strip properties.  The gardens are nice and well maintained, and most of the staff are friendly.  And I find that the slots in the casino are usually quite forgiving compared to  strip properties.  A special shout out to Ryan on the check-in desk, and Sonny on the door, who are both excellent and always friendly staff.  I feel that when compared to many other properties, the Tuscany doesn't try to nickel and dime guests on every single thing, like some of the strip properties.  As long as they understand what guests like about their property, and continue providing that, then I will happily keep staying there as my main property during any visit to Vegas.  What Tuscany has is quite unique nowadays, and the best thing they can do is to recognise and protect that, rather than try to copy strip properties.  Most of the guests who stay there, are wise to that, and looking for exactly the value that Tuscany provides.

reviews.title: This trip was for us to visit Nevada
reviews.text: Great place to stay in Vegas we stayed two nights room was clean thing that impressed me most is how nice the staff was . This trip was us to attend a driving school for new corvette owners so we were in and out of Vegas .

reviews.title: Not again
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Vegas for our Anniversary to see Chicago.  We booked months in advance at Tuscany Suites.  We have stayed before several times and like that the parking is close, it is a smaller hotel, they have dedicated non smoking buildings and before this time easy check in.  Went to check in and there was a very long line with many unhappy people.  By the time we got up to the window we were told they were overbooked and didn't have a room for us and would be sending us to another hotel for the evening.  Other people were checking in, but they were bumping us.  Not thrilled at all.  They moved us to the Westgate by the convention center where you can't walk to anything.  Had to go there and check in and wait in that line and they didn't even have the papers yet, but the lady was nice enough to check us in with a deposit.  The Westgate was fine, but then we had to pack it up and move the next morning, why they didn't just put us up there for 2 nights since that is all we were staying, not sure.  Of course, the room wasn't ready to get into after check out from Westgate so had to check in later.  The front desk didn't care at all.  Tried to get ahold of the general manager, Grayson and talked with his assistant Vonya on 2 separate occasions asking for a call back.  Well 4 months later and still no return call.  Was approached by another family when we were getting on the elevator who asked us if we were bumped and when we said yes, they said they had booked months ago too and were very upset.  We believe they bumped us because they booked a convention after we had already booked.  Would have been nice for them to call us ahead of time and say we overbooked and are going to move you to another hotel.  Then we could have made a decision at that point.  I had even called a week before to confirm that reservation and not a word.  Will not stay here again and have told everyone I know not to stay here.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Large room with comfortable bed. Fridge and coffee maker in room. Two pools, one lap pool and other one full size. Staff was very friendly. Walking distance to the strip. Casino on site and restaurants with good food. Close  to the airport.

reviews.title: Beware Rate Changes!!!
reviews.text: Stayed at the Tuscany for a high school reunion. Booked a room under group rates and then was charged DOUBLE the group rate without notice. We tried talking with the front desk and were basically told they couldn’t do anything about it.The room was ok, but the beds were not especially comfortable. Overall disappointed, even though the reunion was fun.

reviews.title: Missed the mark on so many levels
reviews.text: Room was not ready until 5pm, 2 hours after check-in despite completing online check-in the day before.  Was not provided the room I reserved king vs 2 twin and i was told non were availablesince i didnt arrive early in the day.  Completing the online check-in is pointless.  It does save any time at check-in and the front desk staff doesn't seem to have access to the information.   Interactions with the front desk supervisor missed the mark in a city known for hospitality.

reviews.title: Unable to use the pool
reviews.text: This was our second stay at Tuscany and this time booked 3 rooms in Block G one with Lanai and pool access. Our party was 6 adults and this was booked 12 months in advance. I’ve ready in other reviews that “we should of called in advance” to find out if there was a block out booking or advent. We have no issues with the LGBTQ community, our issue was after paying a premium for a room with pool access, only to be told the pool area was closed for a private function for Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday. The reception supervisor Max who has NO customer service skill just stated “it’s our hotel and we do not need to tell you in advance there is a function and if you don’t like it, leave the hotel now and we will refund the balance of your stay” the pool is normal open between 7am to 10pm, this function has a DJ (at VERY high volume) until 2am. One of the management team Kerry  actually apologise that we were not informed in advance of our 9 night stay and agreed to move us to 3 rooms that were away from the party and arrange for us to use the pool in the hotel next door, not ideal but at least she tried to help. Unfortunately we will not be returning to Tuscany Suites.

reviews.title: AMAZING event during Pride Month!
reviews.text: Stayed here in Late May / Early June for an event and the hotel did an amazing job to make sure we were all taken care of.- Rooms are huge and clean, Housekeeping is quick to assist when something is running low.- Pub 365, Marylin Cafe & Cafe Bottega were all great with friendly staff and delicious food.- Check-in was seamless as we checked in online and at arrival we just picked up our room keys and went to our room.- Hotel was off the strip which made it quiet and peaceful however it was a close 15 minute walk to the strip.I would stay here again and recommend to all my friends and family.

reviews.title: My Tuscany Experience
reviews.text: We were here for an LGBTQ+ event, and we had a blast! The Tuscany was overall very inviting to us, and accommodated us to the best of their ability.  Nothing is ever perfect though, and there were some snags. It is just unfortunate that some people need to display their discomfort and entitlement for nothing other than rage-baiting, and falsely communicating to others that puts a negative spotlight on our community. We need our safe spaces to be ourselves. Tuscany was able to hold an event to create that atmosphere for us.

reviews.title: Hidden off strip gem
reviews.text: Great Las Vegas choice.  If you want a large room, off strip and friendly staff, then consider the Tuscany.  I have stayed there multiple times and it’s very walkable to the strip.  The room was large, comfy and clean.  The staff was great from housekeeping to restaurant servers to the front desk.  I would stay there again.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Great place! All workers were very friendly and the rooms were pleasantly larger than most equivalent Vegas rooms.Pool was very nice although the pool deck was a bit slippery. Definitely fell one time but luckily wasn’t hurt.Would definitely stay again!

reviews.title: June 2023 Stay
reviews.text: From the time we checked in to the time we checked out, we did not have an issue. The staff that we encountered was pleasant and accommodating. The food was good and we did not experience an issue with any of the outlets. Our room was large and clean. Great job to the housekeeping staff! Very nice place to stay.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: This is my second time staying at this resort.  As a frequent traveler to Vegas if you are looking for a nice place off the strip then this place is amazing. The rooms are HUGE, the staff is so friendly, the food options are great too.  LGBT friendly at that.  Great job Tuscany, we appreciate you!

reviews.title: Thanks to a Tuscany for hosting our event
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for a LGBT - staff was so great .  Great pool, affordable food .  Rooms are nice and large with couches and refrig.  Only one block fromStrip.  Free parking .  Maids don’t bang on doors so early like on strip

reviews.title: Love the hotel for promoting a LGBT+event and showing their support
reviews.text: First and foremost the the front desk and helpful and friendly and our king room was so roomie and spacious. Secondly, I wanna give props and shout out to the Tuscany hotel for not only making it welcome and safe to host a LGBTQ+ event, not including a bear event!!  There is nobody dressed inappropriately, as I was a attendee at the event and almost everyone was in sort of swimwear from speedo and bikinis, to swim shorts. Now what was best part was tall the vendors and before anyone states that their hanging inappropriate banners (like I know someone else already did)  they promoted different vendors from the LGBTQ COMMUNITY for a full week for fun and enjoyment. No unsure how anyone would have purchased a room on the hotels website directly as the dates were blocked off and were able to be booked unless purchased through a third party( however whatever way, if someone didn’t  like it, they could have talked to the front desk and and either canceling with a full refund)  the point being this hotel showed that they cared about our community and had a full hotel packed!!!! The only one complaint I had was the daiquiris that I bout were the big ones but no one told us the price and was 84 bucks for 2 of them but BRAVO TUSCANY, for showing ur support and hosting us  and WE LOOK FORWARD TO FUTURE EVENTS SO BE PREPAIRED AMD CALL AHEAD BEFORE BOOKING

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: I was able to stay at Tuscany Suites and Casino this past weekend for an event and let me tell you, it is a great venue and would love to stay here again for pleasure and quiet time.  The pool area was great space and lot of lounge chairs to pick and being able to relax in it.  Love the food options too, if you don't feel like walking to the Strip for convenience purposes.  Marilyn's Cafe was a great spot for brunch and lots of options to choose from and Pub 365 was another great spot to watch the Stanley Cup Finals too.  The rooms were huge and spacious to hang out or take a nice nap.  Overall, I enjoyed the experience and the bear event was amazing.  Highly recommend this hotel and if you want to make sure there are no special events going on for the time frame you are going, call the hotel ahead of time.  You can always seek out other options that are not on the Strip and all.

reviews.title: Good choice for convenient outdoor parking
reviews.text: Resort style, good for family, with convenient parking near the rooms. Although the interior is not brand new, the rooms are free of smoke smell, the environment is quiet.  Close to the Vegas strip street.

reviews.title: Comfortable & Quiet Property
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for 9 nights in May 2023. The property is off-strip which was absolutely perfect to get away from the noise and chaos of the strip. It is a very easy 5 min walk to the Horseshoe which links with Paris. The property is tidy. The rooms are a bit old but they are tidy, clean, and functional. We loved the huge size of the rooms and coffee maker. The first 3 nights we were placed in a room which was at the front of the property - street noise was unrelenting, and we were outside the lifts which had mechanical equipment that would turn on at random times during the night creating a huge vibration and loud hum. The hotel were great and moved us to another room which was completely silent. I would stay here again. I liked the location in relation to the strip. The pool area is lovely, and so are the grounds. My only complaint (and this applies to most hotels in Vegas) is the overwhelming stench of old cigarettes which hits you even before you enter the Main Lobby. Thankfully this smell was not in ANY of the accomodation blocks.

reviews.title: Do better, Tuscany Suites!
reviews.text: Double room for self, wife and son.  Beds were so small - wife and I had to sleep in separate beds.  Son had to sleep in couch (not pullout).  Someone came inside our room and turned off our AC (90’s in Vegas now).  Called to inquire - was scolded to remove “Do not Disturb” sign when leaving instead of addressing complaint.  Funny thing is the “Do not Disturb” sign was off the entire day.  Terrible service!  Very rude!  The guest services rep I called stated she could not help and she would call maintenance/engineering,  the AC works fine - someone just turned it off.  We were also told restaurant was open until 2am - kitchen closes at 1 so we missed late night dinner one evening and were too tired to go back out or wait on a delivery.  I would expect that Tuscany Suites could do better - especially with the outrageous resort fees being charged.  But not up to expectations.  I have asked for management and executive follow-up.

reviews.title: Great Service Clean Rooms Hot Slots
reviews.text: Omg, what can I say. The slots were Hot and my whole trip paid. For starters. As for the checkin great start. Catherine is truly phenomenal and takes customer service to the next level. She needs a raise! Upgraded to a king bed smoking room, we don’t smoke and if smoke smells don’t bother you, the room was very tolerable. The sheets were perfect as well as the bed. Very spacious room and big bathroom. Room has mini coffee pot to start of your day. The hotel has everything you need at decent prices. The entertainments are nice. Maid service very helpful. Security abundant and cordial. Pool areas clean and towels near by. Just a great experience. In my opinion the 150 holding fee is not much it came back 2 days after our stay. Also resort fee not too shabby compared to on the strip. Tax is tax  what can we say that’s not Tuscany fault. I feel that the people we encountered that worked at Tuscany or its Affillates such as the restaurants, are genuinely happy to be there and to me that goes to show this establishment is ran well. Don’t forget to tip, stop at the Botega,see the shows, and play those hot slots.We can at the beggining of the week right before Memorial Day.

reviews.title: Great Vegas hotel!
reviews.text: Have stayed at the Tuscany Suites on three trips to Las Vegas. It is a wonderful hotel and a nice break from the stiff, gaudiness of the Strip. Tuscany Gardens restaurant is excellent! Going back to the Tuscany in September.

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations!
reviews.text: We were looking for a place off The Strip with a relaxed atmosphere and a nice pool area and came across Tuscany Suites & Casino on a Google search. My husband and I spent a week in May 2023 and absolutely loved our stay! The room was excellent, the casinos has lots of different slot machines, the player club incentives and draws were excellent, great dining choices and very friendly staff! We were most impressed by how clean the entire resort is and the gardening/landscaping is beautiful - just like a desert oasis! Thank you Tuscany for making our 30th Anniversary that much more special!!

reviews.title: Unclear Cash Forward Rules Led to Misunderstanding
reviews.text: I had an issue with The Guestbook's Cash Forward rules due to a lack of clear communication on their website. The misunderstanding arose when I found out that rewards earned at Tuscany Suites & Casino couldn't be redeemed at the same hotel, a rule not stated on their site but only revealed by Rochelle from customer service. Despite Rochelle's response, I felt my concerns were insufficiently addressed, leading to unnecessary hassle and disappointment. Future customers should be aware of this potential pitfall before using their service.

reviews.title: Great Off-Strip Experience
reviews.text: Just returned from a very enjoyable week at the Tuscany. All staff were helpful and cheerfully answered our requests. Restaurant service at all venues was great, as were the meals. The grounds were very well maintained and had a tropical setting with plenty of shade available around the pool The suites were spacious and perfectly adequate for our needs. This isn't a "luxury" strip front hotel, but that's not what we were looking for. It's quiet and tucked away a few blocks from the Strip, which suited us just fine for this short vacation. The only negative is the poor sound proofing between the floors. No issues between the rooms themselves, but when guests walked across the floor in the room above us it sounded like a band of bass drums being pounded on by manic drummers. Make sure you get a room on the top floor to avoid this issue. We had an otherwise wonderful stay.

reviews.title: Great spot in Las Vegas to relax and enjoy
reviews.text: This wonderful resort, just off the strip, is a great place to get away from it all. The rooms are very spacious, the restaurants on site are wonderful and the facilities have it all. We were there for a reunion with a group of 20 old friends and had a great time! The pool is lovely and the service all over the site was high quality.

reviews.title: A calm oasis from Las Vegas
reviews.text: Although I disliked Las Vegas, the Tuscany provided an oasis of calm to enjoy drinks by the pool and the sunshine. Parking was easy, as was the check in. The room was large with comfortable beds. Like most of Vegas, vegetarian food was limited but I was expecting anything different.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: This hotel is just a couple of blocks from Las Vegas Blvd. It is a smaller hotel but has everything you need. Restaurants..a bar..shows..casino and a really nice pool and outdoor area. It is clean,quiet and the staff are very nice. Will definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Exceptional experience
reviews.text: Tuscany is a quiet oasis off the strip. Nice sized suites, offering a microwave ( upon request) small refrigerator and table seating in the kitchen area. Large sofa, chair and coffee table and nice sized beds. Large bathroom, separate tub and shower. Small, quiet casino that offers plenty of action. I’ve seen a lot of very large jackpots paid out here. The staff is exceptionally friendly and remembers you from previous visits. Marilyn’s Cafe food is great, and the staff is even better. It’s our home away from home. Love staying here.The gym is large and never busy. 2 pools are available, a lap pool and relaxing pool.

reviews.title: Security lack of knowledge and accusing minors of stealing based of appearance
reviews.text: Me my two brothers two sisters and parents booked the last weekend of April and checked in at 11 once we dropped our belongings off we left and continued with our day we came back to the hotel around 10:45pm we later on went to the gift shop for snacks around 11 pm when checking out a security guard (Raymond juarez) comes into the store and quickly leaves when we exit the shop he stops my 15 year old brother and asks to empty his pockets when he does so he says he was caught stealing on surveillance he then radios and asks which one of us and which pocket he then says that my brother put it down his pants and asks him to remove them thank god my brother had shorts under he removed them and shows he had nothing stolen from the shop our parents later take us back to the hotel and they leave to file a complaint whilst filing the complaint they have head security which is the same guy that accused my brother of stealing he says it was based off of surveillance footage of him picking up an item and leaving it in a different place he then goes on to say it was also based off of his appearance to accuse him of stealing never stay here again.

reviews.title: Great meal
reviews.text: We ate dinner here in the Italian restaurant. Fabulous. the best meal we had in Las Vegas. Soup, salad, fillet mignon steak and tiramisu. A bottle of pinot grigio. Perfect. Lovely helpful waiter. Thoroughly enjoyed our meal.

reviews.title: Stay Away: Disappointing
reviews.text: Nice property, difficult staff, lack of management on-site to address issues resulting in very poor customer service.Room type booked was not honored and worse still, despite verification of the room type and upgrade being presented by the customer, the ‘manager’ on duty lacked the ability to grant the necessary change. Front office manager was unresponsive and staff seems generally inexperienced, lacking in common sense and certainly not customer focused.We are trying a series of different hotels/resorts this week to review as part of our top ‘off Strip’ places to stay in Las Vegas. This was a poor start unfortunately.The room allocated was away from the main area, smelled of smoke and was in average condition.

reviews.title: Great value hotel near the strip.
reviews.text: Loved this hotel, wish we had stayed longer. Spacious rooms, lovely pool and splendid jacuzzi. Helpful staff. Would have been 5 stars had the pool not been closed for cleaning when I turned up at 8am on the day we were leaving. So disappointed!

reviews.title: Exceeded all of our expectations and more
reviews.text: Having traveled many times from the UK to Las Vegas, we have always preferred to stay mainly off strip. This time we chose the Tuscany suites and casino to finish off our last 5 nights in Las Vegas.What a great decision that was.Clean and spacious rooms are just the start, comfy beds, great restaurants and bars, shows and entertainment a plenty and friendly staff and great amenities abound. The thing we love most of all is just how clean the whole hotel and grounds are, the staff take great pride in how clean the place is and the groundsmen and women do  a fantastic job of keeping the grounds and plants looking just perfect, they are truly a credit to Tuscany and it’s management.We want to rave and rave about all the wonderful people who work there and the friendliness that they radiate which makes the whole experience so enjoyable.2 pools one quiet, one lively, your choice. Laundry room with washer and dryers, gym, spa, Italian restaurant, snack bar, shop and let’s not forget the Casino with its many promotions running frequently throughout our stay and last but not least Marilyn’s cafe where we enjoyed breakfast and evening meals on multiple occasions with a big shout out to Riza Mae our waitress who just put the cherry on the top of our stay with her smile and helpful nature.Would we go back, try stopping us. Booked 12 nights for June 2023 so we can soak up even more, I am sure we will discover even more in the extra time we have allocated for our next visit, we just can’t wait.

reviews.title: Nice off the strip
reviews.text: Very spacious rooms. Front desk staff was kind and helpful. Liked the pool area only wish hours were later. Rooms were clean and housekeeping always available for last minute needs. I will stay here again.

reviews.title: Loved this Place
reviews.text: This hotel is walking distance to the strip but it feels like a secluded little resort.  The pool area is beautiful.  There are sitting areas with fireplaces to help keep you warm on a cool night. The grounds are very well manicured.  There are a variety of places to eat from fine dining to a pub. They have a decent size casino and a lounge that features live music at night where you can dance or just enjoy the music.  The price was very reasonable.  The room was extra spacious with a little dining area and living area included. The bed was comfortable and so were the pillows. There is ample parking and it is free. We were so glad that we found this place.  We definitely will stay here again.

reviews.title: We came to relax, well that didn’t happen!!!!
reviews.text: When we checked in we requested a room close to the pool because we were recovering from knee surgery, apparently nothing was available. They put us in the furthest room, l102, which is furthest the last building in, across from the Racetrack that’s being built. We were in the ground floor and the guest above must of had multiple children with them, constant pounding on the ceiling, mo sleep for three nights, worst experience we ever had while staying at this resort hotel. We Won’t be back . Good riddance

reviews.title: Beautiful grounds and rooms, at (comparatively) reasonable rates.
reviews.text: Was ready to give an "excellent" review right up to check out.  The hotel grounds and rooms are beautiful, rates are competitive (although no breakfast included, the restaurant prices are reasonable).  It is more than a half mile walk to the Strip (probably why it is a good value).While we were carrying out our luggage and gear to the car, the guest management system disabled our keys and disabled the wifi.  It must have informed the cleaning crew that it thought we had left because she barged in to the room while we were in it, even though we had the "do not disturb" sign on the door.  We pointed out the sign and said we would be gone in about 20 minutes.  We then had to go get our keys re-enabled so we could finish carrying out.  The cleaning crew barged in again before we were done!  We reported this when checking out that this system needs to get fixed, and they did apologize.

reviews.title: Total Rip Off
reviews.text: Previously our fave off-strip friendly hotel.   Not any more.    Room rate quoted and accepted at $76 was actually $130.80 at checkout thanks to “lodging tax”, Resort Fee and resort fee tax.     The $135 night ended up as $198 !      In the Casino we each won vouchers for 20% discount off an entree in the Tuscany Gardens restaurant, usable that night only.    On presenting them we were told only one could be used.     As there was no indication of this on the voucher we disputed it.    One hour later after confrontations with three separate layers of management (and having refused the option of dining at separate tables !) a compromise was very grudgingly offered;  we had to have  separate checks.   Not a problem.  We delighted in adding our checks together and making a single payment.  Good PR ?   Consumer friendly ?   I don’t think so !     Will we ever go back ?    Never.

reviews.title: Price Gougers
reviews.text: I really want to post a good review because I do truly enjoy the Tuscany Suites. The rooms are nice. The casino is fun. The restaurant is superb. The Pub is a great place to hang out. I love the Rat Pack show. The reason for the bad review is because of their price gouging. We booked a total of 5 nights and paid, on average, about $400 per night for a 2-bedroom suite. We wanted to add another night to our stay because we don't have to be back to the airport until 8pm. They wanted to charge us $1,400 for another SINGLE night. That's preposterous. The girl at the desk said it's because the hotel is sold out. Well, obviously it's not sold out since our room IS available for that night, but they want to rape me for as much as they possibly can. So, even though I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely come back in the future, now they've lost a customer, and we usually come to Vegas at least twice a year. They also couldn't even give us a late checkout. Very unhappy.

reviews.title: Worst hotel vacation stay of my life
reviews.text: Do NOT stay here. They will steal your belongings. They will say you have checked out, have room service throw all of your wedding attire in a trash bag, steal your personal belongings and when you come back to a non working key to a room you reserved for a week in a block of 20 rooms for a wedding party they will tell you, I don't know what happened. It shows you checked out. They will not even call you. They can't tell you who checked you out when you're the only contact in the room.Then since there's three more nights and a wedding the next day when they give you your trash bag full of belongings, they'll put you in a smaller room to do inventory of your belongings. Don't worry they will take another payment up front, in full. You'll be told a security guard will come watch the inventory. The security guard will literally drop your stuff and say "that's not my job"Then you get the privilege of going through your own belongings just to find you're missing stuff and you get to go miss a before-wedding dinner and nearly cause the bride and groom to miss it as well.Don't worry though, I'll give you this cool little incident report to fill out and when you turn it back in and ask for a copy of it they absolutely ask like you shouldn't be able to have oneNow I get to spend my morning with customer service in the lobby instead of being with my brother, the groom and my familyThe gift shop sells packs of cigarettes for $20. Housekeeping with all of my other hygiene products and food stuff stole five packs of cigarettes.If you do the math they made $100 off of my cigarettes in the gift shop... They gave me a $40 credit for $200 worth of stolen stuff. They made more off of the cigarettes they stole from me than I got as a credit.Their system double booked me and sent me two confirmation emails at the exact same date and time and they told me that it was my fault that the guy at the counter canceled the wrong one and didn't ask. I have never felt like punching a guy over the counter that bad in my life. The general manager will simply smile at you and tell you that it is your fault because you used the wrong pre-check in email. I had only reserved one room so when I saw an email come in and i clicked it, I cannot tell you why their system online double booked me sending me two confirmation numbers at the exact same date and time.. in the end I got downgraded to a single room for me and my 18-year-old son. Instead of the double that I had booked for a week. I kind of gave up the fight on the wedding day being the third day out of 5:00 so that I could finally spend some time with my family.None of the 20 people in our party will ever stay here again. The beds are terrible. The staff is terrible and don't expect anything when they steal all of your stuff and kick you out of your room that you had reserved for a week because of their computers mistakes. They told me that they didn't charge me for the night that they kicked me out from our double that was reserved to a single room, but I have yet to see that credit.

reviews.title: Here I wait…
reviews.text: Flew  in to Vegas for a work conference. Got in about 930 am. Room wasn’t ready which was no surprise as Check in is at 3pm. I went and had breakfast at Marilyn’s then hung out in the lobby until 1pm. Then I started seeing people checking in and getting rooms. So I jump back in line and am told again my room isn’t ready and to come back at 3pm. Ok, no big deal. 3pm rolls around and I jump in line with 20 prime who are all getting rooms. AGAIN I’m told my room isn’t ready and to come back between 4 and 5 pm. Wtf?!! At that point, this was too much. How are prone getting rooms and I’m not? Well apparently rooms are pre-assigned and I’m just the unlucky fool whose room still isn’t ready. I tell them I’ve been here since 945am and am told that early check in isn’t guaranteed. Yeah, Esther, except I never asked or demanded early check in. I just want to be checked in at the stated check-in time!!!  So here I sit in the lobby. Still.

reviews.title: In desperate need of a renovation
reviews.text: Pros:- beautifully landscaped- easy parking- large room- quiet location away from the strip- nice coffee shopCons- rooms are dated with cheap quality finishes. Desperately in need of a refurbish. - good long 15-20 minute walk next to heavy traffic to get to the strip. - pool was closed so I can’t comment on that. - odd layout of disconnected buildings.Would stay here again only if they renovated and dropped the price.

reviews.title: Tuscany inn and suites
reviews.text: Great amenities and the location was perfect. Close enough to the strip, but away from a lot of the traffic. The room was huge and very clean. The casino was nice and the restaurant was very good. The grounds were very stylish.

reviews.title: Loud rooms, very noisy construction and need a car
reviews.text: Booked a King room for 2 nights but on arrival was told that a King was unavailable so they moved me to a double.  Was given Building M that faces the large construction project on the back side of the property and the construction goes on ALL NIGHT LONG with beeping trucks, low tone diesel truck drone and jack hammers.  The TV in my room did not work, the people above me must have had a child that ran around the room every hour on the hour.  The room was clean and roomy but pretty dated for today's standards.  The price was ok but by the time you add in the "resort fee" for internet and usage of items that I would never use in the winter in LV it was no different than a strip hotel cost.  The location is good if you have a car and parking was included in the resort fee.  The Casino is meh...ZERO live table games with only slots and automated Roulette , Craps and Blackjack.  I did not try the restaurants.  The drink service is spotty.  I would only stay here again if the price was lower than the strip hotels by a huge margin and the construction is done on the F1 place behind the hotel.

reviews.title: Construction site right next, land drilling starts at 6am
reviews.text: I notified the hotel about our late arrival - 2am. They still gave us our room in L block which is right beside the massive construction site which will last months if not years. 6am, and the drilling of land started and we could not get any sleep. Kids are grumpy, parents are mad. I’m never returning to this place for ruining our time in Vegas. The restaurants are overpriced; I scanned the Marilyn’s Cafe menu for room service, there is a massive up charge to that, so beware! I met an old guy who claimed to have been staying here for over 2 decades and was very upset about how this place has gone down in the last one year. When a loyal old customers say so, it kinda describes why you should avoid this place.
